### Task 4.2: Small client helpers: safe storage, debounce, online status, formatting, category recents, doc navigation

**Files**
- Create: `apps/web-next/src/app/app/_lib/safe-storage.ts`, `_lib/useDebouncedValue.ts`, `_lib/useOnlineStatus.ts`, `_lib/format.ts`, `_lib/category-recents.ts`, `_lib/doc-nav.ts` (all under `apps/web-next/src/app/app/`)
- Test: `apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/docs-helpers.test.ts`

**Interfaces**
- Consumes: `DocFilter`, `ExpenseCategory` (C1).
- Produces:
  - `readJson<T>(area: 'local'|'session', key, fallback): T`, `writeJson(area, key, value): void`
  - `useDebouncedValue<T>(value: T, ms = 300): T`, `useOnlineStatus(): boolean`
  - `formatDocDate(iso, locale)`, `formatTime(iso, locale)`, `isPdfUrl(url)`, `formatAmountInput(cents, locale)`, `todayIso()`
  - `RECENTS_KEY`, `getRecentCategories()`, `pushRecentCategory(c)`, `orderWithRecents(all, recents)`
  - `DOC_FILTERS`, `parseDocFilter(raw)`, `saveDocNav(nav)`, `readDocNav()`, `neighbors(nav, id)`, `removeFromDocNav(id)`, `docsHref(nav)`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests**

`apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/docs-helpers.test.ts`:
```ts
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { readJson, writeJson } from '@/app/app/_lib/safe-storage';
import { useDebouncedValue } from '@/app/app/_lib/useDebouncedValue';
import { useOnlineStatus } from '@/app/app/_lib/useOnlineStatus';
import { formatDocDate, isPdfUrl, formatAmountInput, todayIso } from '@/app/app/_lib/format';
import { getRecentCategories, pushRecentCategory, orderWithRecents, RECENTS_KEY } from '@/app/app/_lib/category-recents';
import { parseDocFilter, saveDocNav, readDocNav, neighbors, removeFromDocNav, docsHref } from '@/app/app/_lib/doc-nav';

beforeEach(() => { localStorage.clear(); sessionStorage.clear(); });

describe('safe-storage', () => {
  it('round-trips JSON', () => {
    writeJson('local', 'k', { a: 1 });
    expect(readJson('local', 'k', null)).toEqual({ a: 1 });
  });
  it('returns the fallback when storage throws (private mode / blocked site data)', () => {
    vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype, 'getItem').mockImplementation(() => { throw new Error('SecurityError'); });
    vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype, 'setItem').mockImplementation(() => { throw new Error('QuotaExceeded'); });
    expect(() => writeJson('local', 'k', 1)).not.toThrow();
    expect(readJson('local', 'k', 'fallback')).toBe('fallback');
  });
  it('returns the fallback on corrupt JSON', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('k', '{not json');
    expect(readJson('local', 'k', 7)).toBe(7);
  });
});

describe('useDebouncedValue', () => {
  it('only publishes the last value after the delay', () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const { result, rerender } = renderHook(({ v }) => useDebouncedValue(v, 300), { initialProps: { v: 'a' } });
    rerender({ v: 'ab' });
    rerender({ v: 'abc' });
    expect(result.current).toBe('a');
    act(() => { vi.advanceTimersByTime(299); });
    expect(result.current).toBe('a');
    act(() => { vi.advanceTimersByTime(1); });
    expect(result.current).toBe('abc');
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });
});

describe('useOnlineStatus', () => {
  it('tracks online/offline events', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useOnlineStatus());
    expect(result.current).toBe(true);
    act(() => { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('offline')); });
    expect(result.current).toBe(false);
    act(() => { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('online')); });
    expect(result.current).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('format', () => {
  it('formats a date-only ISO without shifting the day in negative time zones', () => {
    expect(formatDocDate('2026-10-01', 'en')).toBe('Oct 1, 2026');
    expect(formatDocDate('2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z', 'en')).toBe('Oct 1, 2026');
  });
  it('returns empty for an unparseable date', () => {
    expect(formatDocDate('nope', 'en')).toBe('');
  });
  it('detects PDF receipts by path, ignoring query strings', () => {
    expect(isPdfUrl('https://x.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/r/a.PDF?download=1')).toBe(true);
    expect(isPdfUrl('https://x.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/r/a.jpg')).toBe(false);
    expect(isPdfUrl(null)).toBe(false);
  });
  it('formats an editable amount with the locale decimal separator and no grouping', () => {
    expect(formatAmountInput(123456, 'en')).toBe('1234.56');
    expect(formatAmountInput(4700, 'fr-CA')).toBe('47,00');
  });
  it('todayIso is a local YYYY-MM-DD', () => {
    expect(todayIso()).toMatch(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/);
  });
});

describe('category recents', () => {
  it('pushes most-recent-first, de-duplicates and caps at 5', () => {
    for (const id of ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f']) pushRecentCategory({ id, name: id.toUpperCase() });
    pushRecentCategory({ id: 'c', name: 'C' });
    expect(getRecentCategories().map((r) => r.id)).toEqual(['c', 'f', 'e', 'd', 'b']);
  });
  it('ignores malformed storage', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(RECENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify([{ nope: 1 }, 'x', { id: 'ok', name: 'OK' }]));
    expect(getRecentCategories()).toEqual([{ id: 'ok', name: 'OK' }]);
  });
  it('orders recents first, rest alphabetically, and drops recents that no longer exist', () => {
    const all = [
      { id: '1', name: 'Travel', code: '5100' },
      { id: '2', name: 'Meals', code: '5200' },
      { id: '3', name: 'Advertising', code: '5000' },
    ];
    const { recent, rest } = orderWithRecents(all, [{ id: '2', name: 'Meals' }, { id: 'gone', name: 'Old' }]);
    expect(recent.map((c) => c.name)).toEqual(['Meals']);
    expect(rest.map((c) => c.name)).toEqual(['Advertising', 'Travel']);
  });
});

describe('doc-nav', () => {
  it('parses only known filters', () => {
    expect(parseDocFilter('needs-review')).toBe('needs-review');
    expect(parseDocFilter('archived')).toBe('archived');
    expect(parseDocFilter('bogus')).toBe('all');
    expect(parseDocFilter(null)).toBe('all');
  });
  it('computes neighbours from the saved list', () => {
    saveDocNav({ ids: ['a', 'b', 'c'], filter: 'no-category', q: 'cafe' });
    const nav = readDocNav();
    expect(neighbors(nav, 'b')).toEqual({ prev: 'a', next: 'c' });
    expect(neighbors(nav, 'a')).toEqual({ prev: null, next: 'b' });
    expect(neighbors(nav, 'zzz')).toEqual({ prev: null, next: null });
    expect(docsHref(nav)).toBe('/app/docs?filter=no-category&q=cafe');
  });
  it('removes a deleted id', () => {
    saveDocNav({ ids: ['a', 'b'], filter: 'all', q: '' });
    removeFromDocNav('a');
    expect(readDocNav()?.ids).toEqual(['b']);
    expect(docsHref(readDocNav())).toBe('/app/docs');
  });
  it('survives sessionStorage being unavailable', () => {
    vi.spyOn(Storage.prototype, 'getItem').mockImplementation(() => { throw new Error('blocked'); });
    expect(readDocNav()).toBeNull();
    expect(neighbors(null, 'a')).toEqual({ prev: null, next: null });
    expect(docsHref(null)).toBe('/app/docs');
```

```ts
/**
 * localStorage/sessionStorage access that never throws. Private windows,
 * blocked site data and full quotas all throw from the accessor itself; every
 * caller here stores a convenience (view mode, recents, nav list), so the
 * right failure is "behave as if nothing was stored".
 */
type Area = 'local' | 'session';

function area(a: Area): Storage | null {
  try {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
    return a === 'local' ? window.localStorage : window.sessionStorage;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function readJson<T>(a: Area, key: string, fallback: T): T {
  try {
    const raw = area(a)?.getItem(key);
    return raw == null ? fallback : (JSON.parse(raw) as T);
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

export function writeJson(a: Area, key: string, value: unknown): void {
  try {
    area(a)?.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
  } catch {
    /* storage unavailable or full — the value is a convenience only */
  }
}
```

```ts
'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export function useDebouncedValue<T>(value: T, delayMs = 300): T {
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delayMs);
    return () => clearTimeout(h);
  }, [value, delayMs]);
  return debounced;
}
```

```ts
'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export function useOnlineStatus(): boolean {
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(() =>
    typeof navigator === 'undefined' ? true : navigator.onLine !== false,
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    const on = () => setOnline(true);
    const off = () => setOnline(false);
    window.addEventListener('online', on);
    window.addEventListener('offline', off);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', on);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', off);
    };
  }, []);
  return online;
}
```

```ts
/** Display helpers shared by Docs and Capture. Money itself goes through the kit's <Money>. */

function toDate(iso: string): Date {
  // A bare YYYY-MM-DD is a calendar date, not an instant — pin it to UTC and
  // format in UTC, or a user west of Greenwich sees the previous day.
  return new Date(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(iso) ? `${iso}T00:00:00Z` : iso);
}

export function formatDocDate(iso: string, locale: string): string {
  const d = toDate(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' }).format(d);
  } catch {
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
}

export function formatTime(iso: string, locale: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }).format(d);
  } catch {
    return d.toISOString().slice(11, 16);
  }
}

export function isPdfUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!url) return false;
  try {
    return /\.pdf$/i.test(new URL(url, 'https://placeholder.invalid').pathname);
  } catch {
    return /\.pdf(\?|#|$)/i.test(url);
  }
}

/** The value an amount <input> starts with: locale decimal separator, never grouping (so it re-parses). */
export function formatAmountInput(cents: number, locale: string): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2, useGrouping: false }).format(cents / 100);
  } catch {
    return (cents / 100).toFixed(2);
  }
}

export function todayIso(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;
}
```

```ts
import type { ExpenseCategory } from '@/lib/mobile/types';
import { readJson, writeJson } from './safe-storage';

export const RECENTS_KEY = 'ab:mobile:category-recents';
const MAX_RECENTS = 5;

/** Stored with the name so Capture can show recent chips while offline. */
export type RecentCategory = Pick<ExpenseCategory, 'id' | 'name'>;

function isRecent(v: unknown): v is RecentCategory {
  return !!v && typeof v === 'object'
    && typeof (v as RecentCategory).id === 'string'
    && typeof (v as RecentCategory).name === 'string';
}

export function getRecentCategories(): RecentCategory[] {
  const raw = readJson<unknown>('local', RECENTS_KEY, []);
  return Array.isArray(raw) ? raw.filter(isRecent).slice(0, MAX_RECENTS) : [];
}

export function pushRecentCategory(c: RecentCategory): RecentCategory[] {
  const next = [{ id: c.id, name: c.name }, ...getRecentCategories().filter((r) => r.id !== c.id)].slice(0, MAX_RECENTS);
  writeJson('local', RECENTS_KEY, next);
  return next;
}

export function orderWithRecents(
  all: ExpenseCategory[],
  recents: RecentCategory[],
): { recent: ExpenseCategory[]; rest: ExpenseCategory[] } {
  const byId = new Map(all.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
  const recent = recents.map((r) => byId.get(r.id)).filter((c): c is ExpenseCategory => !!c);
  const taken = new Set(recent.map((c) => c.id));
  const rest = all.filter((c) => !taken.has(c.id)).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  return { recent, rest };
}
```

```ts
import type { DocFilter } from '@/lib/mobile/types';
import { readJson, writeJson } from './safe-storage';

export const DOC_FILTERS: readonly DocFilter[] = ['needs-review', 'no-category', 'no-receipt', 'all', 'archived'];
const NAV_KEY = 'ab:mobile:docs:nav';

export interface DocNav { ids: string[]; filter: DocFilter; q: string }

export function parseDocFilter(raw: string | null | undefined): DocFilter {
  return (DOC_FILTERS as readonly string[]).includes(raw ?? '') ? (raw as DocFilter) : 'all';
}

/** The ids the list showed, in order — so the viewer's prev/next walks the SAME filtered list. */
export function saveDocNav(nav: DocNav): void {
  writeJson('session', NAV_KEY, nav);
}

export function readDocNav(): DocNav | null {
  const v = readJson<DocNav | null>('session', NAV_KEY, null);
  return v && Array.isArray(v.ids) ? { ids: v.ids.filter((x) => typeof x === 'string'), filter: parseDocFilter(v.filter), q: typeof v.q === 'string' ? v.q : '' } : null;
}

export function neighbors(nav: DocNav | null, id: string): { prev: string | null; next: string | null } {
  if (!nav) return { prev: null, next: null };
  const i = nav.ids.indexOf(id);
  if (i < 0) return { prev: null, next: null };
  return { prev: i > 0 ? nav.ids[i - 1] : null, next: i < nav.ids.length - 1 ? nav.ids[i + 1] : null };
}

export function removeFromDocNav(id: string): void {
  const nav = readDocNav();
  if (nav) saveDocNav({ ...nav, ids: nav.ids.filter((x) => x !== id) });
}

export function docsHref(nav: DocNav | null): string {
  const p = new URLSearchParams();
  if (nav && nav.filter !== 'all') p.set('filter', nav.filter);
  if (nav?.q) p.set('q', nav.q);
  const s = p.toString();
  return s ? `/app/docs?${s}` : '/app/docs';
}
```

**Currency rule.** `AbExpense.currency` defaults to `'USD'` and `MobileDoc` carries no currency. `AbTenantConfig.currency` also defaults to `'USD'`, so a CA/AU tenant who never saved Business Profile would get US dollars. The rule: an explicit non-default currency wins. The schema default `USD` on a non-US jurisdiction falls back to `defaultCurrencyFor(jurisdiction)`.

`apps/web-next/src/app/app/_lib/api-extra.ts`:
```ts
/**
 * Client calls the mobile screens need that are NOT in the C4 api.ts contract
 * (api.ts is owned by PR 2 and not edited by screen PRs). Each targets an
 * EXISTING production route. Fold these into api.ts when it is next revised.
 */
import { defaultCurrencyFor } from '@/lib/jurisdiction-currency';

export class HttpError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;
  readonly code?: string;
  constructor(message: string, status: number, code?: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'HttpError';
    this.status = status;
    this.code = code;
  }
}

export async function request<T>(path: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(path, { credentials: 'include', ...init });
  } catch {
    throw new HttpError('network', 0, 'network');
  }
  // The service worker answers for the network when the device is offline;
  // fetch() does not throw for that, so the marker header is the only signal.
  if (res.headers?.get?.('X-Agentbook-Offline') === '1') throw new HttpError('offline', 0, 'offline');
  let body: { success?: boolean; data?: T; error?: string } | null;
  try {
    body = await res.json();
  } catch {
    throw new HttpError(`HTTP ${res.status}`, res.status, 'bad_json');
  }
  if (!res.ok || body?.success === false) throw new HttpError(body?.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`, res.status);
  return body?.data as T;
}

export interface PendingSuggestion {
  expenseId: string;
  vendorName: string | null;
  amountCents: number;
  date: string;
  description: string | null;
  suggestedCategoryId: string;
  suggestedCategoryName: string;
  confidence: number;
}

function toSuggestion(raw: unknown): PendingSuggestion | null {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return null;
  const r = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (typeof r.expenseId !== 'string' || typeof r.suggestedCategoryId !== 'string' || typeof r.suggestedCategoryName !== 'string') return null;
  return {
    expenseId: r.expenseId,
    vendorName: typeof r.vendorName === 'string' ? r.vendorName : null,
    amountCents: typeof r.amountCents === 'number' ? r.amountCents : 0,
    date: typeof r.date === 'string' ? r.date : r.date instanceof Date ? r.date.toISOString() : '',
    description: typeof r.description === 'string' ? r.description : null,
    suggestedCategoryId: r.suggestedCategoryId,
    suggestedCategoryName: r.suggestedCategoryName,
    confidence: typeof r.confidence === 'number' ? r.confidence : 0,
  };
}

export async function getPendingSuggestions(): Promise<{ items: PendingSuggestion[]; uncategorizedCount: number }> {
  const data = await request<{ items?: unknown[]; uncategorizedCount?: number }>('/api/v1/agentbook-core/auto-categorize/pending');
  const items = (Array.isArray(data?.items) ? data.items : []).map(toSuggestion).filter((s): s is PendingSuggestion => !!s);
  return { items, uncategorizedCount: typeof data?.uncategorizedCount === 'number' ? data.uncategorizedCount : 0 };
}

export function resolveTenantCurrency(cfg: { currency?: string | null; jurisdiction?: string | null }): string {
  const jurisdiction = cfg.jurisdiction || 'us';
  const fallback = defaultCurrencyFor(jurisdiction);
  const currency = (cfg.currency || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!currency) return fallback;
  // 'USD' is the AbTenantConfig schema default — on a non-US tenant it means
  // "never set", not "bills in US dollars".
  if (currency === 'USD' && jurisdiction !== 'us') return fallback;
  return currency;
}

export async function getTenantCurrency(): Promise<string> {
  const cfg = await request<{ currency?: string | null; jurisdiction?: string | null }>('/api/v1/agentbook-core/tenant-config');
  return resolveTenantCurrency(cfg ?? {});
}

/**
 * Moves a pending_review expense to confirmed. Callers MUST only call this
 * when the expense has a category: the confirm route posts a journal entry
 * only when a category is known, so confirming an uncategorized business
 * expense would leave it "confirmed" but off the ledger.
 */
export async function confirmDoc(id: string): Promise<void> {
  await request<unknown>(`/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/confirm`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: '{}',
  });
}
```

```ts
import { getTenantCurrency } from './api-extra';

/** ISO currency for the tenant, or null until known — never a guessed 'USD'. */
export function useTenantCurrency(): string | null {
  const { data } = useMobileData<string>('tenant-currency', getTenantCurrency);
  return data ?? null;
}
```

`apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/_mock-io.ts`:
```ts
/** Minimal IntersectionObserver double: records observe() calls and lets a test fire entries. */
export class MockIntersectionObserver {
  static instances: MockIntersectionObserver[] = [];
  observed = new Set<Element>();
  observeCalls = 0;
  disconnected = false;
  constructor(private cb: IntersectionObserverCallback, public options?: IntersectionObserverInit) {
    MockIntersectionObserver.instances.push(this);
  }
  observe(el: Element) { this.observed.add(el); this.observeCalls += 1; }
  unobserve(el: Element) { this.observed.delete(el); }
  disconnect() { this.observed.clear(); this.disconnected = true; }
  takeRecords() { return []; }
  fire(isIntersecting = true) {
    const entries = [...this.observed].map((target) => ({ isIntersecting, target })) as unknown as IntersectionObserverEntry[];
    this.cb(entries, this as unknown as IntersectionObserver);
  }
  static latest(): MockIntersectionObserver {
    return MockIntersectionObserver.instances[MockIntersectionObserver.instances.length - 1];
  }
  static reset() { MockIntersectionObserver.instances = []; }
}
```

`apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/use-infinite-scroll.test.tsx`:

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { useInfiniteScroll } from '@/app/app/_lib/useInfiniteScroll';
import { MockIntersectionObserver } from './_mock-io';

function Harness(props: { hasMore: boolean; loading: boolean; onLoadMore: () => void; onSupported?: (s: boolean) => void }) {
  const { sentinelRef, supported } = useInfiniteScroll(props);
  props.onSupported?.(supported);
  return <div ref={sentinelRef} data-testid="sentinel" />;
}

beforeEach(() => { MockIntersectionObserver.reset(); vi.stubGlobal('IntersectionObserver', MockIntersectionObserver); });
afterEach(() => { vi.unstubAllGlobals(); });

describe('useInfiniteScroll', () => {
  it('loads more when the sentinel intersects', () => {
    const onLoadMore = vi.fn();
    render(<Harness hasMore loading={false} onLoadMore={onLoadMore} />);
    act(() => MockIntersectionObserver.latest().fire(true));
    expect(onLoadMore).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(MockIntersectionObserver.latest().options?.rootMargin).toBe('400px');
  });
  it('ignores non-intersecting entries', () => {
    const onLoadMore = vi.fn();
    render(<Harness hasMore loading={false} onLoadMore={onLoadMore} />);
    act(() => MockIntersectionObserver.latest().fire(false));
    expect(onLoadMore).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('does not load when there is no next page', () => {
    const onLoadMore = vi.fn();
    render(<Harness hasMore={false} loading={false} onLoadMore={onLoadMore} />);
    act(() => MockIntersectionObserver.latest().fire(true));
    expect(onLoadMore).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('does not double-load while a page is in flight', () => {
    const onLoadMore = vi.fn();
    render(<Harness hasMore loading onLoadMore={onLoadMore} />);
    act(() => MockIntersectionObserver.latest().fire(true));
    expect(onLoadMore).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it('re-observes after a page lands so a still-visible sentinel triggers the next page', () => {
    const onLoadMore = vi.fn();
    const { rerender } = render(<Harness hasMore loading={false} onLoadMore={onLoadMore} />);
    const io = MockIntersectionObserver.latest();
    const before = io.observeCalls;
    rerender(<Harness hasMore loading onLoadMore={onLoadMore} />);
    rerender(<Harness hasMore loading={false} onLoadMore={onLoadMore} />);
    expect(io.observeCalls).toBeGreaterThan(before);
  });
  it('disconnects on unmount', () => {
    const { unmount } = render(<Harness hasMore loading={false} onLoadMore={vi.fn()} />);
    const io = MockIntersectionObserver.latest();
    unmount();
    expect(io.disconnected).toBe(true);
  });
  it('reports unsupported (so the page shows a Load more button) when IntersectionObserver is missing', () => {
    vi.stubGlobal('IntersectionObserver', undefined);
    const seen: boolean[] = [];
    expect(() => render(<Harness hasMore loading={false} onLoadMore={vi.fn()} onSupported={(s) => seen.push(s)} />)).not.toThrow();
    expect(seen.at(-1)).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

`apps/web-next/src/app/app/_lib/useInfiniteScroll.ts`:
```ts
'use client';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

interface Options { hasMore: boolean; loading: boolean; onLoadMore: () => void; rootMargin?: string }

/**
 * Calls onLoadMore when a sentinel element nears the viewport. Two subtleties:
 *  - An observer only fires on CHANGES in intersection. If a page lands and the
 *    sentinel is still visible (short pages, tall phones), nothing would fire
 *    again — so after every load we unobserve+observe, which makes the observer
 *    deliver the current state once more.
 *  - Callers read `supported` and render a "Load more" button when false.
 */
export function useInfiniteScroll({ hasMore, loading, onLoadMore, rootMargin = '400px' }: Options) {
  const supported = typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.IntersectionObserver === 'function';
  const latest = useRef({ hasMore, loading, onLoadMore });
  latest.current = { hasMore, loading, onLoadMore };
  const observer = useRef<IntersectionObserver | null>(null);
  const element = useRef<Element | null>(null);

  const sentinelRef = useCallback((el: Element | null) => {
    observer.current?.disconnect();
    observer.current = null;
    element.current = el;
    if (!el || !supported) return;
    observer.current = new window.IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      const s = latest.current;
      if (entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting) && s.hasMore && !s.loading) s.onLoadMore();
    }, { rootMargin });
    observer.current.observe(el);
  }, [supported, rootMargin]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = element.current;
    const o = observer.current;
    if (el && o && !loading && hasMore) {
      o.unobserve(el);
      o.observe(el);
    }
  }, [loading, hasMore]);

  useEffect(() => () => observer.current?.disconnect(), []);

  return { sentinelRef, supported };
}
```

### Task 4.5: Thumbnails through the Next image optimizer, plus a check on the remotePatterns config

**Decision.** `apps/web-next/next.config.js` already has `images.remotePatterns: [{ protocol: 'https', hostname: '**.vercel-storage.com' }, …]`. Receipts are written by `put(…, { access: 'public' })` (in `receipts/scan`, `receipts/upload-blob` and the PR 1 `from-receipt`), which produces `https://<storeId>.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/receipts/<tenant>/…`. In Next's matcher, `**` matches any number of leading subdomains, so **no config change is needed**. What this task adds is a test that pins it: a future edit that narrows the pattern, or adds `unoptimized: true`, fails CI instead of quietly sending full-size receipts into list rows. The pattern only admits Vercel Blob hosts, so the optimizer can't be used to proxy arbitrary origins. That is also asserted. **Fallback (spec §9):** if the optimizer errors for a URL, `DocThumb` switches to a lazily loaded `<img>` with fixed width and height, so a list never shows a broken image or shifts layout. PDFs get an icon tile, since the optimizer cannot rasterise them. Task 5.6 adds a production probe of `/_next/image` for a real receipt.

**Files**
- Create: `apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/_components/DocThumb.tsx`
- Test: `apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/image-remote-patterns.test.ts`, `apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/doc-thumb.test.tsx`

**Interfaces**
- Consumes: `next/image`, `isPdfUrl` (Task 4.2).
- Produces: `DocThumb({ src: string | null; size: number; alt: string })`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement DocThumb**

`apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/_components/DocThumb.tsx`:
```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { FileText, Receipt } from 'lucide-react';
import { isPdfUrl } from '../../_lib/format';

/**
 * List thumbnail. Receipts are full-size public Blob photos (often 1-3 MB);
 * rendering them raw in a 100-row list is the render-blocking load the spec
 * forbids, so they go through the Next image optimizer at the displayed size.
 * Width/height are always fixed so rows never shift as images arrive.
 */
export function DocThumb({ src, size, alt }: { src: string | null; size: number; alt: string }) {
  const [fallback, setFallback] = useState(false);
  const box: React.CSSProperties = {
    width: size, height: size, flex: '0 0 auto', borderRadius: 8, overflow: 'hidden',
    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
    background: 'var(--muted, rgba(127,127,127,0.14))', color: 'var(--muted-foreground)',
  };
  const icon = { width: Math.round(size * 0.42), height: Math.round(size * 0.42) };

  if (!src) {
    return <span style={box} aria-hidden="true" data-testid="doc-thumb-empty"><Receipt style={icon} /></span>;
  }
  if (isPdfUrl(src)) {
    return <span style={box} aria-hidden="true" data-testid="doc-thumb-pdf"><FileText style={icon} /></span>;
  }
  return (
    <span style={box}>
      {fallback ? (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
        <img src={src} alt={alt} width={size} height={size} loading="lazy" decoding="async"
          style={{ width: size, height: size, objectFit: 'cover' }} data-testid="doc-thumb-fallback" />
      ) : (
        <Image src={src} alt={alt} width={size} height={size} sizes={`${size}px`} quality={60} loading="lazy"
          style={{ width: size, height: size, objectFit: 'cover' }} onError={() => setFallback(true)} data-testid="doc-thumb" />
      )}
    </span>
  );
}
```

**Interfaces**

- Produces:
  - `AiBanner({ noCategoryCount: number; online: boolean; currency: string | null; onChanged: () => void })`
  - `ReviewSheet({ open; onClose; items: PendingSuggestion[]; currency: string | null; onResolved: (ids: string[]) => void })`
  - `Amount({ cents; currency: string | null })`, which renders `<Money>` or an em dash until the currency is known
  - `LAST_AUTOCAT_KEY = 'ab:mobile:docs:last-autocat'`

**What "AI categorized N · M need you" means:** M is the number of pending AI suggestions from the existing `pending` route. N is the `appliedCount` of this device's last Auto-categorize run in the past 24 h, stored under `LAST_AUTOCAT_KEY`. No server count of "AI-categorized" items exists, and the banner never shows a number it doesn't have. When N is unknown and M > 0, the banner reads "AI picks waiting: M". When both are zero and some items have no category, it reads "Without a category: K". Otherwise it is hidden.

`apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/_components/ReviewSheet.tsx`:
```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useT } from '@/hooks/use-t';
import type { ReviewItem } from '@/lib/mobile/types';
import { reviewSuggestions } from '../../_lib/api';
import type { PendingSuggestion } from '../../_lib/api-extra';
import { Sheet, Pill, useToast } from '../../_kit';
import { Amount } from './Amount';

const btn: React.CSSProperties = { minHeight: 44, minWidth: 44, padding: '0 14px', borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--card)', color: 'var(--foreground)', fontSize: 14 };
const primary: React.CSSProperties = { ...btn, background: 'var(--primary)', color: 'var(--primary-foreground, #04130c)', border: 'none', fontWeight: 600 };

export function ReviewSheet({ open, onClose, items, currency, onResolved }: {
  open: boolean; onClose: () => void; items: PendingSuggestion[]; currency: string | null; onResolved: (ids: string[]) => void;
}) {
  const t = useT();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const visible = items.filter((i) => !hidden.has(i.expenseId));

  async function submit(batch: ReviewItem[]) {
    const ids = batch.map((b) => b.expenseId);
    setHidden((prev) => new Set([...prev, ...ids]));       // optimistic
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const results = await reviewSuggestions(batch);
      const ok = ids.filter((id) => results.some((r) => r.expenseId === id && r.ok));
      const failed = ids.filter((id) => !ok.includes(id));
      if (failed.length) {
        setHidden((prev) => { const n = new Set(prev); failed.forEach((id) => n.delete(id)); return n; });
        toast.show(batch.length === 1 ? t('mobile.docs.review_failed') : t('mobile.docs.review_partial', { failed: failed.length }), 'critical');
      }
      if (ok.length) onResolved(ok);
    } catch {
      setHidden((prev) => { const n = new Set(prev); ids.forEach((id) => n.delete(id)); return n; });
      toast.show(t('mobile.docs.review_failed'), 'critical');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onClose={onClose} title={t('mobile.docs.review_title')}>
      {visible.length === 0 ? (
        <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted-foreground)', padding: '8px 0' }}>{t('mobile.docs.review_empty')}</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <ul style={{ listStyle: 'none', margin: 0, padding: 0, display: 'grid', gap: 10 }}>
            {visible.map((s) => {
              const vendor = s.vendorName || s.description || t('mobile.docs.untitled');
              return (
                <li key={s.expenseId} data-testid="review-row" style={{ border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 12, padding: 12, display: 'grid', gap: 8 }}>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 8 }}>
                    <span style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{vendor}</span>
                    <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}><Amount cents={s.amountCents} currency={currency} /></span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                    <span>{t('mobile.docs.suggested', { category: s.suggestedCategoryName })}</span>
                    <Pill tone="info">{t('mobile.docs.confidence', { pct: Math.round(s.confidence * 100) })}</Pill>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
                    <button type="button" style={primary} disabled={busy}
                      aria-label={t('mobile.docs.accept_for', { category: s.suggestedCategoryName, vendor })}
                      onClick={() => void submit([{ expenseId: s.expenseId, action: 'accept', categoryId: s.suggestedCategoryId }])}>
                      {t('mobile.docs.accept')}
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" style={btn} disabled={busy}
                      aria-label={t('mobile.docs.reject_for', { category: s.suggestedCategoryName, vendor })}
                      onClick={() => void submit([{ expenseId: s.expenseId, action: 'reject' }])}>
                      {t('mobile.docs.reject')}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
          <button type="button" style={{ ...primary, width: '100%', marginTop: 12 }} disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void submit(visible.map((s) => ({ expenseId: s.expenseId, action: 'accept' as const, categoryId: s.suggestedCategoryId })))}>
            {t('mobile.docs.accept_all')}
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

`apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/_components/AiBanner.tsx`:
```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useT } from '@/hooks/use-t';
import { runAutoCategorize } from '../../_lib/api';
import { getPendingSuggestions, type PendingSuggestion } from '../../_lib/api-extra';
import { readJson, writeJson } from '../../_lib/safe-storage';
import { Banner, useToast } from '../../_kit';
import { ReviewSheet } from './ReviewSheet';

export const LAST_AUTOCAT_KEY = 'ab:mobile:docs:last-autocat';
const RUN_TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

interface LastRun { appliedCount: number; pendingCount: number; skippedCount: number; at: number }

function readLastRun(): LastRun | null {
  const r = readJson<LastRun | null>('local', LAST_AUTOCAT_KEY, null);
  return r && typeof r.appliedCount === 'number' && typeof r.at === 'number' && Date.now() - r.at < RUN_TTL_MS ? r : null;
}

const btn: React.CSSProperties = { minHeight: 44, padding: '0 14px', borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--card)', color: 'var(--foreground)', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 500 };

export function AiBanner({ noCategoryCount, online, currency, onChanged }: {
  noCategoryCount: number; online: boolean; currency: string | null; onChanged: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useT();
  const toast = useToast();
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<PendingSuggestion[]>([]);
  const [lastRun, setLastRun] = useState<LastRun | null>(() => readLastRun());
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const loadPending = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setPending((await getPendingSuggestions()).items);
    } catch {
      setPending([]);   // unknown → show no "need you" count rather than a stale one
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { void loadPending(); }, [loadPending]);

  async function run() {
    setRunning(true);
    try {
      const r = await runAutoCategorize();
      const rec: LastRun = { ...r, at: Date.now() };
      writeJson('local', LAST_AUTOCAT_KEY, rec);
      setLastRun(rec);
      toast.show(
        r.appliedCount === 0 && r.pendingCount === 0
          ? t('mobile.docs.autocat_nothing')
          : t('mobile.docs.autocat_done', { applied: r.appliedCount, pending: r.pendingCount }),
        'good',
      );
      await loadPending();
      onChanged();
    } catch {
      toast.show(t('mobile.docs.autocat_failed'), 'critical');
    } finally {
      setRunning(false);
    }
  }

  const m = pending.length;
  const n = lastRun?.appliedCount ?? null;
  let title: string | null = null;
  if (n !== null) title = t('mobile.docs.ai_summary', { n, m });
  else if (m > 0) title = t('mobile.docs.ai_pending', { m });
  else if (noCategoryCount > 0) title = t('mobile.docs.ai_idle', { k: noCategoryCount });
  if (title === null) return null;

  return (
    <Banner tone="info" title={title}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginTop: 8 }}>
        <button type="button" style={btn} disabled={m === 0 || !online} onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
          {t('mobile.docs.review_ai_picks')}
        </button>
        <button type="button" style={btn} disabled={running || !online} aria-busy={running} onClick={() => void run()}>
          {running ? t('mobile.docs.auto_categorizing') : t('mobile.docs.auto_categorize')}
        </button>
      </div>
      <ReviewSheet
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        items={pending}
        currency={currency}
        onResolved={(ids) => { setPending((p) => p.filter((s) => !ids.includes(s.expenseId))); onChanged(); }}
      />
    </Banner>
  );
}
```

`apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/_components/FilterChips.tsx`:
```tsx
'use client';
import React from 'react';
import { useT } from '@/hooks/use-t';
import type { DocCounts, DocFilter } from '@/lib/mobile/types';
import { Chip } from '../../_kit';
import { DOC_FILTERS } from '../../_lib/doc-nav';

const LABEL_KEY: Record<DocFilter, string> = {
  'needs-review': 'mobile.docs.filter_needs_review',
  'no-category': 'mobile.docs.filter_no_category',
  'no-receipt': 'mobile.docs.filter_no_receipt',
  all: 'mobile.docs.filter_all',
  archived: 'mobile.docs.filter_archived',
};

function countFor(f: DocFilter, c: DocCounts | null): number | undefined {
  if (!c) return undefined;
  switch (f) {
    case 'needs-review': return c.needsReview;
    case 'no-category': return c.noCategory;
    case 'no-receipt': return c.noReceipt;
    case 'archived': return c.archived;
    default: return undefined;
  }
}

export function FilterChips({ value, counts, onChange }: { value: DocFilter; counts: DocCounts | null; onChange: (f: DocFilter) => void }) {
  const t = useT();
  return (
    <div role="group" aria-label={t('mobile.docs.filters_label')}
      style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, overflowX: 'auto', padding: '12px 16px 4px', scrollbarWidth: 'none' }}>
      {DOC_FILTERS.map((f) => (
        <Chip key={f} label={t(LABEL_KEY[f])} count={countFor(f, counts)} selected={f === value} onClick={() => onChange(f)} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';
import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useT, useShellLocale } from '@/hooks/use-t';
import type { MobileDoc } from '@/lib/mobile/types';
import { Pill } from '../../_kit';
import { formatDocDate } from '../../_lib/format';
import { DocThumb } from './DocThumb';
import { Amount } from './Amount';

const ellipsis: React.CSSProperties = { overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' };

export function DocItem({ doc, view, currency }: { doc: MobileDoc; view: 'list' | 'grid'; currency: string | null }) {
  const t = useT();
  const locale = useShellLocale();
  const title = doc.vendorName || doc.description || t('mobile.docs.untitled');
  const pills = (
    <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 4, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
      {doc.categorySource === 'ai' && <Pill tone="info">{t('mobile.docs.ai_pill')}</Pill>}
      {doc.status === 'pending_review' && <Pill tone="warn">{t('mobile.docs.review_pill')}</Pill>}
      {doc.archivedAt && <Pill tone="neutral">{t('mobile.docs.archived_pill')}</Pill>}
    </span>
  );
  const common: React.CSSProperties = {
    textDecoration: 'none', color: 'var(--foreground)', background: 'var(--card)',
    border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 12, minHeight: 44,
  };

  if (view === 'grid') {
    return (
      <Link href={`/app/docs/${doc.id}`} data-testid="doc-item" style={{ ...common, display: 'grid', gap: 6, padding: 8, justifyItems: 'start' }}>
        <DocThumb src={doc.receiptUrl} size={96} alt="" />
        <span style={{ ...ellipsis, maxWidth: '100%', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 500 }}>{title}</span>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 600 }}><Amount cents={doc.amountCents} currency={currency} /></span>
        {pills}
      </Link>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Link href={`/app/docs/${doc.id}`} data-testid="doc-item" style={{ ...common, display: 'flex', gap: 12, alignItems: 'center', padding: 10 }}>
      <DocThumb src={doc.receiptUrl} size={48} alt="" />
      <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, display: 'grid', gap: 2 }}>
        <span style={{ ...ellipsis, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 500 }}>{title}</span>
        <span style={{ ...ellipsis, fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted-foreground)' }}>
          {formatDocDate(doc.date, locale)} · {doc.categoryName ?? t('mobile.docs.no_category')}
        </span>
        {pills}
      </span>
      <span style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}><Amount cents={doc.amountCents} currency={currency} /></span>
    </Link>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import React, { Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { LayoutGrid, List as ListIcon, Search } from 'lucide-react';
import { useT, useShellLocale } from '@/hooks/use-t';
import type { DocCounts, DocFilter, DocList, MobileDoc } from '@/lib/mobile/types';
import { listDocs } from '../_lib/api';
import { useMobileData } from '../_lib/useMobileData';
import { useDebouncedValue } from '../_lib/useDebouncedValue';
import { useOnlineStatus } from '../_lib/useOnlineStatus';
import { useTenantCurrency } from '../_lib/useTenantCurrency';
import { useInfiniteScroll } from '../_lib/useInfiniteScroll';
import { readJson, writeJson } from '../_lib/safe-storage';
import { parseDocFilter, saveDocNav } from '../_lib/doc-nav';
import { formatTime } from '../_lib/format';
import { Skeleton, EmptyState } from '../_kit';
import { FilterChips } from './_components/FilterChips';
import { DocItem } from './_components/DocItem';
import { AiBanner } from './_components/AiBanner';

const VIEW_KEY = 'ab:mobile:docs:view';
const PAGE_SIZE = 30;
type ViewMode = 'list' | 'grid';

const iconBtn: React.CSSProperties = { minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--card)', color: 'var(--foreground)' };
const textBtn: React.CSSProperties = { minHeight: 44, padding: '0 16px', borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--card)', color: 'var(--foreground)', fontSize: 14 };
const notice: React.CSSProperties = { margin: '8px 16px 0', padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 13, background: 'var(--muted, rgba(127,127,127,0.14))', color: 'var(--foreground)' };

export default function MobileDocsPage() {
  // useSearchParams() needs a Suspense boundary or `next build` refuses to prerender the route.
  return <Suspense fallback={<DocsSkeleton />}><DocsScreen /></Suspense>;
}

function DocsSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div data-testid="docs-skeleton" aria-busy="true" style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 8, padding: '12px 16px' }}>
      {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => <Skeleton key={i} height={68} />)}
    </div>
  );
}

function DocsScreen() {
  const t = useT();
  const router = useRouter();
  const routerRef = useRef(router);
  routerRef.current = router;
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<DocFilter>(() => parseDocFilter(params?.get('filter')));
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(() => params?.get('q') ?? '');
  const q = useDebouncedValue(query.trim(), 300);
  const [view, setView] = useState<ViewMode>(() => (readJson<string>('local', VIEW_KEY, 'list') === 'grid' ? 'grid' : 'list'));
  const [counts, setCounts] = useState<DocCounts | null>(null);
  const [reloadToken, setReloadToken] = useState(0);
  const online = useOnlineStatus();
  const currency = useTenantCurrency();

  useEffect(() => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    if (filter !== 'all') p.set('filter', filter);
    if (q) p.set('q', q);
    const s = p.toString();
    routerRef.current.replace(s ? `/app/docs?${s}` : '/app/docs', { scroll: false });
  }, [filter, q]);

  const toggleView = () => setView((v) => {
    const next: ViewMode = v === 'list' ? 'grid' : 'list';
    writeJson('local', VIEW_KEY, next);
    return next;
  });

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '12px 0 24px', color: 'var(--foreground)' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '0 16px' }}>
        <h1 style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 600, margin: 0 }}>{t('common.documents')}</h1>
        <button type="button" onClick={toggleView} style={iconBtn}
          aria-label={view === 'list' ? t('mobile.docs.view_grid') : t('mobile.docs.view_list')}>
          {view === 'list' ? <LayoutGrid style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }} /> : <ListIcon style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }} />}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px 0' }}>
        <AiBanner noCategoryCount={counts?.noCategory ?? 0} online={online} currency={currency} onChanged={() => setReloadToken((n) => n + 1)} />
      </div>

      <FilterChips value={filter} counts={counts} onChange={setFilter} />

      <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, margin: '8px 16px 0', padding: '0 12px', minHeight: 44, borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--background)' }}>
        <Search aria-hidden="true" style={{ width: 16, height: 16, color: 'var(--muted-foreground)' }} />
        <input type="search" value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
          aria-label={t('mobile.docs.search_label')} placeholder={t('mobile.docs.search_placeholder')}
          style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 42, border: 'none', outline: 'none', background: 'transparent', color: 'var(--foreground)', fontSize: 16 }} />
      </label>

      <DocsList key={`${filter}|${q}|${reloadToken}`} filter={filter} q={q} view={view} currency={currency} online={online} onCounts={setCounts} />
    </div>
  );
}

function EmptyForFilter({ filter, searching }: { filter: DocFilter; searching: boolean }) {
  const t = useT();
  if (searching) return <EmptyState title={t('mobile.docs.empty_search_title')} body={t('mobile.docs.empty_search_body')} />;
  const map: Record<DocFilter, [string, string]> = {
    'needs-review': ['mobile.docs.empty_needs_review_title', 'mobile.docs.empty_needs_review_body'],
    'no-category': ['mobile.docs.empty_no_category_title', 'mobile.docs.empty_no_category_body'],
    'no-receipt': ['mobile.docs.empty_no_receipt_title', 'mobile.docs.empty_no_receipt_body'],
    all: ['mobile.docs.empty_all_title', 'mobile.docs.empty_all_body'],
    archived: ['mobile.docs.empty_archived_title', 'mobile.docs.empty_archived_body'],
  };
  const [title, body] = map[filter];
  return (
    <EmptyState title={t(title)} body={t(body)}
      action={filter === 'all' ? <Link href="/app/capture" style={{ ...textBtn, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', textDecoration: 'none' }}>{t('mobile.docs.snap_receipt')}</Link> : undefined} />
  );
}

function DocsList({ filter, q, view, currency, online, onCounts }: {
  filter: DocFilter; q: string; view: ViewMode; currency: string | null; online: boolean; onCounts: (c: DocCounts) => void;
}) {
  const t = useT();
  const locale = useShellLocale();
  const fetchFirst = useCallback(() => listDocs({ filter, q: q || undefined, limit: PAGE_SIZE, withCounts: true }), [filter, q]);
  const { data, error, loading, offline, staleAt, reload } = useMobileData<DocList>(`docs:${filter}:${q}`, fetchFirst);
  const [more, setMore] = useState<MobileDoc[]>([]);
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const [moreError, setMoreError] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!data) return;
    setMore([]);
    setCursor(data.nextCursor);
    if (data.counts) onCounts(data.counts);
  }, [data, onCounts]);

  const items = useMemo(() => {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    return [...(data?.items ?? []), ...more].filter((d) => (seen.has(d.id) ? false : (seen.add(d.id), true)));
  }, [data, more]);

  useEffect(() => { saveDocNav({ ids: items.map((d) => d.id), filter, q }); }, [items, filter, q]);

  const loadMore = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!cursor || loadingMore) return;
    setLoadingMore(true);
    setMoreError(false);
    try {
      const next = await listDocs({ filter, q: q || undefined, cursor, limit: PAGE_SIZE });
      setMore((m) => [...m, ...next.items]);
      setCursor(next.nextCursor);
    } catch {
      setMoreError(true);
    } finally {
      setLoadingMore(false);
    }
  }, [cursor, loadingMore, filter, q]);

  const offlineNow = offline || !online;
  const { sentinelRef, supported } = useInfiniteScroll({ hasMore: !!cursor && !moreError && !offlineNow, loading: loadingMore, onLoadMore: () => void loadMore() });

  if (loading && !data) return <DocsSkeleton />;
  if (error && !data) {
    return (
      <div role="alert" style={{ padding: 16 }}>
        <EmptyState title={t('mobile.docs.error_title')}
          action={<button type="button" style={textBtn} onClick={reload}>{t('mobile.docs.retry')}</button>} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {staleAt ? (
        <p role="status" data-testid="docs-offline" style={notice}>{t('mobile.docs.offline_snapshot', { time: formatTime(staleAt, locale) })}</p>
      ) : offlineNow ? (
        <p role="status" data-testid="docs-offline" style={notice}>{t('mobile.docs.offline_readonly')}</p>
      ) : null}
      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 16 }}><EmptyForFilter filter={filter} searching={!!q} /></div>
      ) : (
        <ul data-testid="doc-list" data-view={view} style={view === 'grid'
          ? { listStyle: 'none', margin: 0, padding: '12px 16px', display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(104px, 1fr))', gap: 8 }
          : { listStyle: 'none', margin: 0, padding: '12px 16px', display: 'grid', gap: 8 }}>
          {items.map((d) => <li key={d.id}><DocItem doc={d} view={view} currency={currency} /></li>)}
        </ul>
      )}
      {cursor && items.length > 0 && (
        <div ref={sentinelRef} style={{ padding: 16, textAlign: 'center' }}>
          {loadingMore ? (
            <span role="status">{t('mobile.docs.loading_more')}</span>
          ) : !supported || moreError ? (
            <button type="button" style={textBtn} onClick={() => void loadMore()}>{t('mobile.docs.load_more')}</button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```
In the offline test, use `screen.getByTestId('docs-offline')` (this page provides that test id): change `expect(screen.getByRole('status', { name: '' })).toHaveTextContent(/Offline|offline/);` to `expect(screen.getByTestId('docs-offline')).toHaveTextContent(/offline/i);` before running.

### Task 4.8: Pinch-zoom receipt image (pointer events, math tested on its own)

**Files**
- Create: `apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/_lib/pinch-zoom.ts`, `apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/_components/PinchZoomImage.tsx`
- Create: `apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/_pointer.ts`
- Test: `apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/pinch-zoom.test.tsx`

**Interfaces**
- Produces: `ZoomState`, `Pt`, `IDENTITY`, `MIN_SCALE = 1`, `MAX_SCALE = 4`, `DOUBLE_TAP_SCALE = 2.5`, `DOUBLE_TAP_MS = 300`, `distance`, `midpoint`, `clampScale`, `clampPan`, `pinch`, `pan`, `toggleDoubleTap`; component `PinchZoomImage({ src, alt, hint })`; test helper `installPointerEvent()`.

**Model.** The rendered transform is `translate(x, y) scale(s)` with the origin at the centre, and every point is measured relative to the container centre. A content point `p` displays at `x + s·p`. A pinch keeps the content point under the starting midpoint pinned under the current midpoint, which gives `x' = mid' − (s'/s)(mid − x)`. Panning is clamped so that the image edges never move inside the viewport: `|x| ≤ (s−1)·W/2`.

```ts
/** jsdom 24 has no PointerEvent: fireEvent.pointerDown falls back to a bare
 *  Event and silently drops clientX/pointerId. MouseEvent keeps coordinates. */
export function installPointerEvent(): void {
  if (typeof window.PointerEvent === 'function') return;
  class FakePointerEvent extends MouseEvent {
    pointerId: number;
    pointerType: string;
    constructor(type: string, init: PointerEventInit = {}) {
      super(type, init);
      this.pointerId = init.pointerId ?? 1;
      this.pointerType = init.pointerType ?? 'touch';
    }
  }
  (window as unknown as { PointerEvent: unknown }).PointerEvent = FakePointerEvent;
}
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeAll, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';
import { IDENTITY, pinch, pan, clampPan, clampScale, toggleDoubleTap, MAX_SCALE } from '@/app/app/docs/_lib/pinch-zoom';
import { PinchZoomImage } from '@/app/app/docs/_components/PinchZoomImage';
import { installPointerEvent } from './_pointer';

const W = 300, H = 400;

describe('pinch-zoom math', () => {
  it('spreading two fingers from 100px to 200px about the centre doubles the scale', () => {
    expect(pinch(IDENTITY, 100, { x: 0, y: 0 }, 200, { x: 0, y: 0 }, W, H)).toEqual({ scale: 2, x: 0, y: 0 });
  });
  it('keeps the content under the gesture midpoint fixed (when not clamped)', () => {
    const start = { scale: 2, x: 0, y: 0 };
    const mid = { x: 40, y: -30 };
    const z = pinch(start, 100, mid, 150, mid, W, H);
    const contentUnderMid = (mid.x - start.x) / start.scale;
    expect(z.x + z.scale * contentUnderMid).toBeCloseTo(mid.x, 6);
  });
  it('clamps scale to [1, 4]', () => {
    expect(pinch(IDENTITY, 100, { x: 0, y: 0 }, 2000, { x: 0, y: 0 }, W, H).scale).toBe(MAX_SCALE);
    expect(pinch({ scale: 2, x: 0, y: 0 }, 200, { x: 0, y: 0 }, 10, { x: 0, y: 0 }, W, H).scale).toBe(1);
    expect(clampScale(0.2)).toBe(1);
  });
  it('clamps panning so the image edge never enters the viewport', () => {
    expect(clampPan({ scale: 2, x: 1000, y: -1000 }, W, H)).toEqual({ scale: 2, x: 150, y: -200 });
  });
  it('one-finger pan is ignored at scale 1 and applied when zoomed', () => {
    expect(pan(IDENTITY, 50, 50, W, H)).toEqual(IDENTITY);
    expect(pan({ scale: 2, x: 0, y: 0 }, 50, -20, W, H)).toEqual({ scale: 2, x: 50, y: -20 });
  });
  it('double-tap zooms to 2.5x around the tapped point, and back to 1x', () => {
    const z = toggleDoubleTap(IDENTITY, { x: 20, y: 10 }, W, H);
    expect(z.scale).toBe(2.5);
    expect(z.x + z.scale * 20).toBeCloseTo(20, 6);
    expect(toggleDoubleTap(z, { x: 0, y: 0 }, W, H)).toEqual(IDENTITY);
  });
});

describe('<PinchZoomImage> pointer handling', () => {
  beforeAll(installPointerEvent);
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.spyOn(HTMLElement.prototype, 'getBoundingClientRect').mockReturnValue({
      left: 0, top: 0, width: W, height: H, right: W, bottom: H, x: 0, y: 0, toJSON: () => ({}),
    } as DOMRect);
  });
  const transform = () => (screen.getByTestId('pinch-zoom-img') as HTMLElement).style.transform;

  it('pinches to 2x with two pointers', () => {
    render(<PinchZoomImage src="https://x/r.jpg" alt="Receipt image" hint="Pinch" />);
    const box = screen.getByTestId('pinch-zoom');
    fireEvent.pointerDown(box, { pointerId: 1, clientX: 100, clientY: 200 });
    fireEvent.pointerDown(box, { pointerId: 2, clientX: 200, clientY: 200 });
    fireEvent.pointerMove(box, { pointerId: 1, clientX: 50, clientY: 200 });
    fireEvent.pointerMove(box, { pointerId: 2, clientX: 250, clientY: 200 });
    expect(transform()).toBe('translate(0px, 0px) scale(2)');
    fireEvent.pointerUp(box, { pointerId: 1, clientX: 50, clientY: 200 });
    fireEvent.pointerUp(box, { pointerId: 2, clientX: 250, clientY: 200 });
    expect(transform()).toBe('translate(0px, 0px) scale(2)');
  });

  it('double-tap toggles 2.5x and back', () => {
    const now = vi.spyOn(Date, 'now');

    const box = screen.getByTestId('pinch-zoom');
    const tap = (t: number) => {
      now.mockReturnValue(t);
      fireEvent.pointerDown(box, { pointerId: 7, clientX: 150, clientY: 200 });
      fireEvent.pointerUp(box, { pointerId: 7, clientX: 150, clientY: 200 });

    tap(1000); tap(1150);
    expect(transform()).toBe('translate(0px, 0px) scale(2.5)');
    tap(5000); tap(5100);
    expect(transform()).toBe('translate(0px, 0px) scale(1)');
  });

  it('two slow taps do not zoom', () => {
    const now = vi.spyOn(Date, 'now');
    render(<PinchZoomImage src="https://x/r.jpg" alt="Receipt image" hint="Pinch" />);
    const box = screen.getByTestId('pinch-zoom');
    for (const t of [1000, 2000]) {
      now.mockReturnValue(t);
      fireEvent.pointerDown(box, { pointerId: 3, clientX: 150, clientY: 200 });
      fireEvent.pointerUp(box, { pointerId: 3, clientX: 150, clientY: 200 });
    }
    expect(transform()).toBe('translate(0px, 0px) scale(1)');
  });

  it('pans when zoomed, clamped to the edges', () => {
    render(<PinchZoomImage src="https://x/r.jpg" alt="Receipt image" hint="Pinch" />);
    const box = screen.getByTestId('pinch-zoom');
    fireEvent.pointerDown(box, { pointerId: 1, clientX: 100, clientY: 200 });
    fireEvent.pointerDown(box, { pointerId: 2, clientX: 200, clientY: 200 });
    fireEvent.pointerMove(box, { pointerId: 1, clientX: 50, clientY: 200 });
    fireEvent.pointerMove(box, { pointerId: 2, clientX: 250, clientY: 200 });
    fireEvent.pointerUp(box, { pointerId: 2, clientX: 250, clientY: 200 });
    fireEvent.pointerMove(box, { pointerId: 1, clientX: 1000, clientY: 200 });
    expect(transform()).toBe('translate(150px, 0px) scale(2)');
  });

  it('exposes the image to assistive tech with its alt text and disables browser gestures', () => {
    render(<PinchZoomImage src="https://x/r.jpg" alt="Receipt image" hint="Pinch" />);
    const box = screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'Receipt image' });
    expect(box.style.touchAction).toBe('none');
  });
});
```

`apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/_lib/pinch-zoom.ts`:
```ts
/** Pure gesture math for the receipt viewer. Points are relative to the container centre. */
export interface Pt { x: number; y: number }
export interface ZoomState { scale: number; x: number; y: number }

export const MIN_SCALE = 1;
export const MAX_SCALE = 4;
export const DOUBLE_TAP_SCALE = 2.5;
export const DOUBLE_TAP_MS = 300;
export const TAP_SLOP_PX = 10;
export const IDENTITY: ZoomState = { scale: 1, x: 0, y: 0 };

export const distance = (a: Pt, b: Pt) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
export const midpoint = (a: Pt, b: Pt): Pt => ({ x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 });
export const clampScale = (s: number) => Math.min(MAX_SCALE, Math.max(MIN_SCALE, s));

const clean = (n: number) => (Object.is(n, -0) ? 0 : n);

export function clampPan(s: ZoomState, w: number, h: number): ZoomState {
  const maxX = ((s.scale - 1) * w) / 2;
  const maxY = ((s.scale - 1) * h) / 2;
  return {
    scale: s.scale,
    x: clean(Math.min(maxX, Math.max(-maxX, s.x))),
    y: clean(Math.min(maxY, Math.max(-maxY, s.y))),
  };
}

export function pinch(start: ZoomState, startDist: number, startMid: Pt, curDist: number, curMid: Pt, w: number, h: number): ZoomState {
  if (startDist <= 0) return start;
  const scale = clampScale(start.scale * (curDist / startDist));
  const k = scale / start.scale;
  return clampPan({ scale, x: curMid.x - k * (startMid.x - start.x), y: curMid.y - k * (startMid.y - start.y) }, w, h);
}

export function pan(start: ZoomState, dx: number, dy: number, w: number, h: number): ZoomState {
  if (start.scale <= MIN_SCALE) return IDENTITY;
  return clampPan({ scale: start.scale, x: start.x + dx, y: start.y + dy }, w, h);
}

export function toggleDoubleTap(s: ZoomState, at: Pt, w: number, h: number): ZoomState {
  if (s.scale > MIN_SCALE) return IDENTITY;
  return clampPan({ scale: DOUBLE_TAP_SCALE, x: -at.x * (DOUBLE_TAP_SCALE - 1), y: -at.y * (DOUBLE_TAP_SCALE - 1) }, w, h);
}
```

`apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/_components/PinchZoomImage.tsx`:
```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  IDENTITY, DOUBLE_TAP_MS, TAP_SLOP_PX, distance, midpoint, pinch, pan, toggleDoubleTap, type Pt, type ZoomState,
} from '../_lib/pinch-zoom';

function usePrefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  const [reduced, setReduced] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') return;
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    setReduced(mq.matches);
    const on = () => setReduced(mq.matches);
    mq.addEventListener?.('change', on);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener?.('change', on);
  }, []);
  return reduced;
}

export function PinchZoomImage({ src, alt, hint }: { src: string; alt: string; hint: string }) {
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pointers = useRef(new Map<number, Pt>());
  const downAt = useRef(new Map<number, Pt>());
  const gesture = useRef<{ start: ZoomState; startDist: number; startMid: Pt; panFrom: Pt | null } | null>(null);
  const lastTap = useRef<{ t: number; p: Pt } | null>(null);
  const [z, setZ] = useState<ZoomState>(IDENTITY);
  const zRef = useRef(z);
  zRef.current = z;
  const [active, setActive] = useState(false);
  const reduced = usePrefersReducedMotion();

  const size = () => {
    const r = boxRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { w: r?.width || 1, h: r?.height || 1, left: r?.left ?? 0, top: r?.top ?? 0 };
  };
  const rel = (e: React.PointerEvent | React.MouseEvent): Pt => {
    const { w, h, left, top } = size();
    return { x: e.clientX - left - w / 2, y: e.clientY - top - h / 2 };
  };
  const begin = () => {
    const pts = [...pointers.current.values()];
    if (pts.length >= 2) gesture.current = { start: zRef.current, startDist: distance(pts[0], pts[1]), startMid: midpoint(pts[0], pts[1]), panFrom: null };
    else if (pts.length === 1) gesture.current = { start: zRef.current, startDist: 0, startMid: pts[0], panFrom: pts[0] };
    else gesture.current = null;
  };

  const onPointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
    const p = rel(e);
    pointers.current.set(e.pointerId, p);
    downAt.current.set(e.pointerId, p);
    setActive(true);
    begin();
  };
  const onPointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!pointers.current.has(e.pointerId)) return;
    pointers.current.set(e.pointerId, rel(e));
    const g = gesture.current;
    if (!g) return;
    const { w, h } = size();
    const pts = [...pointers.current.values()];
    if (pts.length >= 2 && g.startDist > 0) setZ(pinch(g.start, g.startDist, g.startMid, distance(pts[0], pts[1]), midpoint(pts[0], pts[1]), w, h));
    else if (pts.length === 1 && g.panFrom) setZ(pan(g.start, pts[0].x - g.panFrom.x, pts[0].y - g.panFrom.y, w, h));
  };
  const onPointerEnd = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const down = downAt.current.get(e.pointerId);
    const wasSingle = pointers.current.size === 1;
    pointers.current.delete(e.pointerId);
    downAt.current.delete(e.pointerId);
    if (e.type === 'pointerup' && wasSingle && down) {
      const up = rel(e);
      if (distance(down, up) < TAP_SLOP_PX) {
        const now = Date.now();
        const prev = lastTap.current;
        if (prev && now - prev.t < DOUBLE_TAP_MS && distance(prev.p, up) < 30) {
          const { w, h } = size();
          setZ(toggleDoubleTap(zRef.current, up, w, h));
          lastTap.current = null;
        } else {
          lastTap.current = { t: now, p: up };
        }
      }
    }
    if (pointers.current.size === 0) setActive(false);
    begin();
  };
  const onDoubleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    // Mouse users (desktop testing, tablets with trackpads) get the same toggle.
    if (e.detail === 0) return;
    const { w, h } = size();
    setZ(toggleDoubleTap(zRef.current, rel(e), w, h));
  };

  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} data-testid="pinch-zoom" role="img" aria-label={alt}
      onPointerDown={onPointerDown} onPointerMove={onPointerMove} onPointerUp={onPointerEnd} onPointerCancel={onPointerEnd}
      onDoubleClick={onDoubleClick}
      style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: 'min(60dvh, 480px)', overflow: 'hidden', touchAction: 'none', borderRadius: 12, background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img src={src} alt="" draggable={false} data-testid="pinch-zoom-img"
        style={{
          width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'contain', userSelect: 'none', pointerEvents: 'none',
          transform: `translate(${z.x}px, ${z.y}px) scale(${z.scale})`, transformOrigin: 'center center',
          transition: reduced || active ? 'none' : 'transform 150ms ease-out',
        }} />
      {z.scale === 1 && (
        <span style={{ position: 'absolute', bottom: 8, left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', fontSize: 12, padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 999, background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)', color: '#fff' }}>
          {hint}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useT } from '@/hooks/use-t';
import type { ExpenseCategory } from '@/lib/mobile/types';
import { listExpenseCategories } from '../../_lib/api';
import { getRecentCategories, orderWithRecents } from '../../_lib/category-recents';
import { Sheet, Skeleton } from '../../_kit';

const option = (selected: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
  width: '100%', minHeight: 44, textAlign: 'left', padding: '10px 12px', borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 15,
  border: `1px solid ${selected ? 'var(--primary)' : 'var(--border)'}`, background: 'var(--card)', color: 'var(--foreground)',
});
const heading: React.CSSProperties = { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, textTransform: 'uppercase', color: 'var(--muted-foreground)', margin: '12px 0 6px' };

export function CategoryPicker({ open, onClose, onSelect, currentId }: {
  open: boolean; onClose: () => void; onSelect: (c: ExpenseCategory) => void; currentId: string | null;
}) {
  const t = useT();
  const [all, setAll] = useState<ExpenseCategory[] | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || all) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    setFailed(false);
    listExpenseCategories()
      .then((r) => { if (!cancelled) setAll(r); })
      .catch(() => { if (!cancelled) setFailed(true); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [open, all, attempt]);

  const recents = useMemo(() => (open ? getRecentCategories() : []), [open]);
  const { recent, rest } = useMemo(() => orderWithRecents(all ?? [], recents), [all, recents]);
  // When the list cannot load (offline), recents are still real accounts the user picked before.
  const recentOptions: ExpenseCategory[] = all ? recent : recents.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, name: r.name, code: '' }));
  const needle = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const match = (c: ExpenseCategory) => !needle || c.name.toLowerCase().includes(needle) || c.code.toLowerCase().includes(needle);

  const renderOption = (c: ExpenseCategory) => (
    <li key={c.id}>
      <button type="button" data-testid="category-option" data-category-id={c.id} aria-pressed={c.id === currentId}
        style={option(c.id === currentId)} onClick={() => onSelect(c)}>{c.name}</button>
    </li>
  );

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onClose={onClose} title={t('mobile.docs.choose_category')}>
      <input type="search" value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
        aria-label={t('mobile.docs.category_search')} placeholder={t('mobile.docs.category_search')}
        style={{ width: '100%', minHeight: 44, padding: '0 12px', borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--background)', color: 'var(--foreground)', fontSize: 16 }} />
      {failed && (
        <p role="alert" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
          {t('mobile.docs.categories_failed')}
          <button type="button" style={{ minHeight: 44, padding: '0 12px', borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--card)', color: 'var(--foreground)' }}
            onClick={() => { setAll(null); setAttempt((n) => n + 1); }}>{t('mobile.docs.retry')}</button>
        </p>
      )}
      {recentOptions.filter(match).length > 0 && (
        <section>
          <h3 style={heading}>{t('mobile.docs.recent_categories')}</h3>
          <ul style={{ listStyle: 'none', margin: 0, padding: 0, display: 'grid', gap: 6 }}>{recentOptions.filter(match).map(renderOption)}</ul>
        </section>
      )}
      {!all && !failed && <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}><Skeleton height={44} /></div>}
      {all && (
        <section>
          <h3 style={heading}>{t('mobile.docs.all_categories')}</h3>
          <ul style={{ listStyle: 'none', margin: 0, padding: 0, display: 'grid', gap: 6 }}>{rest.filter(match).map(renderOption)}</ul>
        </section>
      )}
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

### Task 4.10: Viewer `/app/docs/[id]`: edit, AI accept, categorize, archive/restore, delete, prev/next

**Files**
- Create: `apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/_lib/edit-form.ts`, `apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/[id]/page.tsx`
- Test: `apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/doc-edit-form.test.ts`, `apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/doc-viewer.test.tsx`

**Interfaces**
- Consumes: `getDoc, patchDoc, categorizeDoc, archiveDoc, unarchiveDoc, deleteDoc` (api.ts); `confirmDoc, getPendingSuggestions` (api-extra); `parseAmountToCents` from `@agentbook/i18n`; Tasks 4.2/4.8/4.9; kit `Sheet, Pill, Skeleton, EmptyState, useToast`.
- Produces: `FormState`, `toForm(doc, locale)`, `diffForm(doc, form, locale): { body: PatchBody; error: { key: string; params?: Record<string,string> } | null }`, `isDirty(doc, form, locale)`; route `/app/docs/[id]`.

**Behaviour.** Edits, categorize, archive/restore and mark-reviewed are optimistic and roll back on failure, with a toast. Delete is destructive, so it waits for the server and is not optimistic. A failed Save restores the displayed figures but keeps the user's typed values so Retry is one tap. "Mark as reviewed" is enabled only when the doc has a category, because `confirm` posts no journal entry for an uncategorized expense (see Task 4.3). An uncategorized doc with no AI suggestion opens the picker automatically (spec §4.3), but only after the pending-suggestion check has finished, so the picker never covers a suggestion that is about to arrive.

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { toForm, diffForm, isDirty } from '@/app/app/docs/_lib/edit-form';
import type { MobileDoc } from '@/lib/mobile/types';

const doc: MobileDoc = {
  id: 'e1', date: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z', amountCents: 4700, vendorName: 'Blue Bottle', description: 'Client coffee',
  categoryId: null, categoryName: null, categorySource: null, confidence: null, status: 'confirmed', isPersonal: false,
  receiptUrl: null, receiptStatus: null, archivedAt: null, suggestion: null,
};

describe('edit form', () => {
  it('starts from the doc in the user locale', () => {
    expect(toForm(doc, 'en')).toEqual({ amount: '47.00', vendor: 'Blue Bottle', date: '2026-10-01', description: 'Client coffee', isPersonal: false });
    expect(toForm(doc, 'fr-CA').amount).toBe('47,00');
  });
  it('is clean until something changes', () => {
    expect(isDirty(doc, toForm(doc, 'en'), 'en')).toBe(false);
    expect(isDirty(doc, { ...toForm(doc, 'en'), vendor: 'Blue Bottle Coffee' }, 'en')).toBe(true);
  });
  it('sends only changed fields', () => {
    const r = diffForm(doc, { ...toForm(doc, 'en'), amount: '52.50', isPersonal: true }, 'en');
    expect(r).toEqual({ body: { amountCents: 5250, isPersonal: true }, error: null });
  });
  it('parses the locale decimal comma', () => {
    expect(diffForm(doc, { ...toForm(doc, 'fr-CA'), amount: '52,50' }, 'fr-CA').body).toEqual({ amountCents: 5250 });
  });
  it('rejects non-numbers and non-positive amounts', () => {
    expect(diffForm(doc, { ...toForm(doc, 'en'), amount: 'abc' }, 'en').error).toEqual({ key: 'mobile.docs.amount_invalid' });
    expect(diffForm(doc, { ...toForm(doc, 'en'), amount: '0' }, 'en').error).toEqual({ key: 'mobile.docs.amount_invalid' });
  });
  it('never sends an empty vendor (it cannot clear one)', () => {
    expect(diffForm(doc, { ...toForm(doc, 'en'), vendor: '   ' }, 'en').body).toEqual({});
  });
  it('sends date and description changes', () => {
    expect(diffForm(doc, { ...toForm(doc, 'en'), date: '2026-09-30', description: 'Team lunch' }, 'en').body)
      .toEqual({ date: '2026-09-30', description: 'Team lunch' });
  });
});
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';

import type { MobileDoc } from '@/lib/mobile/types';
import { ToastHost } from '@/app/app/_kit';
import { RECENTS_KEY } from '@/app/app/_lib/category-recents';

vi.mock('@/hooks/use-t', async () => (await import('./_i18n-mock')).useTMock);
const nav = vi.hoisted(() => ({ id: 'e2', push: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock('next/navigation', () => ({
  useRouter: () => ({ push: nav.push, replace: vi.fn(), prefetch: vi.fn(), back: vi.fn(), forward: vi.fn() }),
  useParams: () => ({ id: nav.id }),
  useSearchParams: () => new URLSearchParams(),
  usePathname: () => `/app/docs/${nav.id}`,
}));
const api = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  getDoc: vi.fn(), patchDoc: vi.fn(), categorizeDoc: vi.fn(), archiveDoc: vi.fn(), unarchiveDoc: vi.fn(),
  deleteDoc: vi.fn(), listExpenseCategories: vi.fn(),
}));
vi.mock('@/app/app/_lib/api', async (orig) => ({ ...(await orig<object>()), ...api }));
const extra = vi.hoisted(() => ({ getPendingSuggestions: vi.fn(), getTenantCurrency: vi.fn(), confirmDoc: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock('@/app/app/_lib/api-extra', async (orig) => ({ ...(await orig<object>()), ...extra }));

import DocViewerPage from '@/app/app/docs/[id]/page';

const base = (o: Partial<MobileDoc> = {}): MobileDoc => ({
  id: 'e2', date: '2026-10-01', amountCents: 4700, vendorName: 'Blue Bottle', description: null,
  categoryId: 'c1', categoryName: 'Meals', categorySource: 'user', confidence: null, status: 'confirmed',
  isPersonal: false, receiptUrl: null, receiptStatus: 'pending', archivedAt: null, suggestion: null, ...o,
});
const CAD = (c: number) => formatCurrencyCents(c, 'CAD');
const renderViewer = () => render(<ToastHost><DocViewerPage /></ToastHost>);
const setOnline = (v: boolean) => Object.defineProperty(window.navigator, 'onLine', { configurable: true, get: () => v });

beforeEach(() => {
  localStorage.clear(); sessionStorage.clear(); setOnline(true); nav.id = 'e2';
  Object.values(api).forEach((f) => f.mockReset());
  nav.push.mockReset();
  extra.getPendingSuggestions.mockResolvedValue({ items: [], uncategorizedCount: 0 });
  extra.getTenantCurrency.mockResolvedValue('CAD');
  extra.confirmDoc.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
  api.listExpenseCategories.mockResolvedValue([{ id: 'c1', name: 'Meals', code: '5200' }, { id: 'c5', name: 'Travel', code: '5100' }]);
});

describe('viewer — display', () => {
  it('shows vendor, tenant-currency amount, category and the AI pill for AI-categorized docs', async () => {
    api.getDoc.mockResolvedValue(base({ categorySource: 'ai' }));
    renderViewer();
    expect(await screen.findByTestId('doc-amount')).toHaveTextContent(CAD(4700));
    expect(screen.getByText('Blue Bottle')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('doc-category')).toHaveTextContent('Meals');
    expect(within(screen.getByTestId('doc-category')).getByText('AI')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('shows the receipt in a pinch-zoom viewer, a PDF link for PDFs, and a static tile when none', async () => {
    api.getDoc.mockResolvedValueOnce(base({ receiptUrl: 'https://a.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/r/1.jpg' }));
    const { unmount } = renderViewer();
    expect(await screen.findByRole('img', { name: 'Receipt image' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    unmount();
    api.getDoc.mockResolvedValueOnce(base({ receiptUrl: 'https://a.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/r/1.pdf' }));
    const second = renderViewer();
    expect(await screen.findByRole('link', { name: 'Open the PDF receipt' })).toHaveAttribute('href', 'https://a.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/r/1.pdf');
    second.unmount();
    api.getDoc.mockResolvedValueOnce(base());
    renderViewer();
    expect(await screen.findByTestId('no-receipt-tile')).toHaveTextContent('No receipt attached');
  });
  it('shows "no longer exists" for a 404', async () => {
    api.getDoc.mockRejectedValue(Object.assign(new Error('Expense not found'), { status: 404 }));
    renderViewer();
    expect(await screen.findByText('This document no longer exists.')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('shows a retryable error for other failures', async () => {
    api.getDoc.mockRejectedValueOnce(Object.assign(new Error('boom'), { status: 500 })).mockResolvedValueOnce(base());
    renderViewer();
    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' }));
    expect(await screen.findByTestId('doc-amount')).toHaveTextContent(CAD(4700));
  });
  it('links prev/next across the saved filtered list', async () => {
    sessionStorage.setItem('ab:mobile:docs:nav', JSON.stringify({ ids: ['e1', 'e2', 'e3'], filter: 'no-receipt', q: '' }));
    api.getDoc.mockResolvedValue(base());
    renderViewer();
    await screen.findByTestId('doc-amount');
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Previous document' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/app/docs/e1');
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Next document' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/app/docs/e3');
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Back to documents' })).toHaveAttribute('href', '/app/docs?filter=no-receipt');
  });
});

describe('viewer — booked expenses are amount/date-locked', () => {
```
