```tsx
    api.getDoc.mockResolvedValue(base({ status: 'confirmed' }));
    renderViewer();
    await screen.findByTestId('doc-amount');
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Amount')).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Date')).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('booked-lock')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Vendor')).toBeEnabled();
  });
  it('keeps Amount and Date editable (and shows no lock note) while the expense is still pending review', async () => {
    api.getDoc.mockResolvedValue(base({ status: 'pending_review' }));
    renderViewer();
    await screen.findByTestId('doc-amount');
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Amount')).toBeEnabled();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Date')).toBeEnabled();
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('booked-lock')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('viewer — editing', () => {
  it('Save is disabled until dirty, then PATCHes only the change and shows the server result', async () => {
    api.getDoc.mockResolvedValue(base({ status: 'pending_review' }));
    api.patchDoc.mockResolvedValue(base({ amountCents: 5250 }));
    renderViewer();
    await screen.findByTestId('doc-amount');
```

`apps/web-next/src/app/app/docs/_lib/edit-form.ts`:
```ts
import { parseAmountToCents } from '@agentbook/i18n';
import type { MobileDoc } from '@/lib/mobile/types';
import { formatAmountInput } from '../../_lib/format';

export interface FormState { amount: string; vendor: string; date: string; description: string; isPersonal: boolean }
export type PatchBody = Partial<{ amountCents: number; vendor: string; date: string; description: string; isPersonal: boolean }>;
export interface FormError { key: string; params?: Record<string, string> }

export function toForm(doc: MobileDoc, locale: string): FormState {
  return {
    amount: formatAmountInput(doc.amountCents, locale),
    vendor: doc.vendorName ?? '',
    date: (doc.date ?? '').slice(0, 10),
    description: doc.description ?? '',
    isPersonal: doc.isPersonal,
  };
}

export function isDirty(doc: MobileDoc, form: FormState, locale: string): boolean {
  const a = toForm(doc, locale);
  return a.amount !== form.amount.trim() || a.vendor !== form.vendor.trim() || a.date !== form.date
    || a.description !== form.description.trim() || a.isPersonal !== form.isPersonal;
}

export function diffForm(doc: MobileDoc, form: FormState, locale: string): { body: PatchBody; error: FormError | null } {
  const initial = toForm(doc, locale);
  const body: PatchBody = {};
  if (form.amount.trim() !== initial.amount) {
    const parsed = parseAmountToCents(form.amount, locale);
    if (!parsed.ok || parsed.cents <= 0) return { body: {}, error: { key: 'mobile.docs.amount_invalid' } };
    if (parsed.ambiguous) return { body: {}, error: { key: 'mobile.docs.amount_ambiguous', params: { formatted: parsed.formatted } } };
    if (parsed.cents !== doc.amountCents) body.amountCents = parsed.cents;
  }
  const vendor = form.vendor.trim();
  if (vendor && vendor !== (doc.vendorName ?? '')) body.vendor = vendor;
  if (form.date && form.date !== initial.date) body.date = form.date;
  const description = form.description.trim();
  if (description !== (doc.description ?? '')) body.description = description;
  if (form.isPersonal !== doc.isPersonal) body.isPersonal = form.isPersonal;
  return { body, error: null };
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ArrowLeft, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ImageOff, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { useT, useShellLocale } from '@/hooks/use-t';
import type { MobileDoc } from '@/lib/mobile/types';
import { getDoc, patchDoc, categorizeDoc, archiveDoc, unarchiveDoc, deleteDoc } from '../../_lib/api';
import { confirmDoc, getPendingSuggestions } from '../../_lib/api-extra';
import { useMobileData } from '../../_lib/useMobileData';
import { useOnlineStatus } from '../../_lib/useOnlineStatus';
import { useTenantCurrency } from '../../_lib/useTenantCurrency';
import { readDocNav, neighbors, docsHref, removeFromDocNav } from '../../_lib/doc-nav';
import { pushRecentCategory } from '../../_lib/category-recents';
import { isPdfUrl, formatTime } from '../../_lib/format';
import { Sheet, Pill, Skeleton, EmptyState, useToast } from '../../_kit';
import { PinchZoomImage } from '../_components/PinchZoomImage';
import { CategoryPicker } from '../_components/CategoryPicker';
import { Amount } from '../_components/Amount';
import { toForm, diffForm, isDirty, type FormState } from '../_lib/edit-form';

const btn: React.CSSProperties = { minHeight: 44, padding: '0 14px', borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--card)', color: 'var(--foreground)', fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 500 };
const primary: React.CSSProperties = { ...btn, background: 'var(--primary)', color: 'var(--primary-foreground, #04130c)', border: 'none', fontWeight: 600 };
const danger: React.CSSProperties = { ...btn, color: 'var(--destructive, #ef4444)', borderColor: 'var(--destructive, #ef4444)' };
const iconLink: React.CSSProperties = { minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', borderRadius: 10, color: 'var(--foreground)' };
const field: React.CSSProperties = { width: '100%', minHeight: 44, padding: '10px 12px', borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--background)', color: 'var(--foreground)', fontSize: 16 };
const label: React.CSSProperties = { display: 'grid', gap: 4, fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted-foreground)' };
const note: React.CSSProperties = { margin: '8px 0', padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 13, background: 'var(--muted, rgba(127,127,127,0.14))', color: 'var(--foreground)' };

export default function DocViewerPage() {
  const params = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const id = typeof params?.id === 'string' ? params.id : '';
  return <DocViewer key={id} id={id} />;
}

type Busy = null | 'categorize' | 'archive' | 'delete' | 'confirm';

function DocViewer({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const t = useT();
  const locale = useShellLocale();
  const router = useRouter();
  const toast = useToast();
  const online = useOnlineStatus();
  const currency = useTenantCurrency();
  const fetchDoc = useCallback(() => getDoc(id), [id]);
  const { data, error, loading, staleAt, reload } = useMobileData<MobileDoc>(`doc:${id}`, fetchDoc);

  const [doc, setDoc] = useState<MobileDoc | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState | null>(null);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<Busy>(null);
  const [pickerOpen, setPickerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleteOpen, setDeleteOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pendingSuggestion, setPendingSuggestion] = useState<MobileDoc['suggestion']>(null);
  const [suggestionChecked, setSuggestionChecked] = useState(false);
  const autoOpened = useRef(false);

  const nav = useMemo(() => readDocNav(), []);
  const { prev, next } = neighbors(nav, id);
  const backHref = docsHref(nav);
  const readOnly = !online || !!staleAt;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!data) return;
    setDoc(data);
    setForm(toForm(data, locale));
  }, [data, locale]);

  const docId = doc?.id ?? null;
  const hasOwnSuggestion = !!doc?.suggestion;
  const categoryId = doc?.categoryId ?? null;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!docId) return;
    if (hasOwnSuggestion || categoryId || !online) { setSuggestionChecked(true); return; }
    let cancelled = false;
    getPendingSuggestions()
      .then((r) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const s = r.items.find((i) => i.expenseId === docId);
        if (s) setPendingSuggestion({ categoryId: s.suggestedCategoryId, categoryName: s.suggestedCategoryName, confidence: s.confidence });
      })
      .catch(() => { /* no suggestion is a valid state */ })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setSuggestionChecked(true); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [docId, hasOwnSuggestion, categoryId, online]);

  const suggestion = doc?.suggestion ?? pendingSuggestion;
  const showSuggestion = !!suggestion && suggestion.categoryId !== doc?.categoryId;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!doc || autoOpened.current || readOnly || !suggestionChecked) return;
    if (!doc.categoryId && !suggestion && !doc.archivedAt) {
      autoOpened.current = true;
      setPickerOpen(true);
    }
  }, [doc, suggestion, suggestionChecked, readOnly]);

  if (!doc || !form) {
    if (loading || (!error && !data)) {
      return <div aria-busy="true" style={{ padding: 16, display: 'grid', gap: 12 }}><Skeleton height={44} /><Skeleton height={240} /><Skeleton height={44} /></div>;
    }
    const status = (error as { status?: number } | null)?.status;
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: 16 }}>
        <Link href={backHref} aria-label={t('mobile.docs.back')} style={iconLink}><ArrowLeft style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }} /></Link>
        {status === 404 ? (
          <EmptyState title={t('mobile.docs.not_found')} />
        ) : (
          <div role="alert"><EmptyState title={t('mobile.docs.load_failed')} action={<button type="button" style={btn} onClick={reload}>{t('mobile.docs.retry')}</button>} /></div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  const current = doc;
  const dirty = isDirty(current, form, locale);
  const set = <K extends keyof FormState>(k: K, v: FormState[K]) => setForm((f) => (f ? { ...f, [k]: v } : f));

  async function save() {
    const { body, error: err } = diffForm(current, form!, locale);
    if (err) { setFormError(t(err.key, err.params)); return; }
    setFormError(null);
    if (Object.keys(body).length === 0) return;
    const before = current;
    setDoc({
      ...current,
      ...(body.amountCents !== undefined ? { amountCents: body.amountCents } : {}),
      ...(body.vendor !== undefined ? { vendorName: body.vendor } : {}),
      ...(body.date !== undefined ? { date: body.date } : {}),
      ...(body.description !== undefined ? { description: body.description } : {}),
      ...(body.isPersonal !== undefined ? { isPersonal: body.isPersonal } : {}),
    });
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const server = await patchDoc(current.id, body);
      setDoc(server);
      setForm(toForm(server, locale));
      toast.show(t('mobile.docs.saved'), 'good');
    } catch {
      setDoc(before);   // figures go back; the typed values stay so Retry is one tap
      toast.show(t('mobile.docs.save_failed'), 'critical');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function applyCategory(cat: { id: string; name: string }, source: 'ai' | 'user') {
    setPickerOpen(false);
    const before = current;
    setDoc({ ...current, categoryId: cat.id, categoryName: cat.name, categorySource: source, suggestion: null });
    setBusy('categorize');
    try {
      const server = await categorizeDoc(current.id, cat.id);
      setDoc(server);
      setPendingSuggestion(null);
      pushRecentCategory({ id: cat.id, name: cat.name });
      toast.show(t('mobile.docs.categorized'), 'good');
    } catch {
      setDoc(before);
      toast.show(t('mobile.docs.categorize_failed'), 'critical');
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  async function toggleArchive() {
    const before = current;
    const archiving = !current.archivedAt;
    setDoc({ ...current, archivedAt: archiving ? new Date().toISOString() : null });
    setBusy('archive');
    try {
      const r = archiving ? await archiveDoc(current.id) : await unarchiveDoc(current.id);
      setDoc((d) => (d ? { ...d, archivedAt: r.archivedAt } : d));
      toast.show(t(archiving ? 'mobile.docs.archived_toast' : 'mobile.docs.restored_toast'), 'good');
    } catch {
      setDoc(before);
      toast.show(t(archiving ? 'mobile.docs.archive_failed' : 'mobile.docs.restore_failed'), 'critical');
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  async function markReviewed() {
    if (!current.categoryId) return;
    const before = current;
    setDoc({ ...current, status: 'confirmed' });
    setBusy('confirm');
    try {
      await confirmDoc(current.id);
      toast.show(t('mobile.docs.reviewed'), 'good');
    } catch {
      setDoc(before);
      toast.show(t('mobile.docs.save_failed'), 'critical');
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  async function confirmDelete() {
    setBusy('delete');
    try {
      await deleteDoc(current.id);
      removeFromDocNav(current.id);
      setDeleteOpen(false);
      toast.show(t('mobile.docs.deleted_toast'), 'good');
      router.push(next ? `/app/docs/${next}` : backHref);
    } catch {
      toast.show(t('mobile.docs.delete_failed'), 'critical');
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  const title = current.vendorName || current.description || t('mobile.docs.untitled');
  const disabled = readOnly || busy !== null;
  // A confirmed expense is already booked to the ledger. PUT /expenses/[id] does not re-post the journal entry
  // when amount/date change (pre-existing, also true on desktop), so the viewer must not offer those edits on
  // booked rows or P&L and the tax estimate would silently disagree with what the user sees.
  const amountDateLocked = current.status === 'confirmed';

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '8px 16px 32px', color: 'var(--foreground)', display: 'grid', gap: 12 }}>
      <nav aria-label={t('mobile.docs.nav_label')} style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <Link href={backHref} aria-label={t('mobile.docs.back')} style={iconLink}><ArrowLeft style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }} /></Link>
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
          {prev ? <Link href={`/app/docs/${prev}`} aria-label={t('mobile.docs.prev')} style={iconLink}><ChevronLeft style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }} /></Link> : <span style={{ width: 44 }} />}
          {next ? <Link href={`/app/docs/${next}`} aria-label={t('mobile.docs.next')} style={iconLink}><ChevronRight style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }} /></Link> : <span style={{ width: 44 }} />}
        </span>
      </nav>

      <header style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 4 }}>
        <span style={{ fontSize: 14, color: 'var(--muted-foreground)' }}>{title}</span>
        <span data-testid="doc-amount" style={{ fontSize: 28, fontWeight: 600 }}><Amount cents={current.amountCents} currency={currency} /></span>
        <span style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {current.status === 'pending_review' && <Pill tone="warn">{t('mobile.docs.needs_review_banner')}</Pill>}
          {current.archivedAt && <Pill tone="neutral">{t('mobile.docs.archived_pill')}</Pill>}
        </span>
      </header>

      {staleAt ? <p role="status" style={note}>{t('mobile.docs.offline_snapshot', { time: formatTime(staleAt, locale) })}</p>
        : !online ? <p role="status" style={note}>{t('mobile.docs.offline_readonly')}</p> : null}
      {current.archivedAt && <p role="status" style={note}>{t('mobile.docs.archived_banner')}</p>}

      {current.receiptUrl ? (
        isPdfUrl(current.receiptUrl) ? (
          <a href={current.receiptUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" style={{ ...btn, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', textDecoration: 'none' }}>{t('mobile.docs.open_pdf')}</a>
        ) : (
          <PinchZoomImage src={current.receiptUrl} alt={t('mobile.docs.receipt_alt')} hint={t('mobile.docs.zoom_hint')} />
        )
      ) : (
        <div data-testid="no-receipt-tile" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 8, minHeight: 96, borderRadius: 12, border: '1px dashed var(--border)', color: 'var(--muted-foreground)' }}>
          <ImageOff aria-hidden="true" style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }} /> {t('mobile.docs.no_receipt_tile')}
        </div>
      )}

      {showSuggestion && suggestion && (
        <div data-testid="ai-suggestion" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', padding: 12, borderRadius: 12, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--card)' }}>
          <Sparkles aria-hidden="true" style={{ width: 16, height: 16 }} />
          <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{t('mobile.docs.suggested', { category: suggestion.categoryName })}</span>
          <Pill tone="info">{t('mobile.docs.confidence', { pct: Math.round(suggestion.confidence * 100) })}</Pill>
          <button type="button" style={primary} disabled={disabled}
            onClick={() => void applyCategory({ id: suggestion.categoryId, name: suggestion.categoryName }, 'ai')}>
            {t('mobile.docs.accept')}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={label}>
        <span>{t('mobile.docs.field_category')}</span>
        <div data-testid="doc-category" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: 16, color: 'var(--foreground)' }}>{current.categoryName ?? t('mobile.docs.no_category')}</span>
          {current.categorySource === 'ai' && <Pill tone="info">{t('mobile.docs.ai_pill')}</Pill>}
          <button type="button" style={{ ...btn, marginLeft: 'auto' }} disabled={disabled} onClick={() => setPickerOpen(true)}>
            {t('mobile.docs.change_category')}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <label style={label}>{t('mobile.docs.field_amount')}
        <input style={field} inputMode="decimal" value={form.amount} disabled={readOnly || amountDateLocked} onChange={(e) => set('amount', e.target.value)} />
      </label>
      <label style={label}>{t('mobile.docs.field_vendor')}
        <input style={field} value={form.vendor} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(e) => set('vendor', e.target.value)} />
      </label>
      <label style={label}>{t('mobile.docs.field_date')}
        <input style={field} type="date" value={form.date} disabled={readOnly || amountDateLocked} onChange={(e) => set('date', e.target.value)} />
      </label>
      {amountDateLocked && <p data-testid="booked-lock" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 12, color: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }}>{t('mobile.docs.booked_locked')}</p>}
      <label style={label}>{t('mobile.docs.field_description')}
        <textarea style={{ ...field, minHeight: 72 }} value={form.description} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(e) => set('description', e.target.value)} />
      </label>
      <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, minHeight: 44 }}>
        <input type="checkbox" checked={form.isPersonal} disabled={readOnly} onChange={(e) => set('isPersonal', e.target.checked)} style={{ width: 22, height: 22 }} />
        {t('mobile.docs.personal_toggle')}
      </label>
      {formError && <p role="alert" style={{ color: 'var(--destructive, #ef4444)', fontSize: 13, margin: 0 }}>{formError}</p>}
      <button type="button" style={primary} disabled={!dirty || saving || readOnly} onClick={() => void save()}>
        {saving ? t('mobile.docs.saving') : t('mobile.docs.save')}
      </button>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        {current.status === 'pending_review' && (
          <>
            <button type="button" style={btn} disabled={disabled || !current.categoryId} onClick={() => void markReviewed()}>{t('mobile.docs.mark_reviewed')}</button>
            {!current.categoryId && <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted-foreground)', margin: 0, flexBasis: '100%' }}>{t('mobile.docs.review_needs_category')}</p>}
          </>
        )}
        <button type="button" style={btn} disabled={disabled} onClick={() => void toggleArchive()}>
          {current.archivedAt ? t('mobile.docs.restore') : t('mobile.docs.archive')}
        </button>
        <button type="button" style={danger} disabled={disabled} onClick={() => setDeleteOpen(true)}>{t('mobile.docs.delete')}</button>
      </div>

      <CategoryPicker open={pickerOpen} onClose={() => setPickerOpen(false)} currentId={current.categoryId}
        onSelect={(c) => void applyCategory(c, 'user')} />

      <Sheet open={deleteOpen} onClose={() => setDeleteOpen(false)} title={t('mobile.docs.delete_title')}>
        <p style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>{t('mobile.docs.delete_body')}</p>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
          <button type="button" style={btn} onClick={() => setDeleteOpen(false)}>{t('mobile.docs.cancel')}</button>
          <button type="button" style={{ ...danger, fontWeight: 600 }} disabled={busy === 'delete'} onClick={() => void confirmDelete()}>{t('mobile.docs.delete_confirm')}</button>
        </div>
      </Sheet>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Task 4.11: E2E `docs.spec.ts`, persona journeys and the totals invariant

**Files**
- Create: `tests/e2e/mobile-app/fixtures.ts`, `tests/e2e/mobile-app/docs.spec.ts`
- Modify: `tests/e2e/nightly/phase9-pwa.spec.ts`. The current `'Documents'` assertion still holds; append a rendered-content check for the chips, see Step 3.

**Interfaces**
- Consumes: `MOBILE_VIEWPORT, loginAs, settle` (`tests/e2e/mobile-app/helpers.ts`, PR 2); `api, expectOk` (`tests/e2e/nightly/helpers/api.ts`, in-page fetch carrying the httpOnly cookie).
- Produces: `fixtures.ts` exports `Persona, PERSONA_CURRENCY, runTag, randomWholeDollars, moneyRegex, todayIso, makeReceiptJpeg, createExpense, createReceiptExpense, deleteExpenseQuietly, countByQuery, totalsSnapshot`, which PR 5 reuses.

**Determinism.** The AI-suggestion journey cannot depend on Gemini returning a medium-confidence pick. Low/medium/high routing makes that nondeterministic, and the user-triggered run is deduped for 20 h. So the test intercepts only the **read** `GET …/auto-categorize/pending` to inject one suggestion for a fixture doc, and points it at a real category id taken from the picker (`data-category-id`). The **write**, Accept → `categorizeDoc`, goes to production. The final assertion reloads with the interception removed and reads the category back from the server.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the fixtures module**

`tests/e2e/mobile-app/fixtures.ts`:
```ts
import type { Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { api, expectOk } from '../nightly/helpers/api';

export type Persona = 'maya' | 'alex';
export const PERSONA_CURRENCY: Record<Persona, 'CAD' | 'USD'> = { maya: 'CAD', alex: 'USD' };

export function runTag(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}${Date.now().toString(36)}${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`.toUpperCase();
}
/** Whole dollars, 101..900 — formatCurrencyCents rounds to whole units, so cents would make assertions ambiguous. */
export function randomWholeDollars(): number {
  return 101 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 800);
}
export function todayIso(): string {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}
/** Matches the rendered amount for the tenant currency in an English UI ("CA$347" / "$347"), not a longer number. */
export function moneyRegex(dollars: number, currency: string): RegExp {
  const n = dollars.toLocaleString('en-US');
  if (currency === 'CAD') return new RegExp(`(CA\\$|\\$)\\s?${n}(?![\\d.,])`);
  if (currency === 'AUD') return new RegExp(`(A\\$|\\$)\\s?${n}(?![\\d.,])`);
  return new RegExp(`(?<![A-Z])\\$\\s?${n}(?![\\d.,])`);
}

export async function makeReceiptJpeg(page: Page, label: string): Promise<Buffer> {
  const b64 = await page.evaluate((text) => {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = 600; c.height = 800;
    const g = c.getContext('2d')!;
    g.fillStyle = '#fff'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 600, 800);
    g.fillStyle = '#000'; g.font = '32px sans-serif';
    g.fillText(text, 40, 120);
    g.fillText('TOTAL 12.00', 40, 700);
    return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.8).split(',')[1];
  }, label);
  return Buffer.from(b64, 'base64');
}

export async function createExpense(page: Page, body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
  const res = await api(page).post('/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses', body);
  expectOk(res, 'create fixture expense');
  return res.data.data.id as string;
}

export async function createReceiptExpense(page: Page, f: { vendor: string; amountCents: number; date: string; label: string }): Promise<{ id: string; receiptUrl: string | null }> {
  const res = await page.evaluate(async (fx) => {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = 600; c.height = 800;
    const g = c.getContext('2d')!;
    g.fillStyle = '#fff'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 600, 800);
    g.fillStyle = '#000'; g.font = '32px sans-serif'; g.fillText(fx.label, 40, 120);
    const blob: Blob = await new Promise((r) => c.toBlob((b) => r(b as Blob), 'image/jpeg', 0.8));
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append('file', blob, 'fixture.jpg');
    form.append('idempotencyKey', crypto.randomUUID());
    form.append('amountCents', String(fx.amountCents));
    form.append('vendor', fx.vendor);
    form.append('date', fx.date);
    const r = await fetch('/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/from-receipt', { method: 'POST', body: form, credentials: 'include' });
    let data: unknown = null;
    try { data = await r.json(); } catch { /* non-JSON */ }
    return { status: r.status, data: data as { data?: { doc?: { id: string; receiptUrl: string | null } } } };
  }, f);
  expectOk(res, 'create receipt fixture via from-receipt');
  return { id: res.data!.data!.doc!.id, receiptUrl: res.data!.data!.doc!.receiptUrl };
}

export async function deleteExpenseQuietly(page: Page, id: string): Promise<void> {
  try { await api(page).delete(`/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}`); } catch { /* already gone */ }
}

export async function countByQuery(page: Page, q: string, extra = ''): Promise<number> {
  const res = await api(page).get(`/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&limit=100${extra}`);
  expectOk(res, `list expenses q=${q}`);
  return (res.data.data as unknown[]).length;
}

export async function totalsSnapshot(page: Page) {
  const est = await api(page).get('/api/v1/agentbook-tax/tax/estimate');
  expectOk(est, 'tax estimate');
  const home = await api(page).get('/api/v1/agentbook-core/mobile/home');
  expectOk(home, 'mobile home');
  return {
    revenue: est.data.total_revenue, expenses: est.data.total_expenses, tax: est.data.total_estimated_tax,
    monthNet: home.data.data.kpis.monthNetCents, estTax: home.data.data.kpis.estTaxOwedCents,
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the spec**

`tests/e2e/mobile-app/docs.spec.ts`:
```ts
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { MOBILE_VIEWPORT, loginAs, settle } from './helpers';
import { api, expectOk } from '../nightly/helpers/api';
import {
  type Persona, PERSONA_CURRENCY, runTag, randomWholeDollars, moneyRegex, todayIso,
  createExpense, createReceiptExpense, deleteExpenseQuietly, totalsSnapshot,
} from './fixtures';

/**
 * Docs journeys (spec 8.1(7)(b)) per persona, against a real deployment.
 * Every assertion is on RENDERED content (names, amounts), and every fixture is
 * created here and deleted in afterAll. Runs serially: several steps compare
 * tenant totals before/after, which concurrent writers would perturb.
 */
test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });

for (const persona of ['maya', 'alex'] as Persona[]) {
  test.describe(`docs — ${persona}`, () => {
    const currency = PERSONA_CURRENCY[persona];
    const tag = runTag(`E2EDOC${persona.slice(0, 2)}`);
    const aDollars = randomWholeDollars();
    const bDollars = randomWholeDollars();
    let page: Page;
    let aId = '';
    let bId = '';
    const cats: Array<{ id: string; name: string }> = [];

    test.beforeAll(async ({ browser }) => {
      const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: MOBILE_VIEWPORT, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true });
      page = await context.newPage();
      await loginAs(page, persona);
      await settle(page);
      aId = await createExpense(page, { amountCents: aDollars * 100, vendor: `${tag} Alpha`, description: `${tag} alpha`, date: todayIso(), currency, isPersonal: false });
      ({ id: bId } = await createReceiptExpense(page, { vendor: `${tag} Beta`, amountCents: bDollars * 100, date: todayIso(), label: `${tag} Beta` }));
    });

    test.afterAll(async () => {
      for (const id of [aId, bId]) if (id) await deleteExpenseQuietly(page, id);
      await page.context().close();
    });

    test('filter + search: both fixtures listed; No receipt shows only the receipt-less one', async () => {
      await page.goto('/app/docs');
      await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Documents' })).toBeVisible();
      await page.getByRole('searchbox', { name: 'Search documents' }).fill(tag);
      const rows = page.getByTestId('doc-item');
      await expect(rows.filter({ hasText: `${tag} Alpha` })).toContainText(moneyRegex(aDollars, currency));
      await expect(rows.filter({ hasText: `${tag} Beta` })).toContainText(moneyRegex(bDollars, currency));
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^No receipt/ }).click();
      await expect(rows.filter({ hasText: `${tag} Alpha` })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(rows.filter({ hasText: `${tag} Beta` })).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(/filter=no-receipt/);
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Needs review/ })).toBeVisible();
    });

    test('open viewer: vendor and amount render', async () => {
      await page.goto(`/app/docs/${aId}`);
      await expect(page.getByText(`${tag} Alpha`).first()).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-amount')).toHaveText(moneyRegex(aDollars, currency));
    });

    test('manually categorize: chosen category renders and survives reload', async () => {
      await page.goto(`/app/docs/${aId}`);
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-amount')).toBeVisible();
      const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Choose a category' });
      // An uncategorized doc opens the picker by itself once the suggestion check finishes;
      // if create-time pattern matching already categorized A, open it by hand.
      await dialog.waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 5000 })
        .catch(() => page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Change category' }).click());
      const options = dialog.getByTestId('category-option');
      await expect(options.first()).toBeVisible();
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(2, await options.count()); i++) {
        cats.push({ id: (await options.nth(i).getAttribute('data-category-id'))!, name: (await options.nth(i).textContent())!.trim() });
      }
      const current = (await page.getByTestId('doc-category').textContent()) ?? '';
      const pick = cats.find((c) => !current.includes(c.name)) ?? cats[0];
      await options.filter({ hasText: pick.name }).first().click();
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-category')).toContainText(pick.name);
      await page.reload();
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-category')).toContainText(pick.name);
    });

    test('accept AI suggestion: category from the suggestion persists server-side', async () => {
      const b = await api(page).get(`/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${bId}`);
      expectOk(b, 'read fixture B');
      const suggested = cats.find((c) => c.id !== b.data.data.categoryId) ?? cats[0];
      await page.route('**/api/v1/agentbook-core/auto-categorize/pending', (route) => route.fulfill({
        status: 200, contentType: 'application/json',
        body: JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: { uncategorizedCount: 1, totalCount: 1, uncategorizedPct: 100, items: [{
          expenseId: bId, vendorName: `${tag} Beta`, amountCents: bDollars * 100, date: todayIso(), description: null,
          suggestedCategoryId: suggested.id, suggestedCategoryName: suggested.name, confidence: 0.74, reason: 'e2e' }] } }),
      }));
      // The viewer consults the pending route only for an uncategorized doc. B may already
      // have a category (vendor pattern or the create-time auto-categorize), in which case
      // the chip never appears and the same Accept is exercised through the Review sheet.
      await page.goto(`/app/docs/${bId}`);
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-amount')).toBeVisible();
      const chip = page.getByTestId('ai-suggestion');
      const chipShown = await chip.waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 5000 }).then(() => true, () => false);
      if (chipShown) {
        await expect(chip).toContainText(suggested.name);
        await chip.getByRole('button', { name: 'Accept' }).click();
      } else {
        // B was categorized at creation, so the viewer never asks the pending route. Prove the same
        // Accept path through the Review AI picks sheet, which always reads it.
        await page.goto('/app/docs');
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Review AI picks' }).click();
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: `Accept ${suggested.name} for ${tag} Beta` }).click();
      }
      await page.unroute('**/api/v1/agentbook-core/auto-categorize/pending');
      await page.goto(`/app/docs/${bId}`);
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-category')).toContainText(suggested.name);
    });

    test('edit amount: new amount renders after reload', async () => {
      const newDollars = aDollars + 7;
      await page.goto(`/app/docs/${aId}`);
      await page.getByLabel('Amount').fill(`${newDollars}.00`);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save changes' }).click();
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-amount')).toHaveText(moneyRegex(newDollars, currency));
      await page.reload();
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-amount')).toHaveText(moneyRegex(newDollars, currency));
    });

    test('archive → under Archived → restore, with totals byte-identical throughout', async () => {
      const before = await totalsSnapshot(page);
      await page.goto(`/app/docs/${bId}`);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Archive' }).click();
      await expect(page.getByText('Archived. It is hidden from your lists but its numbers still count.')).toBeVisible();
      expect(await totalsSnapshot(page), 'archive must not change any total').toEqual(before);

      await page.goto(`/app/docs?q=${encodeURIComponent(tag)}`);
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-item').filter({ hasText: `${tag} Beta` })).toHaveCount(0);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Archived/ }).click();
      const archivedRow = page.getByTestId('doc-item').filter({ hasText: `${tag} Beta` });
      await expect(archivedRow).toContainText(moneyRegex(bDollars, currency));
      await archivedRow.click();
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Restore' }).click();
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Archive' })).toBeVisible();
      expect(await totalsSnapshot(page), 'restore must not change any total').toEqual(before);

      await page.goto(`/app/docs?q=${encodeURIComponent(tag)}`);
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-item').filter({ hasText: `${tag} Beta` })).toBeVisible();
    });

    test('receipt thumbnail is served by the Next image optimizer', async () => {
      const b = await api(page).get(`/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${bId}`);
      const url = b.data?.data?.receiptUrl as string | null;
      expect(url, 'from-receipt fixture must have a receiptUrl').toBeTruthy();
      const res = await page.request.get(`/_next/image?url=${encodeURIComponent(url!)}&w=96&q=60`);
      expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
      expect(res.headers()['content-type']).toMatch(/^image\//);
    });

    test('delete: confirm sheet, then gone from the list and the API', async () => {
      await page.goto(`/app/docs/${aId}`);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete', exact: true }).click();
      await page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Delete this expense?' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete expense' }).click();
      await expect(page).not.toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/app/docs/${aId}$`));
      const gone = await api(page).get(`/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${aId}`);
      expect(gone.status).toBe(404);
      await page.goto(`/app/docs?q=${encodeURIComponent(tag)}`);
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-item').filter({ hasText: `${tag} Alpha` })).toHaveCount(0);
      aId = '';
    });
  });
}
```

## PR 5 — Capture + offline fix

Branch `feat/mobile-capture-offline`, worktree `/Users/qianghan/Documents/mycodespace/a3p/.worktrees/mobile-capture`, cut from `origin/main` **after PR 4 is merged and prod-verified**. PR 5 reuses PR 4's `CategoryPicker`, `category-recents`, `format`, `api-extra` (`HttpError`, `request`, `confirmDoc`), `useTenantCurrency` and `tests/e2e/mobile-app/fixtures.ts`.

**The orphan bug being fixed.** Today `queueReceipt(file)` stores a bare photo. On replay, both `lib/offline-queue.ts::replayReceipts` and `public/sw.js::replayReceiptQueue` POST it to `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/receipts/scan`. That route only stores the photo and runs OCR; it **never creates an expense**. The replay "succeeds", the queue entry is deleted, and the receipt is gone. After this PR, both replay paths POST multipart to `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/from-receipt` with the record's stored `idempotencyKey` plus the user's typed fields. The server's key-based dedupe (PR 1) turns any double replay into one expense: page `online` handler plus SW Background Sync, or a lost response followed by a retry.

**Legacy records** (queued by the old page: `{file, fileName, fileType, queuedAt}`, no key). On first replay, a key is generated and persisted **inside one readwrite IndexedDB transaction before the POST** (`ensureReceiptKey`). The page and the worker replaying at the same moment therefore cannot mint two keys for one photo, and a lost response still dedupes on retry. A legacy record carries no fields, so OCR fills them and the expense may land in "Needs review".

**Other fixes here:**
- `registerSync` awaited `navigator.serviceWorker.ready`, which never settles when no worker is registered. Queueing hung with the UI stuck on "Uploading…". It now races a 1.5 s timeout.
- The service worker's synthetic offline 503 (`X-Agentbook-Offline: 1`) used to count as a failed replay. It now stops the replay without recording an error.
- The SW sync handler now rejects when still offline, so Background Sync retries with backoff instead of marking the sync done.
- Manual entries now send the tenant currency. `POST /expenses` defaults `currency` to `'USD'`, so every CA/AU manual capture was booked in USD.
- New records store `bytes: ArrayBuffer` rather than a `Blob`. ArrayBuffers clone reliably into IndexedDB everywhere, including older iOS Safari and fake-indexeddb under jsdom. Legacy `file: Blob` records are still read.

**Capture flow (contract interpretation).** C3/C4 give `uploadReceipt` → `FromReceiptResult { doc, duplicate, ocr }`, so the expense is created when the photo is uploaded, and the result supplies the OCR prefill and the AI guess. **Save** then applies only what the user changed: `patchDoc` for amount/vendor/date/personal, `categorizeDoc` for the category, and `confirmDoc` when the doc is `pending_review` **and** has a category. **Discard** soft-deletes the uploaded expense. If the device is offline when the photo is taken, or the upload fails, nothing exists server-side yet. In that case Save sends `uploadReceipt(file, {sameKey, ...fields})` or queues exactly that request, so the online and offline paths send the same request to the same endpoint, as spec §4.4 requires. "Save & next" saves and returns to the camera-ready screen with focus on the Snap button. It does not reopen the camera automatically: `input.click()` after an `await` has lost the user gesture, and iOS ignores it.

`apps/web-next/src/app/app/_lib/image.ts`:
```ts
/**
 * Receipt photo downscaling (moved from capture/page.tsx).
 *
 * Full-resolution phone photos (3-12 MB) exceed Vercel's 4.5 MB request-body
 * limit: the platform answers 413 with a plain-text body before our route runs,
 * and the old capture page swallowed that — every phone capture failed silently
 * (#235). A single 1800px/0.85 pass fixes the common case; the stepped
 * attempts below cover the pathological one. Falls back to the original file
 * whenever the browser cannot decode it (PDFs, unsupported formats).
 */
export const MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = 4_000_000;

export const COMPRESS_ATTEMPTS: ReadonlyArray<{ maxDim: number; quality: number }> = [
  { maxDim: 1800, quality: 0.85 },
  { maxDim: 1400, quality: 0.75 },
  { maxDim: 1100, quality: 0.65 },
];

function jpegName(name: string): string {
  const base = (name || 'receipt').replace(/\.[^./\\]+$/, '');
  return `${base}.jpg`;
}

async function renderJpeg(bitmap: ImageBitmap, name: string, maxDim: number, quality: number): Promise<File | null> {
  const scale = Math.min(1, maxDim / Math.max(bitmap.width, bitmap.height));
  const width = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.width * scale));
  const height = Math.max(1, Math.round(bitmap.height * scale));
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = width;
  canvas.height = height;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) return null;
  ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, width, height);
  const blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>((resolve) => canvas.toBlob(resolve, 'image/jpeg', quality));
  return blob ? new File([blob], jpegName(name), { type: 'image/jpeg' }) : null;
}

export async function compressImage(file: File, attempts = COMPRESS_ATTEMPTS): Promise<File> {
  if (typeof createImageBitmap !== 'function') return file;
  let bitmap: ImageBitmap;
  try {
    bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file);
  } catch {
    return file;
  }
  try {
    let last: File | null = null;
    for (const { maxDim, quality } of attempts) {
      const out = await renderJpeg(bitmap, file.name, maxDim, quality);
      if (!out) return last ?? file;
      last = out;
      if (out.size <= MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES) return out;
    }
    return last ?? file;
  } catch {
    return file;
  } finally {
    bitmap.close?.();
  }
}
```

```ts
import { vi } from 'vitest';

/** In-memory stand-in for POST /expenses/from-receipt with PR 1's contract: same key → same expense, duplicate:true. */
export function fakeServer() {
  const byKey = new Map<string, string>();
  const calls: Array<{ url: string; key: string; fields: Record<string, string>; fileName: string | null; fileSize: number }> = [];
  let mode: 'ok' | 'throw' | 'sw-offline' | 'http500' | 'http401' = 'ok';
  const fetchImpl = vi.fn(async (url: string, init?: RequestInit) => {
    if (mode === 'throw') throw new TypeError('Failed to fetch');
    if (mode === 'sw-offline') return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: 'Offline' }), { status: 503, headers: { 'X-Agentbook-Offline': '1' } });
    if (typeof init?.body === 'string') return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: { id: 'manual-1' } }), { status: 201 });
    const form = init!.body as FormData;
    const fields: Record<string, string> = {};
    form.forEach((v, k) => { if (k !== 'file' && k !== 'idempotencyKey') fields[k] = String(v); });
    const file = form.get('file') as File | null;
    const key = String(form.get('idempotencyKey') ?? '');
    calls.push({ url, key, fields, fileName: file?.name ?? null, fileSize: file?.size ?? 0 });
    if (mode === 'http500') return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: 'boom' }), { status: 500 });
    if (mode === 'http401') return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: 'Unauthorized' }), { status: 401 });
    const duplicate = byKey.has(key);
    if (!duplicate) byKey.set(key, `exp_${byKey.size + 1}`);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: { doc: { id: byKey.get(key) }, duplicate, ocr: { amountCents: null, vendor: null, date: null } } }), { status: duplicate ? 200 : 201 });
  });
  return { fetchImpl, byKey, calls, setMode: (m: typeof mode) => { mode = m; } };
}
```

```ts
import { Blob as NodeBlob } from 'node:buffer';

import { fakeServer } from './_fake-receipt-server';

type Mod = typeof import('@/lib/offline-queue');
const load = async (): Promise<Mod> => import('@/lib/offline-queue');
const setOnline = (v: boolean) => Object.defineProperty(window.navigator, 'onLine', { configurable: true, get: () => v });
const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

let server: ReturnType<typeof fakeServer>;
beforeEach(() => {
  globalThis.indexedDB = new IDBFactory();
  vi.resetModules();
  setOnline(false); // queueing while offline must not trigger an immediate replay
  server = fakeServer();
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', server.fetchImpl);
});
afterEach(() => { vi.unstubAllGlobals(); });

const photo = () => new File([new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])], 'receipt.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });

async function seedLegacy(record: Record<string, unknown>) {
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = indexedDB.open('agentbook-offline', 1);
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      req.result.createObjectStore('expense-queue', { keyPath: 'id', autoIncrement: true });
      req.result.createObjectStore('receipt-queue', { keyPath: 'id', autoIncrement: true });
    };
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const tx = req.result.transaction('receipt-queue', 'readwrite');
      tx.objectStore('receipt-queue').add(record);
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    };
  });
}
```

`apps/web-next/src/lib/offline-queue.ts`:
```ts
'use client';

/**
 * Offline queue for the mobile PWA's capture flow: if "record expense" or
 * "save receipt" fails because the device has no connection, the write goes
 * into IndexedDB instead of being lost, and gets replayed once connectivity
 * returns.
 *
 * Two replay paths, because the Background Sync API isn't supported on iOS
 * Safari at all. Where it exists we register a sync tag and let the service
 * worker (public/sw.js) replay; everywhere we also replay on the `online`
 * event and on app load. Both paths can run for the same receipt — that is
 * safe ONLY because every receipt carries an idempotency key the server
 * dedupes on (POST /expenses/from-receipt: same key → same expense).
 *
 * History: receipts used to replay to /receipts/scan, which stores + OCRs a
 * photo but never creates an expense — every offline capture was silently
 * orphaned. The record shape and replay below are mirrored in sw.js; the
 * field names are pinned by __tests__/architecture/service-worker-replay.test.ts.
 */

const DB_NAME = 'agentbook-offline';
const DB_VERSION = 1;
const EXPENSE_STORE = 'expense-queue';
const RECEIPT_STORE = 'receipt-queue';

export const FROM_RECEIPT_PATH = '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/from-receipt';
export const QUEUE_CHANGED_EVENT = 'agentbook:offline-queue-changed';
export const SYNC_READY_TIMEOUT_MS = 1500;

export interface ReceiptFields { amountCents?: number; vendor?: string; date?: string; categoryId?: string; isPersonal?: boolean }

interface ReceiptRecord {
  id?: number;
  /** v2: raw bytes — ArrayBuffers clone into IndexedDB reliably everywhere. */
  bytes?: ArrayBuffer;
  /** v1 (legacy): the Blob the old capture page stored. */
  file?: Blob;
  fileName: string;
  fileType: string;
  /** Absent on v1 records — minted and persisted at first replay (ensureReceiptKey). */
  idempotencyKey?: string;
  fields?: ReceiptFields;
  queuedAt: number;
  attempts?: number;
  lastError?: string | null;
}
interface ExpenseRecord { id?: number; payload: Record<string, unknown>; queuedAt: number }

export interface QueueEntry { store: 'receipt' | 'expense'; id: number; label: string | null; amountCents: number | null; queuedAt: number; attempts: number; lastError: string | null }
export interface ReplaySummary { sent: number; failed: number; remaining: number }

function openDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      const db = req.result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(EXPENSE_STORE)) db.createObjectStore(EXPENSE_STORE, { keyPath: 'id', autoIncrement: true });
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(RECEIPT_STORE)) db.createObjectStore(RECEIPT_STORE, { keyPath: 'id', autoIncrement: true });
    };
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

async function withStore<T>(store: string, mode: IDBTransactionMode, run: (s: IDBObjectStore) => IDBRequest<T> | void): Promise<T | undefined> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise<T | undefined>((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(store, mode);
    const req = run(tx.objectStore(store));
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(req ? req.result : undefined);
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

function notifyQueueChanged(): void {
  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(QUEUE_CHANGED_EVENT));
  } catch { /* non-DOM context */ }
}

export function newIdempotencyKey(): string {
  const c = (globalThis as { crypto?: Crypto }).crypto;
  if (c && typeof c.randomUUID === 'function') return c.randomUUID();
  const b = new Uint8Array(16);
  if (c && typeof c.getRandomValues === 'function') c.getRandomValues(b);
  else for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) b[i] = Math.floor(Math.random() * 256);
  b[6] = (b[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
  b[8] = (b[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
  const h = Array.from(b, (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  return `${h.slice(0, 8)}-${h.slice(8, 12)}-${h.slice(12, 16)}-${h.slice(16, 20)}-${h.slice(20)}`;
}

export function blobToArrayBuffer(blob: Blob): Promise<ArrayBuffer> {
  const b = blob as Blob & { arrayBuffer?: () => Promise<ArrayBuffer> };
  if (typeof b.arrayBuffer === 'function') return b.arrayBuffer();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = () => resolve(r.result as ArrayBuffer);
    r.onerror = () => reject(r.error);
    r.readAsArrayBuffer(blob);
  });
}

/** Field names MUST match sw.js buildReceiptForm and the from-receipt route (C3). */
export function buildFromReceiptForm(blob: Blob, fileName: string, idempotencyKey: string, fields: ReceiptFields = {}): FormData {
  const form = new FormData();
  form.append('file', blob, fileName || 'receipt.jpg');
  form.append('idempotencyKey', idempotencyKey);
  if (fields.amountCents != null) form.append('amountCents', String(fields.amountCents));
  if (fields.vendor) form.append('vendor', fields.vendor);
  if (fields.date) form.append('date', fields.date);
  if (fields.categoryId) form.append('categoryId', fields.categoryId);
  if (fields.isPersonal != null) form.append('isPersonal', String(fields.isPersonal));
  return form;
}

async function registerSync(tag: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || !('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return false;
    // `ready` never settles when no worker is registered — awaiting it bare
    // hung every queue call with the capture UI stuck mid-save.
    const reg = await Promise.race([
      navigator.serviceWorker.ready,
      new Promise<null>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(null), SYNC_READY_TIMEOUT_MS)),
    ]);
    const syncable = reg as (ServiceWorkerRegistration & { sync?: { register: (t: string) => Promise<void> } }) | null;
    if (!syncable?.sync) return false;
    await syncable.sync.register(tag);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** Queue a failed manual expense write. Behaviour unchanged (no idempotency key on this path). */
export async function queueExpense(payload: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
  await withStore(EXPENSE_STORE, 'readwrite', (s) => s.add({ payload, queuedAt: Date.now() } as ExpenseRecord));
  notifyQueueChanged();
  const synced = await registerSync('agentbook-expense-sync');
  if (!synced) attachFallbackReplay();
}

/** Queue a receipt for replay to from-receipt. Returns the queue entry id. */
export async function queueReceipt(
  file: Blob,
  opts: { fileName?: string; idempotencyKey?: string; fields?: ReceiptFields } = {},
): Promise<number> {
  const record: ReceiptRecord = {
    bytes: await blobToArrayBuffer(file),
    fileName: opts.fileName || (file as File).name || 'receipt.jpg',
    fileType: file.type || 'image/jpeg',
    idempotencyKey: opts.idempotencyKey || newIdempotencyKey(),
    fields: opts.fields ?? {},
    queuedAt: Date.now(),
    attempts: 0,
    lastError: null,
  };
  const id = (await withStore<IDBValidKey>(RECEIPT_STORE, 'readwrite', (s) => s.add(record))) as number;
  notifyQueueChanged();
  const synced = await registerSync('agentbook-receipt-sync');
  if (!synced) attachFallbackReplay();
  return id;
}

async function countPending(store: string): Promise<number> {
  return (await withStore<number>(store, 'readonly', (s) => s.count())) ?? 0;
}

/** Total queued items across both stores — for the "Queued · N waiting" pill. */
export async function pendingCount(): Promise<number> {
  const [e, r] = await Promise.all([countPending(EXPENSE_STORE), countPending(RECEIPT_STORE)]);
  return e + r;
}

export async function listQueue(): Promise<QueueEntry[]> {
  const [receipts, expenses] = await Promise.all([
    withStore<ReceiptRecord[]>(RECEIPT_STORE, 'readonly', (s) => s.getAll()),
    withStore<ExpenseRecord[]>(EXPENSE_STORE, 'readonly', (s) => s.getAll()),
  ]);
  const r: QueueEntry[] = (receipts ?? []).map((x) => ({
    store: 'receipt', id: x.id as number, label: x.fields?.vendor ?? null, amountCents: x.fields?.amountCents ?? null,
    queuedAt: x.queuedAt, attempts: x.attempts ?? 0, lastError: x.lastError ?? null,
  }));
  const e: QueueEntry[] = (expenses ?? []).map((x) => ({
    store: 'expense', id: x.id as number,
    label: typeof x.payload.vendor === 'string' ? x.payload.vendor : null,
    amountCents: typeof x.payload.amountCents === 'number' ? x.payload.amountCents : null,
    queuedAt: x.queuedAt, attempts: 0, lastError: null,
  }));
  return [...r, ...e].sort((a, b) => a.queuedAt - b.queuedAt);
}

export async function discardQueueEntry(store: 'receipt' | 'expense', id: number): Promise<void> {
  await withStore(store === 'receipt' ? RECEIPT_STORE : EXPENSE_STORE, 'readwrite', (s) => { s.delete(id); });
  notifyQueueChanged();
}

async function replayExpenses(): Promise<{ sent: number }> {
  const items = (await withStore<ExpenseRecord[]>(EXPENSE_STORE, 'readonly', (s) => s.getAll())) ?? [];
  let sent = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(item.payload),
      });
      if (!res.ok) continue; // leave queued — a real server rejection needs user input, not a silent drop
      await withStore(EXPENSE_STORE, 'readwrite', (s) => { s.delete(item.id as number); });
      sent += 1;
    } catch {
      break; // still offline — stop and wait for the next trigger
    }
  }
  if (sent) notifyQueueChanged();
  return { sent };
}

/**
 * Mint + persist a key for a legacy record inside ONE readwrite transaction.
 * IndexedDB serialises readwrite transactions on a store across connections,
 * so the page and the service worker replaying at the same instant cannot mint
 * two different keys for one photo. Returns null if the record is gone.
 */
async function ensureReceiptKey(id: number): Promise<string | null> {
  const db = await openDb();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(RECEIPT_STORE, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(RECEIPT_STORE);
    let key: string | null = null;
    const req = store.get(id);
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const rec = req.result as ReceiptRecord | undefined;
      if (!rec) return;
      if (!rec.idempotencyKey) {
        rec.idempotencyKey = newIdempotencyKey();
        store.put(rec);
      }
      key = rec.idempotencyKey;
    };
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(key);
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

async function markFailed(item: ReceiptRecord, key: string, reason: string): Promise<void> {
  await withStore(RECEIPT_STORE, 'readwrite', (s) => {
    s.put({ ...item, idempotencyKey: key, attempts: (item.attempts ?? 0) + 1, lastError: reason });
  });
}

async function doReplayReceipts(): Promise<ReplaySummary> {
  const items = (await withStore<ReceiptRecord[]>(RECEIPT_STORE, 'readonly', (s) => s.getAll())) ?? [];
  let sent = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    const key = await ensureReceiptKey(item.id as number);
    if (!key) continue; // drained by the service worker meanwhile
    let blob: Blob;
    try {
      const type = item.fileType || item.file?.type || 'image/jpeg';
      blob = new Blob([item.bytes ?? (await blobToArrayBuffer(item.file as Blob))], { type });
    } catch {
      failed += 1;
      await markFailed(item, key, 'unreadable');
      continue;
    }
    let res: Response;
    try {
      res = await fetch(FROM_RECEIPT_PATH, {
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'include',
        body: buildFromReceiptForm(blob, item.fileName, key, item.fields),
      });
    } catch {
      break; // still offline
    }
    if (res.headers?.get?.('X-Agentbook-Offline') === '1') break; // the service worker answered for the network
    if (res.ok) {
      await withStore(RECEIPT_STORE, 'readwrite', (s) => { s.delete(item.id as number); });
      sent += 1;
      continue;
    }
    // A considered server answer (auth expired, validation) needs the user — keep it and say why.
    failed += 1;
    await markFailed(item, key, `http_${res.status}`);
  }
  const remaining = await countPending(RECEIPT_STORE);
  notifyQueueChanged();
  return { sent, failed, remaining };
}

let receiptReplay: Promise<ReplaySummary> | null = null;

/** Single-flight: overlapping triggers (online event + app load + Retry tap) share one pass. */
export function replayReceipts(): Promise<ReplaySummary> {
  if (!receiptReplay) receiptReplay = doReplayReceipts().finally(() => { receiptReplay = null; });
  return receiptReplay;
}

export async function replayAll(): Promise<{ sent: number; remaining: number }> {
  const e = await replayExpenses();
  const r = await replayReceipts();
  return { sent: e.sent + r.sent, remaining: await pendingCount() };
}

let fallbackAttached = false;

/** Browsers without Background Sync (iOS Safari): retry on `online` and once now. */
function attachFallbackReplay(): void {
  if (fallbackAttached || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  fallbackAttached = true;
  const run = () => { void replayAll().catch(() => { /* next trigger retries */ }); };
  window.addEventListener('online', run);
  if (navigator.onLine) run();
}

/** Call once on app mount so a queue left over from a previous offline session gets a chance to drain. */
export function initOfflineQueueReplay(): void {
  attachFallbackReplay();
}
```

```ts
import 'fake-indexeddb/auto';
import { IDBFactory } from 'fake-indexeddb';
import { Blob as NodeBlob } from 'node:buffer';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import vm from 'node:vm';
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { fakeServer } from '../lib/_fake-receipt-server';

/**
 * Executes the SHIPPED public/sw.js — not a copy — against a fake IndexedDB
 * shared with the page-side queue, so both replay paths are proven to target
 * from-receipt with the same stored key.
 */
const SW_SOURCE = readFileSync(join(__dirname, '..', '..', '..', 'public', 'sw.js'), 'utf8');
const setOnline = (v: boolean) => Object.defineProperty(window.navigator, 'onLine', { configurable: true, get: () => v });

function loadSw(fetchImpl: unknown, idb: IDBFactory) {
  const handlers: Record<string, (e: unknown) => void> = {};
  const self = {
    addEventListener: (type: string, fn: (e: unknown) => void) => { handlers[type] = fn; },
    skipWaiting: () => undefined,
    clients: { claim: () => undefined, openWindow: () => undefined },
    registration: { showNotification: () => undefined },
    crypto: globalThis.crypto,
  };
  const context = vm.createContext({
    self, fetch: fetchImpl, indexedDB: idb, FormData, Blob, Response, URL, console, setTimeout,
    caches: { open: async () => ({ addAll: async () => undefined, put: async () => undefined }), keys: async () => [], match: async () => undefined, delete: async () => true },
  });
  vm.runInContext(SW_SOURCE, context);
  return {
    sync(tag: string): Promise<unknown> {
      let p: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
      handlers.sync({ tag, waitUntil: (x: Promise<unknown>) => { p = x; } });
      return p;
    },
  };
}

async function seed(record: Record<string, unknown>) {
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = indexedDB.open('agentbook-offline', 1);
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      req.result.createObjectStore('expense-queue', { keyPath: 'id', autoIncrement: true });
      req.result.createObjectStore('receipt-queue', { keyPath: 'id', autoIncrement: true });
    };
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const tx = req.result.transaction('receipt-queue', 'readwrite');
      tx.objectStore('receipt-queue').add(record);
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    };
  });
}
```

In `apps/web-next/public/sw.js`, replace the `sync` listener with:
```js
// Background sync: replay queued operations when back online. A rejected
// waitUntil tells the browser to retry later with backoff — resolving while
// still offline would mark the sync done and strand the receipt.
self.addEventListener('sync', (event) => {
  if (event.tag === 'agentbook-expense-sync') {
    event.waitUntil(replayExpenseQueue());
  }
  if (event.tag === 'agentbook-receipt-sync') {
    event.waitUntil(replayReceiptQueue());
  }
});
```
Then replace the whole `async function replayReceiptQueue() { … }` with:
```js
// Receipts replay to from-receipt — the route that CREATES the expense. They
// used to replay to /receipts/scan, which only stores + OCRs a photo, so every
// offline capture was orphaned. Mirrors replayReceipts() in
// src/lib/offline-queue.ts; the shared record shape, key handling and field
// names are pinned by __tests__/architecture/service-worker-replay.test.ts.
const FROM_RECEIPT_PATH = '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/from-receipt';

function putItem(db, store, value) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(store, 'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore(store).put(value);
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

// Same algorithm as newIdempotencyKey() in src/lib/offline-queue.ts.
function newIdempotencyKey() {
  if (self.crypto && typeof self.crypto.randomUUID === 'function') return self.crypto.randomUUID();
  const b = new Uint8Array(16);
  self.crypto.getRandomValues(b);
  b[6] = (b[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
  b[8] = (b[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
  const h = Array.from(b, (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  return h.slice(0, 8) + '-' + h.slice(8, 12) + '-' + h.slice(12, 16) + '-' + h.slice(16, 20) + '-' + h.slice(20);
}

// Legacy records (queued before idempotency keys existed) get a key minted and
// persisted inside ONE readwrite transaction, so this worker and the page
// replaying at the same moment cannot mint two keys for one photo.
function ensureReceiptKey(db, id) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(RECEIPT_STORE, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(RECEIPT_STORE);
    let key = null;
    const req = store.get(id);
    req.onsuccess = () => {
      const rec = req.result;
      if (!rec) return;
      if (!rec.idempotencyKey) {
        rec.idempotencyKey = newIdempotencyKey();
        store.put(rec);
      }
      key = rec.idempotencyKey;
    };
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(key);
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

async function receiptBlob(item) {
  const type = item.fileType || (item.file && item.file.type) || 'image/jpeg';
  if (item.bytes) return new Blob([item.bytes], { type });
  return new Blob([await item.file.arrayBuffer()], { type });
}

function buildReceiptForm(blob, fileName, key, fields) {
  const f = fields || {};
  const form = new FormData();
  form.append('file', blob, fileName || 'receipt.jpg');
  form.append('idempotencyKey', key);
  if (f.amountCents != null) form.append('amountCents', String(f.amountCents));
  if (f.vendor) form.append('vendor', f.vendor);
  if (f.date) form.append('date', f.date);
  if (f.categoryId) form.append('categoryId', f.categoryId);
  if (f.isPersonal != null) form.append('isPersonal', String(f.isPersonal));
  return form;
}

async function replayReceiptQueue() {
  const db = await openOfflineDb();
  const items = await getAll(db, RECEIPT_STORE);
  let offline = false;
  for (const item of items) {
    const key = await ensureReceiptKey(db, item.id);
    if (!key) continue; // drained by the page meanwhile
    let blob;
    try {
      blob = await receiptBlob(item);
    } catch {
      await putItem(db, RECEIPT_STORE, Object.assign({}, item, { idempotencyKey: key, attempts: (item.attempts || 0) + 1, lastError: 'unreadable' }));
      continue;
    }
    let res;
    try {
      res = await fetch(FROM_RECEIPT_PATH, { method: 'POST', credentials: 'include', body: buildReceiptForm(blob, item.fileName, key, item.fields) });
    } catch {
      offline = true;
      break;
    }
    if (res.ok) {
      await deleteItem(db, RECEIPT_STORE, item.id);
      continue;
    }
    // A considered server answer (auth expired, validation) needs the user:
    // keep it queued and record why, for the app's "Queued" sheet.
    await putItem(db, RECEIPT_STORE, Object.assign({}, item, { idempotencyKey: key, attempts: (item.attempts || 0) + 1, lastError: 'http_' + res.status }));
  }
  if (offline) throw new Error('offline: background sync will retry');
}
```
Leave `CACHE_NAME`/`STATIC_CACHE`/`API_CACHE` alone. PR 2 already bumped them to v6, and the browser installs a new worker whenever the bytes of `sw.js` change.

**Why `isOfflineError` is duck-typed:** api.ts (PR 2) owns error normalization. This predicate accepts every shape that means "never reached the server": a `TypeError` from fetch, `status 0`, `code 'offline' | 'network'`, the SW synthetic `503 'Offline'`, or `navigator.onLine === false`. It works whichever of these the merged `ApiError` uses, and the test pins each shape.

```ts
'use client';

/**
 * Mobile-facing offline API (contract C4). Storage + replay live in
 * src/lib/offline-queue.ts (shared with the service worker's record shape).
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  queueReceipt, listQueue, discardQueueEntry, replayAll, initOfflineQueueReplay, newIdempotencyKey,
  QUEUE_CHANGED_EVENT, type QueueEntry, type ReceiptFields,
} from '@/lib/offline-queue';

export { newIdempotencyKey };
export type { QueueEntry };

export interface QueueReceiptFields extends ReceiptFields { idempotencyKey: string }

/** Queue a receipt for replay to /expenses/from-receipt with THIS key — the same key the online attempt used. */
export async function queueReceiptForReplay(file: Blob, fields: QueueReceiptFields): Promise<void> {
  const { idempotencyKey, ...rest } = fields;
  await queueReceipt(file, { fileName: (file as File).name || 'receipt.jpg', idempotencyKey, fields: rest });
}

/** True when a request never reached the server — whatever shape the client normalised it to. */
export function isOfflineError(e: unknown): boolean {
  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.onLine === false) return true;
  if (e instanceof TypeError) return true;
  if (!e || typeof e !== 'object') return false;
  const x = e as { status?: number; code?: string; message?: string };
  if (x.code === 'offline' || x.code === 'network') return true;
  if (x.status === 0) return true;
  // The service worker's synthetic answer: 503 with body error 'Offline'.
  return x.status === 503 && /^offline$/i.test(String(x.message ?? '').trim());
}

/** The service worker drains the queue out-of-page (Background Sync), so poll while mounted. */
export const QUEUE_POLL_MS = 5000;

export function useOfflineQueue() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<QueueEntry[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setItems(await listQueue());
    } catch {
      setItems([]); // IndexedDB unavailable (private mode) — nothing can be queued either
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    initOfflineQueueReplay();
    void refresh();
    const on = () => { void refresh(); };
    window.addEventListener(QUEUE_CHANGED_EVENT, on);
    window.addEventListener('online', on);
    const timer = window.setInterval(on, QUEUE_POLL_MS);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(QUEUE_CHANGED_EVENT, on);
      window.removeEventListener('online', on);
      window.clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, [refresh]);

  const retry = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      return await replayAll();
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      void refresh();
    }
  }, [refresh]);

  const discard = useCallback(async (store: 'receipt' | 'expense', id: number) => {
    await discardQueueEntry(store, id);
    await refresh();
  }, [refresh]);

  return { count: items.length, items, busy, retry, discard, refresh };
}
```

`apps/web-next/src/app/app/capture/_components/QueuePill.tsx`:
```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { CloudOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { useT } from '@/hooks/use-t';
import { Pill, Sheet, useToast } from '../../_kit';
import { useOfflineQueue } from '../../_lib/offline';
import { Amount } from '../../docs/_components/Amount';

const btn: React.CSSProperties = { minHeight: 44, minWidth: 44, padding: '0 12px', borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--card)', color: 'var(--foreground)', fontSize: 14 };

export function QueuePill({ currency }: { currency: string | null }) {
  const t = useT();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { count, items, busy, retry, discard } = useOfflineQueue();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  if (count === 0) return null;

  async function onRetry() {
    try {
      const r = await retry();
      toast.show(t('mobile.capture.queue_retry_done', { sent: r.sent, remaining: r.remaining }), r.remaining ? 'warn' : 'good');
      if (!r.remaining) setOpen(false);
    } catch {
      toast.show(t('mobile.capture.save_failed'), 'critical');
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" data-testid="queue-pill" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        style={{ minHeight: 44, border: 'none', background: 'transparent', padding: 0, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <Pill tone="warn"><CloudOff aria-hidden="true" style={{ width: 14, height: 14, verticalAlign: -2, marginRight: 4 }} />{t('mobile.capture.queue_pill', { n: count })}</Pill>
      </button>
      <Sheet open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title={t('mobile.capture.queue_title')}>
        {items.length === 0 ? (
          <p>{t('mobile.capture.queue_empty')}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul style={{ listStyle: 'none', margin: 0, padding: 0, display: 'grid', gap: 8 }}>
            {items.map((it) => {
              const kind = it.store === 'receipt' ? t('mobile.capture.queue_item_receipt') : t('mobile.capture.queue_item_expense');
              const label = it.label || kind;
              return (
                <li key={`${it.store}:${it.id}`} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, padding: 10, borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
                  <span style={{ flex: 1, display: 'grid', gap: 2 }}>
                    <span style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{label}</span>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--muted-foreground)' }}>{kind}</span>
                    {it.lastError && (
                      <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--destructive, #ef4444)' }}>
                        {t('mobile.capture.queue_item_error', { status: it.lastError.replace(/^http_/, '') })}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                  {it.amountCents != null && <Amount cents={it.amountCents} currency={currency} />}
                  <button type="button" style={btn} aria-label={t('mobile.capture.queue_discard_for', { item: label })}
                    onClick={() => void discard(it.store, it.id)}>{t('mobile.capture.queue_discard')}</button>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
        <button type="button" style={{ ...btn, width: '100%', marginTop: 12, fontWeight: 600 }} disabled={busy} onClick={() => void onRetry()}>
          {t('mobile.capture.queue_retry')}
        </button>
      </Sheet>
    </>
  );
}
```

```ts
export interface CreateExpenseBody {
  amountCents: number;
  vendor?: string;
  date?: string;
  categoryId?: string;
  isPersonal?: boolean;
  /** Always send it: the route defaults to 'USD', which mis-booked every CA/AU manual capture. */
  currency?: string;
}

/** Manual entry (no photo). The key makes a retry after a lost response a no-op, not a second expense. */
export async function createExpense(body: CreateExpenseBody, idempotencyKey: string): Promise<{ id: string }> {
  const data = await request<{ id: string }>('/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'Idempotency-Key': idempotencyKey },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  return { id: data.id };
}
```

```tsx
    expect(await q.listQueue()).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ store: 'expense', amountCents: 300 })]);
  });
});
```

```tsx
import MobileCapture from '../../app/app/capture/page';

beforeEach(() => {
  Object.defineProperty(window.navigator, 'onLine', { configurable: true, get: () => true });
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn(async (url: string) => {
    if (String(url).includes('/expenses/from-receipt')) return new Response('Request Entity Too Large', { status: 413 });
    if (String(url).includes('/tenant-config')) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: { currency: 'CAD', jurisdiction: 'ca' } }), { status: 200 });
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: [] }), { status: 200 });
  }));
});

    expect(screen.getByText(/too large to upload/i)).toBeInTheDocument();

});
```
