`apps/web-next/src/app/app/capture/page.tsx` (full replacement):
```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Camera, PenLine } from 'lucide-react';
import { parseAmountToCents } from '@agentbook/i18n';
import { useT, useShellLocale } from '@/hooks/use-t';
import type { FromReceiptResult, MobileDoc } from '@/lib/mobile/types';
import { queueExpense } from '@/lib/offline-queue';
import { uploadReceipt, patchDoc, categorizeDoc, deleteDoc } from '../_lib/api';
import { confirmDoc, createExpense, getTenantCurrency } from '../_lib/api-extra';
import { compressImage } from '../_lib/image';
import { queueReceiptForReplay, isOfflineError, newIdempotencyKey } from '../_lib/offline';
import { getRecentCategories, pushRecentCategory, type RecentCategory } from '../_lib/category-recents';
import { formatAmountInput, todayIso } from '../_lib/format';
import { useTenantCurrency } from '../_lib/useTenantCurrency';
import { Chip, Pill, useToast } from '../_kit';
import { CategoryPicker } from '../docs/_components/CategoryPicker';
import { QueuePill } from './_components/QueuePill';

type Stage = 'idle' | 'uploading' | 'review';
/** Where the expense stands while the form is open. */
type Source = 'uploaded' | 'offline' | 'failed' | 'manual';
type ErrorKind = null | 'read_failed' | 'upload_too_large' | 'save_too_large' | 'save_failed' | 'queue_failed'
  | 'amount_invalid' | 'amount_ambiguous' | 'discard_failed';

interface Draft { amount: string; vendor: string; date: string; categoryId: string | null; categoryName: string | null; isPersonal: boolean }
interface Fields { amountCents: number; vendor?: string; date?: string; categoryId?: string; isPersonal: boolean }

const emptyDraft = (): Draft => ({ amount: '', vendor: '', date: todayIso(), categoryId: null, categoryName: null, isPersonal: false });
const statusOf = (e: unknown) => (e && typeof e === 'object' ? (e as { status?: number }).status : undefined);
const deviceOffline = () => typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.onLine === false;

/** Marks a failure to write the IndexedDB queue itself (private mode, quota). */
class QueueError extends Error {}
async function queueOr<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  try { return await fn(); } catch { throw new QueueError('queue'); }
}

const ERROR_KEYS: Record<Exclude<ErrorKind, null>, string[]> = {
  read_failed: ['mobile.capture.read_failed'],
  upload_too_large: ['mobile.capture.too_large', 'mobile.capture.read_failed'],
  save_too_large: ['mobile.capture.too_large'],
  save_failed: ['mobile.capture.save_failed'],
  queue_failed: ['mobile.capture.queue_failed'],
  amount_invalid: ['mobile.capture.amount_invalid'],
  amount_ambiguous: ['mobile.capture.amount_ambiguous'],
  discard_failed: ['mobile.capture.discard_failed'],
};

const field: React.CSSProperties = { width: '100%', minHeight: 44, padding: '10px 12px', borderRadius: 10, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--background)', color: 'var(--foreground)', fontSize: 16 };
const label: React.CSSProperties = { display: 'grid', gap: 4, fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted-foreground)' };
const primary: React.CSSProperties = { minHeight: 48, borderRadius: 12, border: 'none', background: 'var(--primary)', color: 'var(--primary-foreground, #04130c)', fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600 };
const secondary: React.CSSProperties = { minHeight: 48, borderRadius: 12, border: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--card)', color: 'var(--foreground)', fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 500 };
const linkBtn: React.CSSProperties = { minHeight: 44, border: 'none', background: 'transparent', color: 'var(--foreground)', fontSize: 14, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 6 };
const seg = (on: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({ flex: 1, minHeight: 44, borderRadius: 10, border: `1px solid ${on ? 'var(--primary)' : 'var(--border)'}`, background: on ? 'var(--primary)' : 'var(--card)', color: on ? 'var(--primary-foreground, #04130c)' : 'var(--foreground)', fontWeight: on ? 600 : 500 });

export default function MobileCapture() {
  const t = useT();
  const locale = useShellLocale();
  const toast = useToast();
  const currency = useTenantCurrency();
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const snapRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>('idle');
  const [source, setSource] = useState<Source>('manual');
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [attemptKey, setAttemptKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [doc, setDoc] = useState<MobileDoc | null>(null);
  const [aiGuess, setAiGuess] = useState<RecentCategory | null>(null);
  const [recents, setRecents] = useState<RecentCategory[]>([]);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Draft>(emptyDraft);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [errorKind, setErrorKind] = useState<ErrorKind>(null);
  const [ambiguous, setAmbiguous] = useState('');
  const [pickerOpen, setPickerOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => { setRecents(getRecentCategories()); }, []);
  useEffect(() => () => { if (preview && typeof URL.revokeObjectURL === 'function') URL.revokeObjectURL(preview); }, [preview]);

  const set = <K extends keyof Draft>(k: K, v: Draft[K]) => setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, [k]: v }));

  function reset(focusSnap: boolean) {
    setStage('idle'); setSource('manual'); setFile(null); setPreview(null); setAttemptKey(null);
    setDoc(null); setAiGuess(null); setDraft(emptyDraft()); setErrorKind(null); setAmbiguous('');
    setRecents(getRecentCategories());
    if (focusSnap) setTimeout(() => snapRef.current?.focus(), 0);
  }

  function applyUpload(res: FromReceiptResult) {
    const d = res.doc;
    setDoc(d);
    const cents = res.ocr.amountCents ?? (d.amountCents > 0 ? d.amountCents : null);
    const guess: RecentCategory | null = d.categoryId && d.categoryName && d.categorySource !== 'user'
      ? { id: d.categoryId, name: d.categoryName }
      : d.suggestion ? { id: d.suggestion.categoryId, name: d.suggestion.categoryName } : null;
    setAiGuess(guess);
    setDraft({
      amount: cents != null ? formatAmountInput(cents, locale) : '',
      vendor: res.ocr.vendor ?? d.vendorName ?? '',
      date: (res.ocr.date ?? d.date ?? todayIso()).slice(0, 10),
      categoryId: d.categoryId,
      categoryName: d.categoryName,
      isPersonal: d.isPersonal,
    });
  }

  async function onPhoto(raw: File) {
    const compressed = await compressImage(raw);
    const key = newIdempotencyKey(); // one key per capture attempt; every retry of THIS photo reuses it
    setFile(compressed);
    setAttemptKey(key);
    setPreview(typeof URL.createObjectURL === 'function' ? URL.createObjectURL(compressed) : null);
    setDraft(emptyDraft()); setDoc(null); setAiGuess(null); setErrorKind(null);
    if (deviceOffline()) { setSource('offline'); setStage('review'); return; }
    setStage('uploading');
    try {
      applyUpload(await uploadReceipt(compressed, { idempotencyKey: key }));
      setSource('uploaded');
    } catch (e) {
      if (isOfflineError(e)) {
        setSource('offline');
      } else {
        setSource('failed');
        setErrorKind(statusOf(e) === 413 ? 'upload_too_large' : 'read_failed');
      }
    } finally {
      setStage('review');
    }
  }

  function startManual() {
    reset(false);
    setAttemptKey(newIdempotencyKey());
    setSource('manual');
    setStage('review');
  }

  async function maybeConfirm(d: MobileDoc, categoryId: string | null | undefined) {
    // Only with a category: the confirm route posts no journal entry for an
    // uncategorized expense, which would leave it "confirmed" but off the books.
    if (d.status === 'pending_review' && categoryId) await confirmDoc(d.id);
  }

  async function finalizeUploaded(d: MobileDoc, f: Fields) {
    const patch: Partial<{ amountCents: number; vendor: string; date: string; isPersonal: boolean }> = {};
    if (f.amountCents !== d.amountCents) patch.amountCents = f.amountCents;
    if (f.vendor && f.vendor !== (d.vendorName ?? '')) patch.vendor = f.vendor;
    if (f.date && f.date !== (d.date ?? '').slice(0, 10)) patch.date = f.date;
    if (f.isPersonal !== d.isPersonal) patch.isPersonal = f.isPersonal;
    let latest = d;
    if (Object.keys(patch).length) latest = await patchDoc(d.id, patch);
    if (f.categoryId && f.categoryId !== latest.categoryId) latest = await categorizeDoc(d.id, f.categoryId);
    await maybeConfirm(latest, latest.categoryId ?? f.categoryId);
  }

  /** Photo taken but nothing confirmed server-side: same request online or queued. Returns true if queued. */
  async function saveReceipt(f: Fields): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!file || !attemptKey) throw new Error('no photo');
    const queue = async () => { await queueOr(() => queueReceiptForReplay(file, { idempotencyKey: attemptKey, ...f })); return true; };
    if (deviceOffline()) return queue();
    try {
      const res = await uploadReceipt(file, { idempotencyKey: attemptKey, ...f });
      // duplicate:true means the photo-time upload DID land (its response was lost);
      // the server returned that original expense, so apply the typed fields to it.
      if (res.duplicate) await finalizeUploaded(res.doc, f);
      else await maybeConfirm(res.doc, f.categoryId ?? res.doc.categoryId);
      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      if (isOfflineError(e)) return queue();
      throw e;
    }
  }

  async function saveManual(f: Fields): Promise<boolean> {
    // Never let the route's 'USD' default book a CA/AU expense: fetch the currency if the
    // cached one has not arrived yet; omit it only when that is impossible (offline, no snapshot).
    const cur = currency ?? (deviceOffline() ? null : await getTenantCurrency().catch(() => null));
    const payload = {
      amountCents: f.amountCents, vendor: f.vendor, date: f.date, categoryId: f.categoryId, isPersonal: f.isPersonal,
      ...(cur ? { currency: cur } : {}),
    };
    const key = attemptKey ?? newIdempotencyKey();
    const queue = async () => { await queueOr(() => queueExpense(payload)); return true; };
    if (deviceOffline()) return queue();
    try {
      await createExpense(payload, key);
      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      if (isOfflineError(e)) return queue();
      throw e;
    }
  }

  async function save(next: boolean) {
    const parsed = parseAmountToCents(draft.amount, locale);
    if (!parsed.ok || parsed.cents <= 0) { setErrorKind('amount_invalid'); return; }
    if (parsed.ambiguous) { setAmbiguous(parsed.formatted); setErrorKind('amount_ambiguous'); return; }
    setErrorKind(null);
    const f: Fields = {
      amountCents: parsed.cents,
      vendor: draft.vendor.trim() || undefined,
      date: draft.date || undefined,
      categoryId: draft.categoryId ?? undefined,
      isPersonal: draft.isPersonal,
    };
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      let queued = false;
      if (source === 'uploaded' && doc) await finalizeUploaded(doc, f);
      else if (source === 'manual') queued = await saveManual(f);
      else queued = await saveReceipt(f);
      if (draft.categoryId && draft.categoryName) pushRecentCategory({ id: draft.categoryId, name: draft.categoryName });
      toast.show(queued ? t('mobile.capture.queued_toast') : t('mobile.capture.saved'), queued ? 'warn' : 'good');
      reset(next);
    } catch (e) {
      setErrorKind(e instanceof QueueError ? 'queue_failed' : statusOf(e) === 413 ? 'save_too_large' : 'save_failed');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function discard() {
    if (source === 'uploaded' && doc) {
      try {
        await deleteDoc(doc.id);
        toast.show(t('mobile.capture.discarded'), 'good');
      } catch {
        setErrorKind('discard_failed');
        return;
      }
    }
    reset(false);
  }

  const picked: RecentCategory | null = draft.categoryId && draft.categoryName ? { id: draft.categoryId, name: draft.categoryName } : null;
  const chipCats: RecentCategory[] = [];
  for (const c of [aiGuess, picked, ...recents]) {
    if (c && !chipCats.some((x) => x.id === c.id)) chipCats.push(c);
  }
  const visibleChips = chipCats.slice(0, 5);
  const busy = saving || stage === 'uploading';

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: '16px 16px 32px', color: 'var(--foreground)', display: 'grid', gap: 12 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 8 }}>
        <h1 style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 600, margin: 0 }}>{t('mobile.capture.title')}</h1>
        <QueuePill currency={currency} />
      </div>

      <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment" data-testid="capture-file" style={{ display: 'none' }}
        onChange={(e) => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; e.target.value = ''; if (f) void onPhoto(f); }} />

      {stage === 'idle' ? (
        <>
          <button ref={snapRef} type="button" onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
            style={{ minHeight: 180, borderRadius: 16, border: '1px dashed var(--border)', background: 'var(--card)', color: 'var(--foreground)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <Camera aria-hidden="true" style={{ width: 40, height: 40, color: 'var(--primary)' }} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 600 }}>{t('mobile.capture.snap')}</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted-foreground)' }}>{t('mobile.capture.snap_hint')}</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" style={linkBtn} onClick={startManual}>
            <PenLine aria-hidden="true" style={{ width: 16, height: 16 }} /> {t('mobile.capture.manual')}
          </button>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
          {preview && <img src={preview} alt={t('mobile.capture.preview_alt')} style={{ width: '100%', maxHeight: 260, objectFit: 'contain', borderRadius: 12, background: 'var(--card)' }} />}
          {stage === 'uploading' && <p role="status" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{t('mobile.capture.reading')}</p>}
          {stage === 'review' && source === 'uploaded' && <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--muted-foreground)' }}>{t('mobile.capture.uploaded_hint')}</p>}
          {stage === 'review' && source === 'offline' && (
            <p role="status" style={{ margin: 0, padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: 10, fontSize: 13, background: 'var(--muted, rgba(127,127,127,0.14))' }}>{t('mobile.capture.offline_mode')}</p>
          )}
          {errorKind && (
            <div role="alert" style={{ color: 'var(--destructive, #ef4444)', fontSize: 13, display: 'grid', gap: 4 }}>
              {ERROR_KEYS[errorKind].map((k) => <p key={k} style={{ margin: 0 }}>{t(k, k === 'mobile.capture.amount_ambiguous' ? { formatted: ambiguous } : undefined)}</p>)}
            </div>
          )}

          <fieldset disabled={busy} style={{ border: 'none', padding: 0, margin: 0, display: 'grid', gap: 10 }}>
            <label style={label}>{t('mobile.capture.field_amount')}
              <input style={field} inputMode="decimal" value={draft.amount} onChange={(e) => set('amount', e.target.value)} />
            </label>
            <label style={label}>{t('mobile.capture.field_vendor')}
              <input style={field} value={draft.vendor} onChange={(e) => set('vendor', e.target.value)} />
            </label>
            <label style={label}>{t('mobile.capture.field_date')}
              <input style={field} type="date" value={draft.date} onChange={(e) => set('date', e.target.value)} />
            </label>
            <div role="group" aria-label={t('mobile.capture.category_label')} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              {visibleChips.map((c) => (
                <span key={c.id} style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                  <Chip label={c.name} selected={draft.categoryId === c.id}
                    onClick={() => setDraft((d) => (d.categoryId === c.id ? { ...d, categoryId: null, categoryName: null } : { ...d, categoryId: c.id, categoryName: c.name }))} />
                  {aiGuess?.id === c.id && <Pill tone="info">{t('mobile.capture.ai_guess')}</Pill>}
                </span>
              ))}
              <Chip label={t('mobile.capture.more_categories')} onClick={() => setPickerOpen(true)} />
            </div>
            <div role="radiogroup" aria-label={t('mobile.capture.kind_label')} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
              {[false, true].map((p) => (
                <button key={String(p)} type="button" role="radio" aria-checked={draft.isPersonal === p} style={seg(draft.isPersonal === p)}
                  onClick={() => set('isPersonal', p)}>
                  {p ? t('mobile.capture.personal') : t('mobile.capture.business')}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </fieldset>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 8 }}>
            <button type="button" style={primary} disabled={busy || !draft.amount.trim()} onClick={() => void save(false)}>
              {saving ? t('mobile.capture.saving') : t('mobile.capture.save')}
            </button>
            <button type="button" style={secondary} disabled={busy || !draft.amount.trim()} onClick={() => void save(true)}>
              {t('mobile.capture.save_next')}
            </button>
          </div>
          <button type="button" style={linkBtn} disabled={saving} onClick={() => void discard()}>{t('mobile.capture.discard')}</button>
        </>
      )}

      <CategoryPicker open={pickerOpen} onClose={() => setPickerOpen(false)} currentId={draft.categoryId}
        onSelect={(c) => { setPickerOpen(false); setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, categoryId: c.id, categoryName: c.name })); }} />
    </div>
  );
}
```
Note: in the `'shows the AI guess first'` test, `within(group).getAllByRole('button')` returns the chips in DOM order: AI guess, recents, then "More…". `Pill` is not a button, so it doesn't shift the indices.

```ts
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { MOBILE_VIEWPORT, loginAs, settle } from './helpers';
import { api, expectOk } from '../nightly/helpers/api';
import { type Persona, PERSONA_CURRENCY, runTag, randomWholeDollars, moneyRegex, makeReceiptJpeg, deleteExpenseQuietly, countByQuery } from './fixtures';

/**
 * Capture journeys (spec 8.1(7)(c)) on a real deployment. The fixture image is
 * generated in the browser (canvas → JPEG) and handed to the real file chooser.
 * Serial: the offline test counts expenses, which a concurrent writer would perturb.
 */
test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });

async function idsByQuery(page: Page, q: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const res = await api(page).get(`/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&limit=100`);
  expectOk(res, `list q=${q}`);
  return (res.data.data as Array<{ id: string }>).map((r) => r.id);
}
async function totalExpenses(page: Page): Promise<number> {
  const res = await api(page).get('/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses?limit=1');
  expectOk(res, 'expense total');
  return res.data.meta.total as number;
}
async function snapPhoto(page: Page, buffer: Buffer) {
  const chooser = page.waitForEvent('filechooser');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Snap a receipt/ }).click();
  await (await chooser).setFiles({ name: 'receipt.jpg', mimeType: 'image/jpeg', buffer });
}

for (const persona of ['maya', 'alex'] as Persona[]) {
  test.describe(`capture — ${persona}`, () => {
    const currency = PERSONA_CURRENCY[persona];
    let page: Page;
    const created: string[] = [];

    test.beforeAll(async ({ browser }) => {
      const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: MOBILE_VIEWPORT, isMobile: true, hasTouch: true });
      page = await context.newPage();
      await loginAs(page, persona);
      await settle(page);
    });
    test.afterAll(async () => {
      await page.context().setOffline(false);
      for (const id of created) await deleteExpenseQuietly(page, id);
      await page.context().close();
    });

    test('online: photo → prefilled → save → appears in Docs with the amount; thumbnail is optimizer-served', async () => {
      test.setTimeout(120_000);
      const vendor = runTag(`E2ECAP${persona.slice(0, 2)}`);
      const dollars = randomWholeDollars();
      await page.goto('/app/capture');
      await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Capture expense' })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByTestId('capture-file')).toHaveAttribute('capture', 'environment');
      await snapPhoto(page, await makeReceiptJpeg(page, vendor));
      await expect(page.getByRole('img', { name: 'Receipt preview' })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByText('Check the details, then save.')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 60_000 }); // real OCR
      await page.getByLabel('Amount').fill(`${dollars}.00`);
      await page.getByLabel('Vendor').fill(vendor);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save', exact: true }).click();
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /Snap a receipt/ })).toBeVisible();

      const ids = await idsByQuery(page, vendor);
      expect(ids, 'exactly one expense for this capture').toHaveLength(1);
      created.push(...ids);
      await page.goto(`/app/docs?q=${encodeURIComponent(vendor)}`);
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-item').filter({ hasText: vendor })).toContainText(moneyRegex(dollars, currency));

      const one = await api(page).get(`/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${ids[0]}`);
      expectOk(one, 'read captured expense');
      const url = one.data.data.receiptUrl as string;
      expect(url).toMatch(/^https:\/\/[^/]+\.vercel-storage\.com\//);
      const img = await page.request.get(`/_next/image?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}&w=96&q=60`);
      expect(img.status()).toBe(200);
      expect(img.headers()['content-type']).toMatch(/^image\//);
    });

    test('offline: queue pill → reconnect → exactly one new expense', async () => {
      test.setTimeout(120_000);
      const vendor = runTag(`E2EOFF${persona.slice(0, 2)}`);
      const dollars = randomWholeDollars();
      await page.goto('/app/capture');
      await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Capture expense' })).toBeVisible();
      const jpeg = await makeReceiptJpeg(page, vendor);
      const totalBefore = await totalExpenses(page);
      expect(await countByQuery(page, vendor)).toBe(0);

      await page.context().setOffline(true);
      await snapPhoto(page, jpeg);
      await expect(page.getByText("You're offline. We'll keep this and send it when you reconnect.")).toBeVisible();
      await page.getByLabel('Amount').fill(`${dollars}.00`);
      await page.getByLabel('Vendor').fill(vendor);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save', exact: true }).click();
      await expect(page.getByTestId('queue-pill')).toHaveText(/Queued · 1 waiting/);

      await page.context().setOffline(false);
      await expect(page.getByTestId('queue-pill')).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 45_000 });
      await expect.poll(() => countByQuery(page, vendor), { timeout: 45_000 }).toBe(1);
      // The page's `online` replay and the service worker's Background Sync can BOTH fire;
      // the shared idempotency key must keep this at exactly one.
      await page.waitForTimeout(10_000);
      expect(await countByQuery(page, vendor)).toBe(1);
      expect(await totalExpenses(page)).toBe(totalBefore + 1);
      created.push(...(await idsByQuery(page, vendor)));

      await page.goto(`/app/docs?q=${encodeURIComponent(vendor)}`);
      await expect(page.getByTestId('doc-item').filter({ hasText: vendor })).toContainText(moneyRegex(dollars, currency));
    });

    test('manual entry is booked in the tenant currency', async () => {
      const vendor = runTag(`E2EMAN${persona.slice(0, 2)}`);
      const dollars = randomWholeDollars();
      await page.goto('/app/capture');
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enter without a photo' }).click();
      await page.getByLabel('Amount').fill(`${dollars}`);
      await page.getByLabel('Vendor').fill(vendor);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save', exact: true }).click();
      await expect.poll(() => countByQuery(page, vendor), { timeout: 20_000 }).toBe(1);
      const [id] = await idsByQuery(page, vendor);
      created.push(id);
      const one = await api(page).get(`/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}`);
      expect(one.data.data.currency).toBe(currency);
      expect(one.data.data.amountCents).toBe(dollars * 100);
    });
  });
}
```

## PR 6 — Chat

**Goal:** rebuild `apps/web-next/src/app/app/chat/page.tsx` into a reliable, rich mobile chat: active web-thread history on open, safe light formatting, typing indicator, plan Proceed/Cancel, suggestion chips, undo, photo receipts, failed-send Retry, 429 countdown, and a keyboard-safe `100dvh`/`visualViewport` layout. No backend changes.

**Branch / worktree:** `feat/mobile-chat` in `/Users/qianghan/Documents/mycodespace/a3p/.worktrees/mobile-pr6-chat`.

**Decisions this PR is built on (verified in code on 2026-10-07, keep them in the PR body):**

- **D1 — Photo attach does NOT send `attachments` to `agent/message`.** The brain's attachment path routes `{type:'photo'}` to the `scan-receipt` skill (`classifyOnly`, `plugins/agentbook-core/backend/src/server.ts:3270-3281`), whose endpoint is `POST /api/v1/agentbook-expense/receipts/ocr` (`built-in-skills.ts:173`). That endpoint exists only in the Express dev backend (`plugins/agentbook-expense/backend/src/server.ts:1111`); there is no Next route (`apps/web-next/src/app/api/v1/agentbook-expense/receipts/` holds only `scan/` and `upload-blob/`), and prod runs Next routes only. So an attachment sent to the brain in production reaches a 404. Even if that route existed it would OCR without booking, while Capture books through `from-receipt`; two flows for one photo is how receipts get double-booked. Chat therefore uploads the photo with `uploadReceipt()` (C4 → `from-receipt`, idempotent by key) and renders a receipt card in the transcript that links to `/app/docs/[id]`. Retry reuses the same `idempotencyKey`, so a retried upload can never create a second expense. Telegram does the same thing: its photo handler books via `createOcrExpense` directly and never goes through the brain. The C4 `attachments` type literal `'image'` never matches the server's `'photo'`; this PR doesn't use it (see the contract note in the summary).
- **D2 — Pending plan after a reload.** History turns are text-only (`updateThreadTurns`, `agent-brain.ts:539-580`, stores `{role,text,at,intent,entityId,askedQuestion}`), so plan steps can't be rebuilt. Both plan paths write the bot turn with `intent: 'planner'` (`agent-brain.ts:2209` and `:2297`), and an `AbAgentSession` expires 24 h after creation (`agent-planner.ts` `createSession`). So when the **last** history turn is a bot turn with `intent === 'planner'` and is less than 24 h old, the page shows a "Pending action" card with Proceed/Cancel. Those buttons post `sessionAction:'confirm'|'cancel'`. If the session has already gone, the server answers truthfully: "Nothing is waiting for your confirmation" / "Nothing to cancel" (`agent.nothing_to_confirm` / `nothing_to_cancel`). We **do not** probe with `sessionAction:'status'`: with no active session, a bare `status` falls into Step 2a, which writes a "There's no action in progress" turn into the thread (`agent-brain.ts:1840-1852`). That would pollute history on every open, and the active-session status reply is hardcoded English with no steps. This needs `ChatTurn.intent` (contract amendment C4-a, checked in Task 6.1).
- **D3 — Persona header omitted.** C4 `ChatReply` has no `persona`. The header uses the static i18n title.
- **D4 — No `sessionId` sent.** The route resolves the active session by tenant (`agent/message/route.ts` comment on `sessionId`). Session actions are exempt from the rate limiter (`route.ts` "Session actions … exempt"), so Proceed/Cancel/Undo stay enabled during a 429 countdown.
- **D5 — Colours.** The theme variables are HSL triplets (`packages/theme/src/shell-variables.css`), so every colour is written `hsl(var(--x))`. The current page's `var(--primary, #10b981)` resolves to an invalid colour whenever the variable is defined. Brand-on-white text (`--primary` with white) is about 3.8:1 and fails AA, so user bubbles use a primary tint with foreground text, and Proceed uses foreground/background inversion.

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the failing i18n test**

Create `apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/chat-i18n.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { CATALOG } from '@agentbook/i18n/catalog';
import { createTranslator } from '@agentbook/i18n';

/**
 * Every key the mobile chat uses must resolve in all three locales, and the
 * non-English values must actually be translated. `t()` never throws on a
 * missing key and useT() humanises it into plausible English, so a typo or a
 * missing entry is invisible on the page; this file is what makes it loud.
 *
 * The shell-wiring guard (architecture/i18n-shell-wiring.test.ts) only scrapes
 * TWO-segment keys (`ns.key`), so three-segment `mobile.chat.x` keys would
 * pass it vacuously. Hence a dedicated check.
 */
export const CHAT_KEYS = [
  'mobile.chat.title',
  'mobile.chat.subtitle',
  'mobile.chat.history_loading',
  'mobile.chat.history_error',
  'mobile.chat.retry',
  'mobile.chat.empty_title',
  'mobile.chat.starter_briefing',
  'mobile.chat.starter_spend',
  'mobile.chat.starter_log',
  'mobile.chat.placeholder',
  'mobile.chat.send',
  'mobile.chat.attach',
  'mobile.chat.attach_camera',
  'mobile.chat.attach_library',
  'mobile.chat.attach_close',
  'mobile.chat.typing',
  'mobile.chat.not_sent',
  'mobile.chat.not_sent_offline',
  'mobile.chat.rate_limited',
  'mobile.chat.rate_limited_wait',
  'mobile.chat.plan_title',
  'mobile.chat.proceed',
  'mobile.chat.cancel',
  'mobile.chat.plan_working',
  'mobile.chat.plan_resolved',
  'mobile.chat.pending_title',
  'mobile.chat.undo',
  'mobile.chat.action_failed',
  'mobile.chat.receipt_uploading',
  'mobile.chat.receipt_saved',
  'mobile.chat.receipt_needs_review',
  'mobile.chat.receipt_duplicate',
  'mobile.chat.receipt_failed',
  'mobile.chat.receipt_open',
  'mobile.chat.new_messages',
  'mobile.chat.offline_banner',
  'mobile.chat.unreadable_amount',
] as const;

const SRC = join(__dirname, '..', '..', '..');
const CHAT_DIRS = [join(SRC, 'app', 'app', 'chat')];

function walk(dir: string): string[] {
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return [];
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const e of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const p = join(dir, e);
    if (statSync(p).isDirectory()) out.push(...walk(p));
    else if (/\.(tsx?|jsx?)$/.test(e)) out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}

export function scrapeChatKeys(): string[] {
  const keys = new Set<string>();
  for (const f of CHAT_DIRS.flatMap(walk)) {
    for (const m of readFileSync(f, 'utf8').matchAll(/\bt\('(mobile\.chat\.[a-z0-9_]+)'/g)) keys.add(m[1]);
  }
  return [...keys].sort();
}

describe('mobile chat i18n keys', () => {
  it.each(['en', 'fr-CA', 'zh-CN'])('%s resolves every chat key', (locale) => {
    const tr = createTranslator(locale, CATALOG);
    const missing = CHAT_KEYS.filter((k) => tr.t(k) === k || tr.t(k).trim() === '');
    expect(missing, `${locale}: unresolved ${missing.join(', ')}`).toEqual([]);
  });

  it.each(['fr-CA', 'zh-CN'])('%s actually translates every chat key', (locale) => {
    const en = createTranslator('en', CATALOG);
    const tr = createTranslator(locale, CATALOG);
    const same = CHAT_KEYS.filter((k) => tr.t(k) === en.t(k));
    expect(same, `${locale}: identical to English ${same.join(', ')}`).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('keeps the {seconds} placeholder in every locale', () => {
    for (const locale of ['en', 'fr-CA', 'zh-CN']) {
      const tr = createTranslator(locale, CATALOG);
      expect(tr.t('mobile.chat.rate_limited', { seconds: 7 }), locale).toContain('7');
      expect(tr.t('mobile.chat.rate_limited_wait', { seconds: 7 }), locale).toContain('7');
    }
  });

  it('every key the chat source calls is in CHAT_KEYS', () => {
    const extra = scrapeChatKeys().filter((k) => !(CHAT_KEYS as readonly string[]).includes(k));
    expect(extra, `keys used in source but not declared: ${extra.join(', ')}`).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

/** The mobile app renders server and LLM text; it must never hand it to the HTML parser. */
const ROOT = join(__dirname, '..', '..', '..', 'app', 'app');

function files(dir: string): string[] {
  return readdirSync(dir).flatMap((e) => {
    const p = join(dir, e);
    return statSync(p).isDirectory() ? files(p) : /\.(tsx?|jsx?)$/.test(e) ? [p] : [];
  });
}

      const hits = files(ROOT).filter((f) => readFileSync(f, 'utf8').includes(needle));
```

Create `apps/web-next/src/app/app/_lib/format-message.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Light, SAFE formatting for chat replies.
 *
 * Output is DATA (blocks of inline runs), never HTML. The renderer turns it into
 * React nodes, so every character the server or the LLM sends ends up as a text
 * node, never parsed markup. Agent replies carry Telegram-flavoured HTML (<b>,
 * <br>) and markdown (**bold**, "- " bullets, "1. " plan steps); the result
 * keeps exactly those meanings and drops everything else.
 *
 * Every regex here is linear: no nested or overlapping quantifiers, a bounded
 * class before each terminator, and trimEnd() instead of /\s+$/ (that pattern
 * is quadratic on a long mid-line whitespace run).
 */

export type Inline = { kind: 'text'; text: string } | { kind: 'bold'; text: string };
export type Block =
  | { kind: 'paragraph'; lines: Inline[][] }
  | { kind: 'bullets'; items: Inline[][] }
  | { kind: 'numbered'; start: number; items: Inline[][] };

export const MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS = 8000;

const ENTITIES: Record<string, string> = {
  '&lt;': '<',
  '&gt;': '>',
  '&quot;': '"',
  '&#39;': "'",
  '&#x27;': "'",
  '&nbsp;': ' ',
  '&amp;': '&',
};

/** Remove `<tag …>…</tag …>` blocks (content included) with indexOf, not a lazy regex. */
function removeBlocks(input: string, tag: string): string {
  const lower = input.toLowerCase();
  const open = `<${tag}`;
  const close = `</${tag}`;
  let out = '';
  let i = 0;
  while (i < input.length) {
    const start = lower.indexOf(open, i);
    if (start === -1) {
      out += input.slice(i);
      break;
    }
    out += input.slice(i, start);
    const end = lower.indexOf(close, start + open.length);
    if (end === -1) break; // unterminated: drop the rest, never show script text
    const gt = lower.indexOf('>', end);
    i = gt === -1 ? input.length : gt + 1;
  }
  return out;
}

export function stripMarkup(raw: string): string {
  let s = String(raw ?? '').slice(0, MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS).replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n');
  s = removeBlocks(s, 'script');
  s = removeBlocks(s, 'style');
  s = s.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n');
  s = s.replace(/<li>/gi, '\n- ');
  s = s.replace(/<\/(p|div|li)>/gi, '\n');
  // <b>/<strong> become bold markers; any attributes (onclick=…) are discarded with the tag.
  s = s.replace(/<(b|strong)(?:\s[^<>]*)?>/gi, '**').replace(/<\/(b|strong)>/gi, '**');
  s = s.replace(/<\/?[a-zA-Z][^<>]*>/g, '');
  // Decode LAST: an encoded "&lt;script&gt;" becomes literal text, never a tag.
  s = s.replace(/&(lt|gt|quot|#39|#x27|nbsp|amp);/g, (m) => ENTITIES[m] ?? m);
  return s;
}

// Greedy non-space URL then backtrack to the last ")" — so "javascript:alert(1)" (which
// contains parens) is still recognised as a link target and DROPPED. Bounded: 300 + 2000.
const LINK = /\[([^[\]\n]{1,300})\]\((\S{0,2000})\)/g;

function parseInline(line: string): Inline[] {
  const parts = line.split('**');
  if (parts.length % 2 === 0) {
    // An odd number of markers: the last one is unmatched, keep it literal.
    const tail = parts.pop() as string;
    parts[parts.length - 1] += `**${tail}`;
  }
  const out: Inline[] = [];
  parts.forEach((p, i) => {
    if (!p) return;
    out.push(i % 2 === 1 ? { kind: 'bold', text: p } : { kind: 'text', text: p });
  });
  return out.length ? out : [{ kind: 'text', text: '' }];
}

export function formatMessage(raw: string): Block[] {
  const text = stripMarkup(raw)
    .replace(LINK, (_m: string, label: string) => label)
    .replace(/`/g, '');
  const blocks: Block[] = [];
  let para: Inline[][] = [];
  const flush = () => {
    if (para.length) {
      blocks.push({ kind: 'paragraph', lines: para });
      para = [];
    }
  };
  for (const rawLine of text.split('\n')) {
    const line = rawLine.trimEnd();
    if (line.trim() === '') {
      flush();
      continue;
    }
    const bullet = /^\s*[-*•]\s+(\S.*)$/.exec(line);
    if (bullet) {
      flush();
      const last = blocks[blocks.length - 1];
      const item = parseInline(bullet[1]);
      if (last && last.kind === 'bullets') last.items.push(item);
      else blocks.push({ kind: 'bullets', items: [item] });
      continue;
    }
    const numbered = /^\s*(\d{1,3})[.)]\s+(\S.*)$/.exec(line);
    if (numbered) {
      flush();
      const last = blocks[blocks.length - 1];
      const item = parseInline(numbered[2]);
      if (last && last.kind === 'numbered') last.items.push(item);
      else blocks.push({ kind: 'numbered', start: Number(numbered[1]), items: [item] });
      continue;
    }
    const heading = /^\s*#{1,6}\s+(\S.*)$/.exec(line);
    if (heading) {
      para.push([{ kind: 'bold', text: heading[1].split('**').join('') }]);
      continue;
    }
    para.push(parseInline(line));
  }
  flush();
  return blocks;
}
```

Create `apps/web-next/src/app/app/chat/_components/MessageBody.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { formatMessage, type Inline } from '@/app/app/_lib/format-message';

function inline(parts: Inline[], key: string): React.ReactNode[] {
  return parts.map((p, i) =>
    p.kind === 'bold' ? (
      <strong key={`${key}-${i}`}>{p.text}</strong>
    ) : (
      <React.Fragment key={`${key}-${i}`}>{p.text}</React.Fragment>
    ),
  );
}

/** Renders formatMessage() blocks as React nodes. Never parses HTML. */
export function MessageBody({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const blocks = formatMessage(text);
  return (
    <div data-testid="chat-message-body" style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
      {blocks.map((b, bi) => {
        if (b.kind === 'bullets') {
          return (
            <ul key={bi} style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: 20 }}>
              {b.items.map((it, ii) => <li key={ii}>{inline(it, `${bi}-${ii}`)}</li>)}
            </ul>
          );
        }
        if (b.kind === 'numbered') {
          return (
            <ol key={bi} start={b.start} style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: 22 }}>
              {b.items.map((it, ii) => <li key={ii}>{inline(it, `${bi}-${ii}`)}</li>)}
            </ol>
          );
        }
        return (
          <p key={bi} style={{ margin: 0 }}>
            {b.lines.map((line, li) => (
              <React.Fragment key={li}>
                {li > 0 && <br />}
                {inline(line, `${bi}-${li}`)}
              </React.Fragment>
            ))}
          </p>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { describe, it, expect, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { computeViewportFrame, useKeyboardInset, KEYBOARD_MIN_PX } from '../../../app/app/_lib/useKeyboardInset';

class FakeVV extends EventTarget {
  height = 844;
  offsetTop = 0;
}

const original = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window, 'visualViewport');
afterEach(() => {
  if (original) Object.defineProperty(window, 'visualViewport', original);
  else delete (window as unknown as { visualViewport?: unknown }).visualViewport;
});

describe('computeViewportFrame', () => {
  it('no visualViewport → no keyboard', () => {
    expect(computeViewportFrame(844, null)).toEqual({ keyboardPx: 0, offsetTop: 0, viewportHeight: 844 });
  });
  it('keyboard open → inset is the hidden part of the layout viewport', () => {
    expect(computeViewportFrame(844, { height: 500, offsetTop: 0 })).toEqual({
      keyboardPx: 344, offsetTop: 0, viewportHeight: 500,
    });
  });
  it('iOS pan (offsetTop) is subtracted, not double-counted', () => {
    expect(computeViewportFrame(844, { height: 500, offsetTop: 40 }).keyboardPx).toBe(304);
  });
  it(`ignores URL-bar jitter below ${KEYBOARD_MIN_PX}px`, () => {
    expect(computeViewportFrame(844, { height: 790, offsetTop: 0 }).keyboardPx).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('useKeyboardInset', () => {
  it('tracks visualViewport resize events', () => {
    const vv = new FakeVV();
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'visualViewport', { value: vv, configurable: true });
    Object.defineProperty(window, 'innerHeight', { value: 844, configurable: true });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useKeyboardInset());
    expect(result.current.keyboardPx).toBe(0);
    act(() => {
      vv.height = 480;
      vv.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
    });
    expect(result.current.keyboardPx).toBe(364);
    act(() => {
      vv.height = 844;
      vv.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
    });
    expect(result.current.keyboardPx).toBe(0);
  });
});
```

```tsx
import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { render, fireEvent, act } from '@testing-library/react';
import { isNearBottom, useStickToBottom } from '../../../app/app/_lib/useStickToBottom';

describe('isNearBottom', () => {
  it('true within the threshold, false beyond it', () => {
    expect(isNearBottom({ scrollTop: 520, scrollHeight: 1000, clientHeight: 400 })).toBe(true);
    expect(isNearBottom({ scrollTop: 100, scrollHeight: 1000, clientHeight: 400 })).toBe(false);
  });
});

let api: ReturnType<typeof useStickToBottom> | null = null;
function Harness({ k }: { k: number }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  api = useStickToBottom(ref, k);
  return <div data-testid="list" ref={ref} />;
}

/** jsdom has no layout: back scrollTop/scrollHeight/clientHeight with plain values. */
function fakeScroll(el: HTMLElement, height: { value: number }) {
  let top = 0;
  Object.defineProperty(el, 'scrollHeight', { get: () => height.value, configurable: true });
  Object.defineProperty(el, 'clientHeight', { get: () => 400, configurable: true });
  Object.defineProperty(el, 'scrollTop', { get: () => top, set: (v: number) => { top = v; }, configurable: true });
}
```

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * How much of the layout viewport the on-screen keyboard hides.
 *
 * iOS Safari does not shrink the layout viewport for the keyboard; only
 * window.visualViewport shrinks (and pans via offsetTop). A composer pinned
 * with `bottom: 0` therefore sits behind the keyboard. Callers position the
 * chat panel's bottom edge at `keyboardPx` (or the tab bar when closed).
 */
export const KEYBOARD_MIN_PX = 120;

export interface ViewportFrame {
  keyboardPx: number;
  offsetTop: number;
  viewportHeight: number;
}

interface VVLike {
  height: number;
  offsetTop: number;
  addEventListener(type: string, fn: () => void): void;
  removeEventListener(type: string, fn: () => void): void;
}

export function computeViewportFrame(
  layoutHeight: number,
  vv: { height: number; offsetTop: number } | null | undefined,
): ViewportFrame {
  if (!vv) return { keyboardPx: 0, offsetTop: 0, viewportHeight: Math.round(layoutHeight) };
  const raw = layoutHeight - vv.height - vv.offsetTop;
  return {
    keyboardPx: raw > KEYBOARD_MIN_PX ? Math.round(raw) : 0,
    offsetTop: Math.max(0, Math.round(vv.offsetTop)),
    viewportHeight: Math.round(vv.height),
  };
}

export function useKeyboardInset(): ViewportFrame {
  const [frame, setFrame] = useState<ViewportFrame>({ keyboardPx: 0, offsetTop: 0, viewportHeight: 0 });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const vv = (window as unknown as { visualViewport?: VVLike | null }).visualViewport ?? null;
    const update = () => {
      const next = computeViewportFrame(window.innerHeight, vv);
      setFrame((prev) =>
        prev.keyboardPx === next.keyboardPx &&
        prev.offsetTop === next.offsetTop &&
        prev.viewportHeight === next.viewportHeight
          ? prev
          : next,
      );
    };
    update();
    if (!vv) {
      window.addEventListener('resize', update);
      return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', update);
    }
    vv.addEventListener('resize', update);
    vv.addEventListener('scroll', update);
    return () => {
      vv.removeEventListener('resize', update);
      vv.removeEventListener('scroll', update);
    };
  }, []);
  return frame;
}
```

Create `apps/web-next/src/app/app/_lib/useStickToBottom.ts`:

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';

/** Rule: follow new content only while the user is at (or near) the bottom. */
export const STICK_THRESHOLD_PX = 80;

const useIsoLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;

export function isNearBottom(
  el: { scrollTop: number; scrollHeight: number; clientHeight: number },
  threshold = STICK_THRESHOLD_PX,
): boolean {
  return el.scrollHeight - el.scrollTop - el.clientHeight <= threshold;
}

export function useStickToBottom(
  ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
  contentKey: unknown,
): { hasUnseen: boolean; scrollToBottom: () => void } {
  const stick = useRef(true);
  const [hasUnseen, setHasUnseen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const onScroll = () => {
      stick.current = isNearBottom(el);
      if (stick.current) setHasUnseen(false);
    };
    el.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => el.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
  }, [ref]);

  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    if (stick.current) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
    else setHasUnseen(true);
  }, [ref, contentKey]);

  const scrollToBottom = useCallback(() => {
    stick.current = true;
    setHasUnseen(false);
    const el = ref.current;
    if (el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
  }, [ref]);

  return { hasUnseen, scrollToBottom };
}
```

```ts
import type { ChatPlanStep, ChatReply, ChatTurn } from '@/app/app/_lib/api';
import type { FromReceiptResult } from '@/lib/mobile/types';

/** AbAgentSession.expiresAt = creation + 24h (agent-planner.ts createSession). */
export const PENDING_PLAN_TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
/** agent/message falls back to 60 s when the limiter supplies no retryAfterMs. */
export const DEFAULT_RETRY_AFTER_MS = 60_000;

export type FailureKind = 'offline' | 'server' | 'rate_limited';
export type PlanState = 'open' | 'proceeding' | 'cancelling' | 'done';

export interface UserItem {
  id: string;
  kind: 'user';
  text: string;
  status: 'sending' | 'sent' | 'failed';
  failure?: FailureKind;
}
export interface BotItem {
  id: string;
  kind: 'bot';
  text: string;
  plan: { steps: ChatPlanStep[] } | null;
  pendingFromHistory: boolean;
  planState: PlanState | null;
  suggestions: string[];
  undoAvailable: boolean;
  errorKey: 'action_failed' | null;
}
export interface ReceiptItem {
  id: string;
  kind: 'receipt';
  status: 'uploading' | 'done' | 'failed';
  idempotencyKey: string;
  result: FromReceiptResult | null;
}
export type ChatItem = UserItem | BotItem | ReceiptItem;

export interface ChatState {
  history: 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';
  items: ChatItem[];
  busy: boolean;
  rateLimitedUntil: number | null;
  rateLimitMessage: string | null;
}

export const initialChatState: ChatState = {
  history: 'loading',
  items: [],
  busy: false,
  rateLimitedUntil: null,
  rateLimitMessage: null,
};

export type ChatAction =
  | { type: 'history_loading' }
  | { type: 'history_loaded'; turns: ChatTurn[]; now: number }
  | { type: 'history_failed' }
  | { type: 'send_started'; id: string; text: string }
  | { type: 'retry_started'; id: string }
  | { type: 'send_failed'; id: string; failure: FailureKind }
  | { type: 'reply'; userId: string | null; replyId: string; reply: ChatReply }
  | { type: 'action_started'; botId: string; action: 'confirm' | 'cancel' }
  | { type: 'undo_started'; botId: string }
  | { type: 'action_failed'; botId: string; errorId: string; restoreUndo: boolean }
  | { type: 'rate_limited'; until: number; message: string | null }
  | { type: 'rate_limit_cleared' }
  | { type: 'receipt_started'; id: string; idempotencyKey: string }
  | { type: 'receipt_done'; id: string; result: FromReceiptResult }
  | { type: 'receipt_failed'; id: string };

function bot(id: string, text: string): BotItem {
  return {
    id, kind: 'bot', text, plan: null, pendingFromHistory: false, planState: null,
    suggestions: [], undoAvailable: false, errorKey: null,
  };
}

function botFromReply(id: string, reply: ChatReply): BotItem {
  const confirm = reply.plan?.requiresConfirmation === true;
  return {
    ...bot(id, typeof reply.message === 'string' ? reply.message : ''),
    plan: confirm ? { steps: Array.isArray(reply.plan?.steps) ? reply.plan!.steps : [] } : null,
    planState: confirm ? 'open' : null,
    suggestions: Array.isArray(reply.suggestions)
      ? reply.suggestions.filter((s) => typeof s === 'string' && s.trim() !== '').slice(0, 4)
      : [],
    undoAvailable: reply.undoAvailable === true,
  };
}

export function historyToItems(turns: ChatTurn[], now: number): ChatItem[] {
  const items: ChatItem[] = turns.map((turn, i) =>
    turn.role === 'user'
      ? ({ id: `h-${i}`, kind: 'user', text: turn.text, status: 'sent' } as UserItem)
      : bot(`h-${i}`, turn.text),
  );
  const last = turns[turns.length - 1] as (ChatTurn & { intent?: string }) | undefined;
  if (last && last.role === 'bot' && last.intent === 'planner') {
    const age = now - Date.parse(last.at);
    if (Number.isFinite(age) && age >= 0 && age < PENDING_PLAN_TTL_MS) {
      const idx = items.length - 1;
      items[idx] = { ...(items[idx] as BotItem), pendingFromHistory: true, planState: 'open' };
    }
  }
  return items;
}

const mapBot = (items: ChatItem[], id: string, f: (b: BotItem) => BotItem): ChatItem[] =>
  items.map((it) => (it.kind === 'bot' && it.id === id ? f(it) : it));
const mapUser = (items: ChatItem[], id: string, f: (u: UserItem) => UserItem): ChatItem[] =>
  items.map((it) => (it.kind === 'user' && it.id === id ? f(it) : it));
const mapReceipt = (items: ChatItem[], id: string, f: (r: ReceiptItem) => ReceiptItem): ChatItem[] =>
  items.map((it) => (it.kind === 'receipt' && it.id === id ? f(it) : it));

export function chatReducer(state: ChatState, action: ChatAction): ChatState {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'history_loading':
      return { ...state, history: 'loading' };
    case 'history_loaded':
      return { ...state, history: 'ready', items: [...historyToItems(action.turns, action.now), ...state.items] };
    case 'history_failed':
      return { ...state, history: 'error' };
    case 'send_started':
      return {
        ...state,
        busy: true,
        items: [...state.items, { id: action.id, kind: 'user', text: action.text, status: 'sending' }],
      };
    case 'retry_started':
      return { ...state, busy: true, items: mapUser(state.items, action.id, (u) => ({ ...u, status: 'sending', failure: undefined })) };
    case 'send_failed':
      return { ...state, busy: false, items: mapUser(state.items, action.id, (u) => ({ ...u, status: 'failed', failure: action.failure })) };
    case 'reply': {
      const next = botFromReply(action.replyId, action.reply);
      const items = state.items.map((it): ChatItem => {
        if (it.kind === 'user' && action.userId && it.id === action.userId) {
          return { ...it, status: 'sent', failure: undefined };
        }
        if (it.kind !== 'bot') return it;
        let b = it;
        if (b.planState === 'proceeding' || b.planState === 'cancelling') b = { ...b, planState: 'done' };
        if (next.planState === 'open' && b.planState === 'open') b = { ...b, planState: 'done' };
        if (b.undoAvailable) b = { ...b, undoAvailable: false };
        return b;
      });
      return { ...state, busy: false, items: [...items, next] };
    }
    case 'action_started':
      return {
        ...state,
        busy: true,
        items: mapBot(state.items, action.botId, (b) => ({
          ...b, planState: action.action === 'confirm' ? 'proceeding' : 'cancelling',
        })),
      };
    case 'undo_started':
      return { ...state, busy: true, items: mapBot(state.items, action.botId, (b) => ({ ...b, undoAvailable: false })) };
    case 'action_failed': {
      const items = mapBot(state.items, action.botId, (b) => ({
        ...b,
        planState: b.planState === 'proceeding' || b.planState === 'cancelling' ? 'open' : b.planState,
        undoAvailable: action.restoreUndo ? true : b.undoAvailable,
      }));
      return { ...state, busy: false, items: [...items, { ...bot(action.errorId, ''), errorKey: 'action_failed' }] };
    }
    case 'rate_limited':
      return { ...state, rateLimitedUntil: action.until, rateLimitMessage: action.message };
    case 'rate_limit_cleared':
      return { ...state, rateLimitedUntil: null, rateLimitMessage: null };
    case 'receipt_started': {
      const exists = state.items.some((it) => it.kind === 'receipt' && it.id === action.id);
      return exists
        ? { ...state, items: mapReceipt(state.items, action.id, (r) => ({ ...r, status: 'uploading' })) }
        : {
            ...state,
            items: [...state.items, { id: action.id, kind: 'receipt', status: 'uploading', idempotencyKey: action.idempotencyKey, result: null }],
          };
    }
    case 'receipt_done':
      return { ...state, items: mapReceipt(state.items, action.id, (r) => ({ ...r, status: 'done', result: action.result })) };
    case 'receipt_failed':
      return { ...state, items: mapReceipt(state.items, action.id, (r) => ({ ...r, status: 'failed' })) };
    default:
      return state;
  }
}

type ErrLike = { status?: number; code?: string; retryAfterMs?: number; message?: string } | null | undefined;

export function classifyFailure(err: unknown, online: boolean): FailureKind {
  const e = (typeof err === 'object' ? err : null) as ErrLike;
  if (e?.status === 429) return 'rate_limited';
  if (!online || err instanceof TypeError || e?.status === 0 || e?.code === 'offline') return 'offline';
  return 'server';
}

export function retryAfterFrom(err: unknown): number {
  const ms = (typeof err === 'object' && err ? (err as ErrLike)?.retryAfterMs : undefined);
  return typeof ms === 'number' && ms > 0 ? ms : DEFAULT_RETRY_AFTER_MS;
}

/** The server's localized 429 `message`, when api.ts surfaced it (not a machine code). */
export function serverMessage(err: unknown): string | null {
  if (!(err instanceof Error)) return null;
  const m = err.message.trim();
  if (!m || m === 'rate_limited' || /^[a-z_]+$/.test(m)) return null;
  return m;
}
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import { ShellContextReact } from '@/contexts/shell-context';
import { createTranslator } from '@agentbook/i18n';
import { CATALOG } from '@agentbook/i18n/catalog';

export interface Call { method: string; path: string; body: unknown }

/** Mock global fetch (never the api module): api.ts's real request/error code runs. */
export function installFetch(handler: (call: Call) => Response | Promise<Response>) {
  const calls: Call[] = [];
  const fn = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
    const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input instanceof URL ? input.href : input.url;
    const path = new URL(url, 'http://localhost').pathname;
    const method = (init?.method ?? (typeof input === 'object' && 'method' in input ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase();
    let body: unknown = init?.body;
    if (typeof body === 'string') {
      try { body = JSON.parse(body); } catch { /* keep raw string */ }
    }
    const call = { method, path, body };
    calls.push(call);
    return handler(call);
  });
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fn);
  return { calls, fn };
}

export const json = (status: number, payload: unknown, headers: Record<string, string> = {}) =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), { status, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', ...headers } });

/** Real translator + CAD money, so tests assert real copy and catch hardcoded strings. */
export function withShell(ui: React.ReactElement, locale = 'en') {
  const tr = createTranslator(locale, CATALOG);
  const value = {
    i18n: {
      locale,
      currency: 'CAD',
      t: (k: string, p?: Record<string, string | number>) => tr.t(k, p),
      formatMoney: (cents: number) =>
        new Intl.NumberFormat('en-CA', { style: 'currency', currency: 'CAD' }).format(cents / 100),
    },
  } as unknown as React.ContextType<typeof ShellContextReact>;
  return <ShellContextReact.Provider value={value}>{ui}</ShellContextReact.Provider>;
}
```

```ts
'use client';

import { useContext } from 'react';
import { ShellContextReact } from '@/contexts/shell-context';

/**
 * Money in the TENANT currency via the shell's formatMoney. Without a provider,
 * a bare 2-decimal number, never a guessed currency symbol.
 */
export function useTenantMoney(): (cents: number) => string {
  const fmt = useContext(ShellContextReact)?.i18n?.formatMoney;
  return (cents: number) => (fmt ? fmt(cents) : (cents / 100).toFixed(2));
}
```

Create `apps/web-next/src/app/app/chat/_components/ChatParts.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import type { TFn } from '@/hooks/use-t';
import { MessageBody } from './MessageBody';
import { useTenantMoney } from '../_lib/use-tenant-money';
import type { BotItem, PlanState, ReceiptItem, UserItem } from '../_lib/chat-reducer';
import type { ChatPlanStep } from '@/app/app/_lib/api';

const TAP = 44;
const bubble: React.CSSProperties = {
  padding: '10px 12px', borderRadius: 16, fontSize: 15, lineHeight: 1.45, overflowWrap: 'anywhere',
};
const muted: React.CSSProperties = { fontSize: 13, color: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' };
const outlineBtn: React.CSSProperties = {
  minHeight: TAP, minWidth: TAP, padding: '0 14px', borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 500,
  border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', background: 'hsl(var(--background))', color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))',
};
const solidBtn: React.CSSProperties = {
  ...outlineBtn, border: '1px solid hsl(var(--foreground))',
  background: 'hsl(var(--foreground))', color: 'hsl(var(--background))',
};
const chip: React.CSSProperties = {
  minHeight: TAP, padding: '0 14px', borderRadius: 22, fontSize: 14,
  border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', background: 'hsl(var(--muted))', color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))',
};

export function UserBubble({ item, t, onRetry, retryDisabled }: {
  item: UserItem; t: TFn; onRetry: (item: UserItem) => void; retryDisabled: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div data-testid="chat-bubble-user" data-status={item.status}
      style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-end', maxWidth: '85%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 4 }}>
      <div style={{
        ...bubble, whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', background: 'hsl(var(--primary) / 0.16)',
        color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))', opacity: item.status === 'sending' ? 0.7 : 1,
      }}>
        {item.text}
      </div>
      {item.status === 'failed' && (
        <div role="alert" style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, fontSize: 13, color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))' }}>
          <span aria-hidden style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: 4, background: 'hsl(var(--destructive))' }} />
          <span>{item.failure === 'offline' ? t('mobile.chat.not_sent_offline') : t('mobile.chat.not_sent')}</span>
          <button type="button" data-testid="chat-retry" onClick={() => onRetry(item)} disabled={retryDisabled} style={outlineBtn}>
            {t('mobile.chat.retry')}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function PlanCard({ steps, state, pending, t, disabled, onProceed, onCancel }: {
  steps: ChatPlanStep[]; state: PlanState; pending: boolean; t: TFn; disabled: boolean;
  onProceed: () => void; onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div data-testid={pending ? 'chat-plan-pending' : 'chat-plan-card'} data-state={state}
      style={{ marginTop: 8, padding: 10, borderRadius: 12, border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', background: 'hsl(var(--background))' }}>
      <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 6 }}>
        {pending ? t('mobile.chat.pending_title') : t('mobile.chat.plan_title')}
      </div>
      {!pending && steps.length > 0 && (
        <ol style={{ margin: '0 0 8px', paddingLeft: 20, fontSize: 14 }}>
          {steps.map((s, i) => <li key={s.id || i}>{s.description}</li>)}
        </ol>
      )}
      {state === 'open' && (
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
          <button type="button" data-testid="chat-plan-proceed" disabled={disabled} onClick={onProceed} style={solidBtn}>
            {t('mobile.chat.proceed')}
          </button>
          <button type="button" data-testid="chat-plan-cancel" disabled={disabled} onClick={onCancel} style={outlineBtn}>
            {t('mobile.chat.cancel')}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {(state === 'proceeding' || state === 'cancelling') && <div role="status" style={muted}>{t('mobile.chat.plan_working')}</div>}
      {state === 'done' && <div style={muted}>{t('mobile.chat.plan_resolved')}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function SuggestionChips({ items, onPick, disabled, testId }: {
  items: string[]; onPick: (text: string) => void; disabled: boolean; testId: 'chat-suggestion' | 'chat-starter';
}) {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 6 }}>
      {items.map((s) => (
        <button key={s} type="button" data-testid={testId} disabled={disabled} onClick={() => onPick(s)} style={chip}>
          {s}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function BotBubble({ item, t, busy, sendBlocked, onProceed, onCancel, onUndo, onSuggestion }: {
  item: BotItem; t: TFn; busy: boolean; sendBlocked: boolean;
  onProceed: (item: BotItem) => void; onCancel: (item: BotItem) => void;
  onUndo: (item: BotItem) => void; onSuggestion: (text: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div data-testid="chat-bubble-bot" style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start', maxWidth: '88%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
      <div style={{ ...bubble, background: 'hsl(var(--card))', color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))', border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))' }}>
        {item.errorKey === 'action_failed'
          ? <span role="alert">{t('mobile.chat.action_failed')}</span>
          : <MessageBody text={item.text} />}
        {item.planState && (item.plan || item.pendingFromHistory) && (
          <PlanCard
            steps={item.plan?.steps ?? []}
            state={item.planState}
            pending={item.pendingFromHistory}
            t={t}
            disabled={busy}
            onProceed={() => onProceed(item)}
            onCancel={() => onCancel(item)}
          />
        )}
      </div>
      {item.undoAvailable && (
        <button type="button" data-testid="chat-undo" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onUndo(item)} style={{ ...outlineBtn, alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}>
          {t('mobile.chat.undo')}
        </button>
      )}
      {item.suggestions.length > 0 && (
        <SuggestionChips items={item.suggestions} onPick={onSuggestion} disabled={busy || sendBlocked} testId="chat-suggestion" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function TypingIndicator({ label }: { label: string }) {
  return (
    <div data-testid="chat-typing" role="status" aria-label={label}
      style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start', display: 'flex', gap: 4, padding: '12px 14px', borderRadius: 16, background: 'hsl(var(--card))', border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))' }}>
      <style>{'@keyframes abChatDot{0%,80%,100%{opacity:.25}40%{opacity:1}}'}</style>
      {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
        <span key={i} aria-hidden style={{
          width: 7, height: 7, borderRadius: 4, background: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))',
          animation: `abChatDot 1.2s ${i * 0.2}s infinite ease-in-out`,
        }} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function RateLimitNotice({ t, message, seconds }: { t: TFn; message: string | null; seconds: number }) {
  return (
    <div data-testid="chat-ratelimit" role="status" aria-live="polite"
      style={{ margin: '0 12px 8px', padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 13, background: 'hsl(var(--warning) / 0.15)', color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))' }}>
      <div>{message ?? t('mobile.chat.rate_limited', { seconds })}</div>
      <div style={muted}>{t('mobile.chat.rate_limited_wait', { seconds })}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ReceiptCard({ item, t, onRetry }: { item: ReceiptItem; t: TFn; onRetry: (item: ReceiptItem) => void }) {
  const money = useTenantMoney();
  const box: React.CSSProperties = {
    alignSelf: 'flex-end', maxWidth: '85%', padding: 12, borderRadius: 16, fontSize: 14,
    border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', background: 'hsl(var(--card))', color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))',
    display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6,
  };
  if (item.status === 'uploading') {
    return <div data-testid="chat-receipt" data-status="uploading" role="status" style={box}>{t('mobile.chat.receipt_uploading')}</div>;
  }
  if (item.status === 'failed' || !item.result) {
    return (
      <div data-testid="chat-receipt" data-status="failed" role="alert" style={box}>
        <span>{t('mobile.chat.receipt_failed')}</span>
        <button type="button" data-testid="chat-receipt-retry" onClick={() => onRetry(item)} style={{ ...outlineBtn, alignSelf: 'flex-start' }}>
          {t('mobile.chat.retry')}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const { doc, duplicate } = item.result;
  const label = duplicate
    ? t('mobile.chat.receipt_duplicate')
    : doc.status === 'pending_review'
      ? t('mobile.chat.receipt_needs_review')
      : t('mobile.chat.receipt_saved');
  return (
    <div data-testid="chat-receipt" data-status="done" style={box}>
      <strong>{label}</strong>
      <span>
        {doc.vendorName ? `${doc.vendorName} · ` : ''}
        {doc.amountCents > 0 ? money(doc.amountCents) : t('mobile.chat.unreadable_amount')}
      </span>
      <Link href={`/app/docs/${doc.id}`} data-testid="chat-receipt-open"
        style={{ ...outlineBtn, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', alignSelf: 'flex-start', textDecoration: 'none' }}>
        {t('mobile.chat.receipt_open')}
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Paperclip, Send } from 'lucide-react';
import type { TFn } from '@/hooks/use-t';

const iconBtn: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: 44, height: 44, flexShrink: 0, borderRadius: 22, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
  border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', background: 'hsl(var(--background))', color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))',
};
const sheetBtn: React.CSSProperties = {
  minHeight: 44, padding: '0 14px', borderRadius: 12, fontSize: 14,
  border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', background: 'hsl(var(--background))', color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))',
};

export function Composer({ t, value, onChange, onSend, sendDisabled, onPhoto }: {
  t: TFn; value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; onSend: () => void; sendDisabled: boolean;
  onPhoto: (file: File) => void;
}) {
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState(false);
  const cameraRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const libraryRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const taRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const ta = taRef.current;
    if (!ta) return;
    ta.style.height = 'auto';
    ta.style.height = `${Math.min(Math.max(ta.scrollHeight, 44), 120)}px`;
  }, [value]);

  const pick = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const f = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = '';
    setSheet(false);
    if (f) onPhoto(f);
  };

  return (
    <div data-testid="chat-composer" style={{
      borderTop: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', background: 'hsl(var(--card))',
      padding: '8px 12px', paddingBottom: 'max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))',
    }}>
      {sheet && (
        <div data-testid="chat-attach-sheet" style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}>
          <button type="button" data-testid="chat-attach-camera" onClick={() => cameraRef.current?.click()} style={sheetBtn}>
            {t('mobile.chat.attach_camera')}
          </button>
          <button type="button" data-testid="chat-attach-library" onClick={() => libraryRef.current?.click()} style={sheetBtn}>
            {t('mobile.chat.attach_library')}
          </button>
          <button type="button" data-testid="chat-attach-close" onClick={() => setSheet(false)} style={sheetBtn}>
            {t('mobile.chat.attach_close')}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <input ref={cameraRef} data-testid="chat-file-camera" type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment" hidden onChange={pick} />
      <input ref={libraryRef} data-testid="chat-file-library" type="file" accept="image/*" hidden onChange={pick} />
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 8 }}>
        <button type="button" data-testid="chat-attach" aria-label={t('mobile.chat.attach')} aria-expanded={sheet}
          onClick={() => setSheet((s) => !s)} style={iconBtn}>
          <Paperclip aria-hidden style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }} />
        </button>
        <textarea
          ref={taRef}
          data-testid="chat-input"
          rows={1}
          value={value}
          enterKeyHint="send"
          aria-label={t('mobile.chat.placeholder')}
          placeholder={t('mobile.chat.placeholder')}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            // isComposing: an IME (zh-CN pinyin) uses Enter to commit a candidate.
            if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
              e.preventDefault();
              if (!sendDisabled) onSend();
            }
          }}
          style={{
            flex: 1, resize: 'none', minHeight: 44, maxHeight: 120, padding: '11px 14px', borderRadius: 22,
            border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', background: 'hsl(var(--background))',
            color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))', fontSize: 16, lineHeight: '20px',
          }}
        />
        <button type="button" data-testid="chat-send" aria-label={t('mobile.chat.send')} disabled={sendDisabled}
          onClick={onSend} style={{ ...iconBtn, opacity: sendDisabled ? 0.5 : 1 }}>
          <Send aria-hidden style={{ width: 20, height: 20 }} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Note: `fireEvent.keyDown(input, { isComposing: true })` sets `nativeEvent.isComposing` in jsdom, which the IME assertion relies on.

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { installFetch, json, withShell, type Call } from './chat-test-utils';

vi.mock('@/app/app/_lib/image', () => ({ compressImage: vi.fn(async (f: File) => f) }));

import MobileChat from '../../../app/app/chat/page';

const THREAD = { id: 'th1', channel: 'web', chatId: 'maya', status: 'active', lastActiveAt: '2026-10-07T00:00:00Z', summary: null, lastTurn: null };
const MSG = '/api/v1/agentbook-core/agent/message';
const ago = (ms: number) => new Date(Date.now() - ms).toISOString();
const ok = (data: unknown) => json(200, { success: true, data });

function server(opts: {
  turns?: unknown[] | null;          // null = no web thread
  threadsStatus?: number;
  reply?: (call: Call) => Response | Promise<Response>;
}) {
  return installFetch(async (call) => {
    if (call.path === '/api/v1/agentbook-core/threads') {
      if (opts.threadsStatus && opts.threadsStatus !== 200) return json(opts.threadsStatus, { success: false, error: 'boom' });
      return ok(opts.turns === null || opts.turns === undefined ? [] : [THREAD]);
    }
    if (call.path === '/api/v1/agentbook-core/threads/th1/turns') return ok(opts.turns ?? []);
    if (call.path === MSG && call.method === 'POST') {
      return opts.reply ? opts.reply(call) : ok({ message: 'ok', skillUsed: 'general-question', confidence: 1 });
    }
    return json(404, { success: false, error: `unmocked ${call.method} ${call.path}` });
  });
}
const posts = (calls: Call[]) => calls.filter((c) => c.path === MSG && c.method === 'POST');
const type = (text: string) => fireEvent.change(screen.getByTestId('chat-input'), { target: { value: text } });
const send = () => fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId('chat-send'));

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'onLine', { value: true, configurable: true });
});

describe('MobileChat — history states', () => {

    installFetch(() => new Promise<Response>(() => {}));

  });

  it('undo: posts sessionAction undo and hides the button afterwards', async () => {
    let n = 0;
    const { calls } = server({

    expect(bubble).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('chat-bubble-user')).toHaveAttribute('data-status', 'sent');
    expect(posts(calls).map((c) => (c.body as { text: string }).text)).toEqual(['keep this text', 'keep this text']);

  it('offline failure uses the offline copy and shows the offline banner', async () => {

    render(withShell(<MobileChat />));
    await screen.findByTestId('chat-empty');
    Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'onLine', { value: false, configurable: true });
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('offline'));

    type('hi');
    send();
    expect(await screen.findByText("You're offline — not sent.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('429: shows the server message, disables send + retry, re-enables after retryAfterMs', async () => {
    server({
      turns: [],
      reply: () => json(429, { success: false, error: 'rate_limited', reason: 'minute', retryAfterMs: 1200, message: 'Slow down — try again shortly.', locale: 'en' }, { 'Retry-After': '2' }),
    });
    render(withShell(<MobileChat />));
    await screen.findByTestId('chat-empty');
    type('hi');
    send();
    const notice = await screen.findByTestId('chat-ratelimit');
    expect(notice).toHaveTextContent('Slow down — try again shortly.');
    expect(notice).toHaveTextContent(/Send available in \ds/);
    type('again');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('chat-send')).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('chat-retry')).toBeDisabled();
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByTestId('chat-ratelimit')).toBeNull(), { timeout: 3500 });
    expect(screen.getByTestId('chat-send')).toBeEnabled();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('chat-retry')).toBeEnabled();
  });
});

describe('MobileChat — localization', () => {
  it('renders zh-CN copy from the catalog (no hardcoded English)', async () => {
    server({ turns: null });
    render(withShell(<MobileChat />, 'zh-CN'));

    expect(screen.getByTestId('chat-header')).toHaveTextContent('咨询您的顾问');
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: '发送消息' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```
