```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useReducer, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useT } from '@/hooks/use-t';
import { loadChatHistory, sendChat, uploadReceipt } from '@/app/app/_lib/api';
import { compressImage } from '@/app/app/_lib/image';
import { useKeyboardInset } from '@/app/app/_lib/useKeyboardInset';
import { useStickToBottom } from '@/app/app/_lib/useStickToBottom';
import {
  chatReducer, initialChatState, classifyFailure, retryAfterFrom, serverMessage,
  type BotItem, type ReceiptItem, type UserItem,
} from './_lib/chat-reducer';
import {
  BotBubble, ReceiptCard, RateLimitNotice, SuggestionChips, TypingIndicator, UserBubble,
} from './_components/ChatParts';
import { Composer } from './_components/Composer';

function newId(): string {
  if (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
  return `id-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
}
const isOnline = () => (typeof navigator === 'undefined' ? true : navigator.onLine !== false);
const TABBAR_FALLBACK_PX = 64;

export default function MobileChat() {
  const t = useT();
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(chatReducer, initialChatState);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(true);
  const [topPx, setTopPx] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [tabbarPx, setTabbarPx] = useState(TABBAR_FALLBACK_PX);
  const files = useRef(new Map<string, File>());
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const anchorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const historyStarted = useRef(false);
  const frame = useKeyboardInset();
  const { hasUnseen, scrollToBottom } = useStickToBottom(listRef, `${state.items.length}:${state.busy}:${state.history}`);

  // ── History: the active web thread, oldest-first (C4 loadChatHistory). ──
  const loadHistory = useCallback(async () => {
    dispatch({ type: 'history_loading' });
    try {
      const turns = await loadChatHistory();
      dispatch({ type: 'history_loaded', turns, now: Date.now() });
    } catch {
      dispatch({ type: 'history_failed' });
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (historyStarted.current) return; // StrictMode double-mount must not load twice
    historyStarted.current = true;
    void loadHistory();
  }, [loadHistory]);

  // ── Connectivity ──
  useEffect(() => {
    setOnline(isOnline());
    const up = () => setOnline(true);
    const down = () => setOnline(false);
    window.addEventListener('online', up);
    window.addEventListener('offline', down);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', up);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', down);
    };
  }, []);

  // ── 429 countdown ──
  useEffect(() => {
    const until = state.rateLimitedUntil;
    if (until === null) return;
    const tick = () => {
      const n = Date.now();
      setNow(n);
      if (n >= until) dispatch({ type: 'rate_limit_cleared' });
    };
    tick();
    const h = window.setInterval(tick, 250);
    return () => window.clearInterval(h);
  }, [state.rateLimitedUntil]);
  const rateLimited = state.rateLimitedUntil !== null && now < state.rateLimitedUntil;
  const secondsLeft = rateLimited ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil((state.rateLimitedUntil! - now) / 1000)) : 0;

  // ── Layout: fixed panel between the shell header and the tab bar / keyboard ──
  useEffect(() => {
    const measure = () => {
      const a = anchorRef.current;
      if (a) setTopPx(Math.max(0, Math.round(a.getBoundingClientRect().top)));
      const bar = document.querySelector('[data-testid="tabbar"]');
      setTabbarPx(bar ? Math.round(bar.getBoundingClientRect().height) || TABBAR_FALLBACK_PX : TABBAR_FALLBACK_PX);
    };
    measure();
    window.addEventListener('resize', measure);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', measure);
  }, []);
  const keyboardOpen = frame.keyboardPx > 0;
  const panelStyle: React.CSSProperties =
    topPx === null
      ? { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: 'calc(100dvh - 140px)' }
      : {
          position: 'fixed', left: 0, right: 0,
          top: topPx + frame.offsetTop,
          bottom: keyboardOpen ? frame.keyboardPx : tabbarPx,
          display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column',
        };

  // ── Sending ──
  const performSend = useCallback(async (userId: string, text: string) => {
    try {
      const reply = await sendChat({ text });
      dispatch({ type: 'reply', userId, replyId: newId(), reply });
    } catch (err) {
      const failure = classifyFailure(err, isOnline());
      if (failure === 'rate_limited') {
        dispatch({ type: 'rate_limited', until: Date.now() + retryAfterFrom(err), message: serverMessage(err) });
      }
      dispatch({ type: 'send_failed', id: userId, failure });
    }
  }, []);

  const sendText = useCallback((raw: string) => {
    const text = raw.trim();
    if (!text || state.busy || rateLimited) return;
    const id = newId();
    dispatch({ type: 'send_started', id, text });
    setDraft('');
    scrollToBottom();
    void performSend(id, text);
  }, [state.busy, rateLimited, performSend, scrollToBottom]);

  const retry = useCallback((item: UserItem) => {
    if (state.busy || rateLimited) return;
    dispatch({ type: 'retry_started', id: item.id });
    void performSend(item.id, item.text);
  }, [state.busy, rateLimited, performSend]);

  // Session actions are exempt from the rate limiter server-side: allowed during a countdown.
  const sessionAction = useCallback(async (bot: BotItem, action: 'confirm' | 'cancel') => {
    if (state.busy) return;
    dispatch({ type: 'action_started', botId: bot.id, action });
    try {
      const reply = await sendChat({ sessionAction: action });
      dispatch({ type: 'reply', userId: null, replyId: newId(), reply });
    } catch {
      dispatch({ type: 'action_failed', botId: bot.id, errorId: newId(), restoreUndo: false });
    }
  }, [state.busy]);

  const undo = useCallback(async (bot: BotItem) => {
    if (state.busy) return;
    dispatch({ type: 'undo_started', botId: bot.id });
    try {
      const reply = await sendChat({ sessionAction: 'undo' });
      dispatch({ type: 'reply', userId: null, replyId: newId(), reply });
    } catch {
      dispatch({ type: 'action_failed', botId: bot.id, errorId: newId(), restoreUndo: true });
    }
  }, [state.busy]);

  // ── Photo → from-receipt (D1). Same idempotencyKey on retry = never two expenses. ──
  const startReceipt = useCallback(async (id: string, idempotencyKey: string, original: File) => {
    files.current.set(id, original);
    dispatch({ type: 'receipt_started', id, idempotencyKey });
    scrollToBottom();
    try {
      let upload: File = original;
      try { upload = await compressImage(original); } catch { upload = original; }
      const result = await uploadReceipt(upload, { idempotencyKey });
      files.current.delete(id);
      dispatch({ type: 'receipt_done', id, result });
    } catch {
      dispatch({ type: 'receipt_failed', id });
    }
  }, [scrollToBottom]);
  const onPhoto = useCallback((file: File) => { void startReceipt(newId(), newId(), file); }, [startReceipt]);
  const retryReceipt = useCallback((item: ReceiptItem) => {
    const f = files.current.get(item.id);
    if (f) void startReceipt(item.id, item.idempotencyKey, f);
  }, [startReceipt]);

  const starters = [
    t('mobile.chat.starter_briefing'),
    t('mobile.chat.starter_spend'),
    t('mobile.chat.starter_log'),
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <div ref={anchorRef} aria-hidden style={{ height: 0 }} />
      <section data-testid="chat-screen" aria-labelledby="chat-title" style={{ ...panelStyle, background: 'hsl(var(--background))', color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))' }}>
        <header data-testid="chat-header" style={{ padding: '10px 16px', borderBottom: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))' }}>
          <h1 id="chat-title" style={{ fontSize: 18, fontWeight: 600, margin: 0 }}>{t('mobile.chat.title')}</h1>
          <p style={{ fontSize: 13, margin: 0, color: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }}>{t('mobile.chat.subtitle')}</p>
        </header>

        {!online && (
          <div data-testid="chat-offline" role="status" style={{ padding: '8px 16px', fontSize: 13, background: 'hsl(var(--muted))' }}>
            {t('mobile.chat.offline_banner')}
          </div>
        )}

        <div ref={listRef} data-testid="chat-list" role="log" aria-live="polite"
          style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflowY: 'auto', padding: '12px 12px 16px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10, overscrollBehavior: 'contain' }}>
          {state.history === 'loading' && (
            <div data-testid="chat-history-loading" role="status" style={{ alignSelf: 'center', fontSize: 14, color: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))' }}>
              {t('mobile.chat.history_loading')}
            </div>
          )}
          {state.history === 'error' && (
            <div data-testid="chat-history-error" role="alert" style={{ alignSelf: 'center', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, fontSize: 14 }}>
              <span>{t('mobile.chat.history_error')}</span>
              <button type="button" data-testid="chat-history-retry" onClick={() => void loadHistory()}
                style={{ minHeight: 44, padding: '0 16px', borderRadius: 12, border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', background: 'hsl(var(--background))', color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))' }}>
                {t('mobile.chat.retry')}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
          {state.history === 'ready' && state.items.length === 0 && (
            <div data-testid="chat-empty" style={{ margin: 'auto 0', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <p style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 500, margin: 0 }}>{t('mobile.chat.empty_title')}</p>
              <SuggestionChips items={starters} onPick={sendText} disabled={state.busy || rateLimited} testId="chat-starter" />
            </div>
          )}

          {state.items.map((item) => {
            if (item.kind === 'user') {
              return <UserBubble key={item.id} item={item} t={t} onRetry={retry} retryDisabled={state.busy || rateLimited} />;
            }
            if (item.kind === 'receipt') {
              return <ReceiptCard key={item.id} item={item} t={t} onRetry={retryReceipt} />;
            }
            return (
              <BotBubble key={item.id} item={item} t={t} busy={state.busy} sendBlocked={rateLimited}
                onProceed={(b) => void sessionAction(b, 'confirm')}
                onCancel={(b) => void sessionAction(b, 'cancel')}
                onUndo={(b) => void undo(b)}
                onSuggestion={sendText} />
            );
          })}

          {state.busy && <TypingIndicator label={t('mobile.chat.typing')} />}
        </div>

        {hasUnseen && (
          <button type="button" data-testid="chat-new-messages" onClick={scrollToBottom}
            style={{ alignSelf: 'center', marginTop: -52, marginBottom: 8, minHeight: 44, padding: '0 16px', borderRadius: 22, border: '1px solid hsl(var(--border))', background: 'hsl(var(--card))', color: 'hsl(var(--foreground))', position: 'relative', zIndex: 1 }}>
            {t('mobile.chat.new_messages')}
          </button>
        )}

        {rateLimited && <RateLimitNotice t={t} message={state.rateLimitMessage} seconds={secondsLeft} />}

        <Composer
          t={t}
          value={draft}
          onChange={setDraft}
          onSend={() => sendText(draft)}
          sendDisabled={!draft.trim() || state.busy || rateLimited}
          onPhoto={onPhoto}
        />
      </section>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Task 6.8: E2E — chat journeys + prod transcript replay

**Files**
- Create (only if missing per Task 6.1): `tests/e2e/mobile-app/playwright.config.ts`
- Create: `tests/e2e/mobile-app/page-api.ts`
- Create: `tests/e2e/mobile-app/chat.spec.ts`
- Create: `tests/e2e/mobile-app/chat-replay.spec.ts`

**Interfaces**
- Consumes: `MOBILE_VIEWPORT`, `loginAs(page, persona)`, `settle(page)` from `tests/e2e/mobile-app/helpers.ts` (C5); chat testids (Tasks 6.5/6.6).
- Produces: `inPageFetch(page, method, path, body?)` for PR 7.

Notes that shape these specs:
- `page.route()` does **not** intercept requests a service worker handles, so every spec that intercepts uses `serviceWorkers: 'block'`.
- The plan prompt is deterministic. `"edit my last expense"` matches `edit-expense`'s trigger pattern `edit.*expense`, which is a stage-2 manifest match with no LLM involved. `edit-expense` has `confirmBefore: true`, so agent-brain Step 3b always builds a one-step plan, "Edit expense last", with `requiresConfirmation: true`; the LLM planner is never called. Proceed runs `executeClassification`, which resolves "last" to the most recent expense and `PUT`s it with no field changes, a no-op edit. The loop still tolerates the real LLM-backed stack: up to 3 attempts, clearing any stale session between them, until a terminal state.
- Suggestions are produced only on plan-evaluation paths and can't be reproduced deterministically on prod. So the chip test fulfils the **first** reply with a canned `suggestions[]`, and the chip click goes to the real server.

Create `tests/e2e/mobile-app/page-api.ts`:

```ts
import type { Page } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * Same-origin fetch from inside the page, so the httpOnly session cookie travels.
 * (page.request has not carried it reliably against prod; see project memory.)
 */
export async function inPageFetch<T = unknown>(
  page: Page,
  method: string,
  path: string,
  body?: unknown,
): Promise<{ status: number; data: T | null }> {
  return page.evaluate(
    async ({ m, p, b }) => {
      const r = await fetch(p, {
        method: m,
        credentials: 'include',
        headers: b === undefined ? undefined : { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: b === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(b),
      });
      let data: unknown = null;
      try { data = await r.json(); } catch { data = null; }
      return { status: r.status, data };
    },
    { m: method, p: path, b: body },
  ) as Promise<{ status: number; data: T | null }>;
}
```

```ts
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { MOBILE_VIEWPORT, loginAs, settle } from './helpers';
import { inPageFetch } from './page-api';

test.use({ viewport: MOBILE_VIEWPORT, serviceWorkers: 'block' });
test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });

const MSG = '**/api/v1/agentbook-core/agent/message';
const SAFE_FALLBACK = /I don't want to quote you a number/i;

async function openChat(page: Page) {
  await page.goto('/app/chat');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('chat-screen')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('chat-history-loading')).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 30_000 });
  await expect(page.getByTestId('chat-history-error')).toHaveCount(0);
}
const bots = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId('chat-bubble-bot');
async function send(page: Page, text: string) {
  await page.getByTestId('chat-input').fill(text);
  await page.getByTestId('chat-send').click();
}
async function nextBot(page: Page, before: number) {
  await expect(bots(page)).toHaveCount(before + 1, { timeout: 90_000 });
  const b = bots(page).last();
  await expect(b).not.toHaveText('');
  return b;
}
async function clearSession(page: Page) {
  await inPageFetch(page, 'POST', '/api/v1/agentbook-core/agent/message', { text: '', sessionAction: 'cancel' });
}

test.describe('mobile chat (Maya)', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await loginAs(page, 'maya');
    await settle(page);
  });

  test('history loads after a reload, with the bot reply rendered', async ({ page }) => {
    await openChat(page);
    const marker = `e2e-hist-${Date.now()}`;
    const before = await bots(page).count();
    await send(page, `how much did I spend this month? (${marker})`);
    const reply = await nextBot(page, before);
    await expect(reply).not.toContainText(SAFE_FALLBACK);
    // Turns are written right after the reply; poll a few reloads rather than sleeping.
    await expect(async () => {
      await page.reload();
      await expect(page.getByTestId('chat-bubble-user').filter({ hasText: marker })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 8_000 });
    }).toPass({ timeout: 45_000 });
    const userBubble = page.getByTestId('chat-bubble-user').filter({ hasText: marker });
    await expect(userBubble).toHaveAttribute('data-status', 'sent');
    // The bot turn after it is in history too (oldest-first ordering).
    const all = page.getByTestId(/chat-bubble-(user|bot)/);
    const texts = await all.allTextContents();
    const idx = texts.findIndex((t) => t.includes(marker));
    expect(idx).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(idx).toBeLessThan(texts.length - 1);
  });

  test('a plan renders Proceed/Cancel and Proceed executes', async ({ page }) => {
    await openChat(page);
    await clearSession(page);
    await page.reload();
    await openChat(page);
    let executed = false;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3 && !executed; attempt++) {
      const before = await bots(page).count();
      await send(page, 'edit my last expense');
      const reply = await nextBot(page, before);
      const card = reply.getByTestId('chat-plan-card');
      if ((await card.count()) === 0) {
        await clearSession(page);
        continue;
      }
      await expect(card).toContainText(/edit expense/i);
      await expect(card.getByTestId('chat-plan-proceed')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(card.getByTestId('chat-plan-cancel')).toBeVisible();
      const n = await bots(page).count();
      await card.getByTestId('chat-plan-proceed').click();
      const result = await nextBot(page, n);
      await expect(result.getByTestId('chat-plan-card')).toHaveCount(0);
      await expect(result).not.toContainText(/nothing is waiting for your confirmation/i);
      await expect(result).not.toContainText(/something went wrong/i);
      await expect(card).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'done');
      await expect(card.getByTestId('chat-plan-proceed')).toHaveCount(0);
      executed = true;
    }
    expect(executed, 'no plan preview appeared within 3 attempts of "edit my last expense"').toBe(true);
  });

  test('Cancel on a plan cancels it', async ({ page }) => {
    await openChat(page);
    await clearSession(page);
    let cancelled = false;
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3 && !cancelled; attempt++) {
      const before = await bots(page).count();
      await send(page, 'edit my last expense');
      const reply = await nextBot(page, before);
      const card = reply.getByTestId('chat-plan-card');
      if ((await card.count()) === 0) { await clearSession(page); continue; }
      const n = await bots(page).count();
      await card.getByTestId('chat-plan-cancel').click();
      const result = await nextBot(page, n);
      await expect(result).toContainText(/cancel/i);
      cancelled = true;
    }
    expect(cancelled).toBe(true);
  });

  test('a suggestion chip sends its text and gets a real reply', async ({ page }) => {
    let canned = true;
    await page.route(MSG, async (route) => {
      if (canned && route.request().method() === 'POST') {
        canned = false;
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 200, contentType: 'application/json',
          body: JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: { message: 'Here you go.', skillUsed: 'general-question', confidence: 1, suggestions: ['Show my recent expenses'] } }),
        });
      }
      return route.continue();
    });
    await openChat(page);
    const before = await bots(page).count();
    await send(page, 'hello');
    const first = await nextBot(page, before);
    const chip = first.getByTestId('chat-suggestion').filter({ hasText: 'Show my recent expenses' });
    await expect(chip).toBeVisible();
    await chip.click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('chat-bubble-user').last()).toHaveText('Show my recent expenses');
    const real = await nextBot(page, before + 1);
    await expect(real).not.toContainText(SAFE_FALLBACK);
  });

  test('a failed send keeps the text and Retry delivers it', async ({ page }) => {
    let failNext = true;
    await page.route(MSG, async (route) => {
      if (failNext && route.request().method() === 'POST') { failNext = false; return route.abort('failed'); }
      return route.continue();
    });
    await openChat(page);
    const text = `retry me ${Date.now()}`;
    await send(page, text);
    const mine = page.getByTestId('chat-bubble-user').filter({ hasText: text });
    await expect(mine).toHaveAttribute('data-status', 'failed');
    await expect(mine.getByTestId('chat-retry')).toBeVisible();
    const before = await bots(page).count();
    await mine.getByTestId('chat-retry').click();
    await nextBot(page, before);
    await expect(mine).toHaveAttribute('data-status', 'sent');
    await expect(mine.getByTestId('chat-retry')).toHaveCount(0);
  });

  test('429 shows the server message, disables send, and counts down', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.route(MSG, async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() !== 'POST') return route.continue();
      return route.fulfill({
        status: 429, contentType: 'application/json', headers: { 'Retry-After': '4' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: 'rate_limited', reason: 'minute', retryAfterMs: 4000, message: 'You have sent a lot of messages — try again in a moment.', locale: 'en' }),
      });
    });
    await openChat(page);
    await send(page, 'hi');
    const notice = page.getByTestId('chat-ratelimit');
    await expect(notice).toContainText('You have sent a lot of messages');
    await expect(notice).toContainText(/\ds/);
    await page.getByTestId('chat-input').fill('again');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('chat-send')).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(notice).toBeHidden({ timeout: 8_000 });
    await expect(page.getByTestId('chat-send')).toBeEnabled();
  });

  test('typing indicator shows while a reply is pending', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.route(MSG, async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === 'POST') await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
      return route.continue();
    });
    await openChat(page);
    const before = await bots(page).count();
    await send(page, 'hello');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('chat-typing')).toBeVisible();
    await nextBot(page, before);
    await expect(page.getByTestId('chat-typing')).toHaveCount(0);
  });

  test('photo attach books a receipt and opens it in the viewer', async ({ page }) => {
    await openChat(page);
    const shot = await page.context().newPage();
    await shot.setContent('<div id="r" style="width:360px;padding:24px;font:20px monospace;background:#fff;color:#000">E2E COFFEE BAR<br>2026-10-07<br>Latte 4.50<br>TOTAL $4.50</div>');
    const buffer = await shot.locator('#r').screenshot();

    await page.getByTestId('chat-attach').click();
    await page.getByTestId('chat-file-library').setInputFiles({ name: 'receipt.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer });

    const id = href!.split('/').pop()!;
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Write the prod transcript replay**

Create `tests/e2e/mobile-app/chat-replay.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { test, expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { MOBILE_VIEWPORT, loginAs, settle } from './helpers';

/**
 * Replays a short transcript through the MOBILE UI against production right
 * after a deploy. Catches consultation-reviewer regressions: a rule written for
 * one caller firing on another caller's legitimate replies ("hello" → safe-
 * fallback boilerplate, #565). Content assertions only; no fixed turn counts.
 */
const BASE = process.env.E2E_BASE_URL || 'https://agentbook.brainliber.com';
test.skip(!/agentbook\.brainliber\.com/.test(BASE), 'prod-only replay');
test.use({ viewport: MOBILE_VIEWPORT, serviceWorkers: 'block' });

const SAFE_FALLBACK = /I don't want to quote you a number/i;
const BROKEN = /something went wrong|agent brain failed|^Error: /im;

const TRANSCRIPT: Array<{ text: string; must?: RegExp; noPlan?: boolean }> = [
  { text: 'hello', noPlan: true },
  { text: 'cancel', must: /nothing to cancel|no action in progress|plan cancelled/i },
  { text: 'Give me more details' },
  { text: 'how much did I spend this month?', must: /\$\s?\d/ },
];

async function sendAndRead(page: Page, text: string) {
  const bots = page.getByTestId('chat-bubble-bot');
  const before = await bots.count();
  await page.getByTestId('chat-input').fill(text);
  await page.getByTestId('chat-send').click();
  await expect(bots).toHaveCount(before + 1, { timeout: 90_000 });
  return bots.last();
}

test('mobile transcript replay — no reviewer-rule regressions', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAs(page, 'maya');
  await settle(page);
  await page.goto('/app/chat');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('chat-history-loading')).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 30_000 });
  for (const turn of TRANSCRIPT) {
    const reply = await sendAndRead(page, turn.text);
    const text = (await reply.textContent()) ?? '';
    expect(text.trim().length, `"${turn.text}" got an empty reply`).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(text, `"${turn.text}" hit the reviewer safe-fallback`).not.toMatch(SAFE_FALLBACK);
    expect(text, `"${turn.text}" surfaced an error`).not.toMatch(BROKEN);
    if (turn.must) expect(text, `"${turn.text}"`).toMatch(turn.must);
    if (turn.noPlan) await expect(reply.getByTestId('chat-plan-card')).toHaveCount(0);
  }
});
```

### Task 6.9: Chat deep-link topics (`/app/chat?topic=tax_deadline|bill_due`)

PR 1's Home alerts for tax deadlines and bills due have no mobile screen of their own, so their `target` is `/app/chat?topic=…`. Without this task that tap would land on an empty chat that ignores the topic. The page prefills the composer with a question for the topic and does NOT send it (the user decides).

**Files**
- Modify: `packages/agentbook-i18n/src/locales/en/mobile.json`, `packages/agentbook-i18n/src/locales/fr-CA/mobile.json`, `packages/agentbook-i18n/src/locales/zh-CN/mobile.json` (add `topic_tax_deadline` and `topic_bill_due` inside the existing `chat` object)
- Modify: `apps/web-next/src/app/app/chat/page.tsx`
- Test (create): `apps/web-next/src/__tests__/app/mobile/chat-topic.test.tsx`

**Interfaces**
- Consumes: the page's `draft`/`setDraft` state and `t` from Task 6.6; `installFetch`, `json`, `withShell` from `chat-test-utils` (Task 6.5/6.6).
- Produces: keys `mobile.chat.topic_tax_deadline`, `mobile.chat.topic_bill_due`; behaviour: `?topic=` prefills the composer once, never auto-sends, ignores unknown topics, never overwrites text the user already typed.

```tsx
  // /app/chat?topic=… arrives from Home alerts that have no screen of their own (tax deadline, bill due).
  // Prefill the question; never send it, and never overwrite what the user already typed.
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const topic = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('topic');
      const key =
        topic === 'tax_deadline' ? 'mobile.chat.topic_tax_deadline'
        : topic === 'bill_due' ? 'mobile.chat.topic_bill_due'
        : null;
      if (key) setDraft((d) => d || t(key));
    } catch {
      /* no window, or blocked: the composer simply stays empty */
    }
    // run once on mount; `t` is stable for the session language
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);
```

## PR 7 — Hardening and launch gates

**Goal:** turn spec §8 into executable gates and run them on production. That covers: i18n completion with a hardcoded-English guard and real-browser fr-CA / zh-CN checks; the persona × journey Playwright matrix; perf (Slow-4G Home ≤ 2.5 s, route-JS ≤ baseline + 40 kB gz, Docs CLS/thumbnails); a11y (axe zero serious/critical, 44×44, dark mode, reduced motion, focus); resilience (offline, 3 s, 500, 429, empty) plus a console-error/unhandled-rejection collector; PWA (manifest, SW update/stale client, notification default); security probes; the scorecard runner with a launch report and a manual device checklist; cleanup; and the final go/no-go.

**Rubric (spec §8, verbatim, every gate maps to one row of the scorecard):** §8.1(1)–(8), §8.2 persona matrix, §8.3 performance / accessibility / resilience / PWA / security, §8.4 per-PR exit gates, §8.6 launch scorecard.

**Branch / worktree:** `feat/mobile-launch-gates` in `/Users/qianghan/Documents/mycodespace/a3p/.worktrees/mobile-pr7-launch`.

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative } from 'node:path';
import { CATALOG } from '@agentbook/i18n/catalog';
import { createTranslator } from '@agentbook/i18n';

/**
 * No user-visible English in the /app PWA, and every mobile.* key resolves and
 * is translated. Green catalog guards have coexisted with an English page before
 * (the shell-wiring guard only scrapes TWO-segment keys, so `mobile.x.y` keys
 * were invisible to it) — this covers the three-segment keys and the literals.
 */
const SRC = join(__dirname, '..', '..');
const APP = join(SRC, 'app', 'app');
/** Brand names are never translated (see feedback: no catalog key for brand names). */
const ALLOWED_LITERALS = new Set(['AgentBook']);
/** mobile.* keys whose translation legitimately equals English (none today). */
const IDENTICAL_OK = new Set<string>([]);

function files(dir: string, ext: RegExp): string[] {
  return readdirSync(dir).flatMap((e) => {
    const p = join(dir, e);
    if (statSync(p).isDirectory()) return files(p, ext);
    return ext.test(e) && !e.includes('.test.') ? [p] : [];
  });
}

function stripComments(src: string): string {
  return src.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, '').replace(/(^|[^:'"`\\])\/\/[^\n]*/g, '$1');
}

const isKey = (s: string) => /^[a-z0-9_]+(\.[a-z0-9_]+)+$/.test(s.trim());
const isVisibleEnglish = (s: string) => {
  const v = s.trim();
  return /[A-Za-z]{2,}/.test(v) && !isKey(v) && !ALLOWED_LITERALS.has(v);
};

export function findHardcoded(source: string): string[] {
  const src = stripComments(source);
  const out: string[] = [];
  // JSX text directly after a JSX tag: <p>Hello</p>, multi-line allowed.
  for (const m of src.matchAll(/<\/?[A-Za-z][\w.:-]*(?:\s[^<>]*)?>([^<>{}()=;`]*)</g)) {
    if (isVisibleEnglish(m[1])) out.push(`text: ${m[1].trim()}`);
  }
  // User-visible attributes with a string literal.
  for (const m of src.matchAll(/\b(placeholder|aria-label|title|alt|label)\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"/g)) {
    if (isVisibleEnglish(m[2])) out.push(`${m[1]}: ${m[2]}`);
  }
  // Object-literal copy in .tsx (e.g. TABS = [{ label: 'Home' }]).
  for (const m of src.matchAll(/\b(label|title|placeholder|heading|subtitle|description|message|body)\s*:\s*'([^'\n]*)'/g)) {
    if (isVisibleEnglish(m[2])) out.push(`${m[1]}: ${m[2]}`);
  }
  // Strings handed straight to UI sinks.
  for (const m of src.matchAll(/\b(setError|setMessage|toast|alert|confirm)\(\s*'([^'\n]*)'/g)) {
    if (isVisibleEnglish(m[2])) out.push(`${m[1]}(): ${m[2]}`);
  }
  return out;
}

describe('the detector is not vacuous', () => {
  it('flags each literal shape', () => {
    const sample = `const TABS = [{ label: 'Home' }];
      export default function X() { return (<div><p>Hello there</p><input placeholder="Type here" /></div>); }`;
    expect(findHardcoded(sample)).toEqual(['text: Hello there', 'placeholder: Type here', 'label: Home']);
  });
  it('ignores keys, brand, code and expressions', () => {
    const sample = `const x = useState<string>(''); if (a > max && b < min) {}
      return <p>{t('mobile.home.title')}</p><span>AgentBook</span><i>{'  '}</i>;`;
    expect(findHardcoded(sample)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('app/app has no hardcoded user-visible English', () => {
  const tsx = files(APP, /\.tsx$/);
  it('scans a real tree', () => {
    expect(tsx.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(8);
  });
  it.each(tsx.map((f) => [relative(SRC, f), f]))('%s', (_rel, f) => {
    expect(findHardcoded(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'))).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('every mobile.* key the app calls resolves and is translated', () => {
  const all = files(APP, /\.(ts|tsx)$/).map((f) => readFileSync(f, 'utf8')).join('\n');
  const keys = [...new Set([...all.matchAll(/\bt\('(mobile\.[a-z0-9_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]))].sort();
  const en = createTranslator('en', CATALOG);

  it('found a meaningful number of keys', () => {
    expect(keys.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(80);
  });
  it.each(['en', 'fr-CA', 'zh-CN'])('%s resolves all', (locale) => {
    const tr = createTranslator(locale, CATALOG);
    const missing = keys.filter((k) => tr.t(k) === k || tr.t(k).trim() === '');
    expect(missing).toEqual([]);
  });
  it.each(['fr-CA', 'zh-CN'])('%s translates all', (locale) => {
    const tr = createTranslator(locale, CATALOG);
    const same = keys.filter((k) => !IDENTICAL_OK.has(k) && tr.t(k) === en.t(k));
    expect(same).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('shell components rendered inside /app are localized', () => {
  it('LanguageSwitcher no longer hardcodes its error line', () => {
    const src = readFileSync(join(SRC, 'components', 'layout', 'language-switcher.tsx'), 'utf8');
    expect(src).not.toContain('Could not change language. Please try again.');
    expect(src).toContain("t('common.change_language_failed')");
  });
});
```

Create `tests/e2e/mobile-app/fixtures.ts`:

```ts
import { test as base, expect } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * Spec §8.3: "no unhandled promise rejections or console errors during the
 * journeys". Auto fixture: every test using this `test` fails on any of them.
 * unhandledrejection is re-emitted as console.error by an init script because
 * not every engine reports it as a pageerror.
 */
export interface Collected { console: string[]; pageErrors: string[] }
/** Console noise that is NOT ours and is documented here with a reason. Starts empty. */
const IGNORED_CONSOLE: RegExp[] = [];

export const test = base.extend<{ errors: Collected; strictErrors: boolean }>({
  strictErrors: [true, { option: true }],
  errors: [
    async ({ page, strictErrors }, use, testInfo) => {
      const c: Collected = { console: [], pageErrors: [] };
      await page.addInitScript(() => {
        window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (e) => {
          const r = (e as PromiseRejectionEvent).reason;
          console.error(`unhandledrejection: ${r && r.message ? r.message : String(r)}`);
        });
      });
      page.on('console', (msg) => { if (msg.type() === 'error') c.console.push(msg.text()); });
      page.on('pageerror', (err) => c.pageErrors.push(String(err?.stack ?? err)));
      await use(c);
      const consoleErrors = c.console
        .filter((m) => !IGNORED_CONSOLE.some((re) => re.test(m)))
        .filter((m) => strictErrors || !/Failed to load resource/i.test(m));
      expect(c.pageErrors, `uncaught errors in "${testInfo.title}"`).toEqual([]);
      expect(consoleErrors, `console errors in "${testInfo.title}"`).toEqual([]);
    },
    { auto: true },
  ],
});
export { expect };
```

```ts
export type PersonaKey = 'maya' | 'alex' | 'sydney' | 'fresh';
export const PERSONA_KEYS: PersonaKey[] = ['maya', 'alex', 'sydney', 'fresh'];

export interface PersonaExpect {

  currency: string | null;
  /** Currency marks that must never appear on this persona's screens. */
  wrongCurrencyMarks: RegExp[];
  /** Jurisdiction terms that must never appear (spec §8.2: AU never shows US SE terms). */
  forbiddenTerms: RegExp[];
}

  maya: { seeded: true, currency: 'CAD', wrongCurrencyMarks: [/US\$/, /(?<!C)A\$/], forbiddenTerms: [/\bIRS\b/, /Schedule C/i, /\bForm 1040\b/] },
  alex: { seeded: true, currency: 'USD', wrongCurrencyMarks: [/CA\$/, /(?<!C)A\$/], forbiddenTerms: [/\bCRA\b/, /GST\/HST/, /\bATO\b/, /\bT2125\b/] },
  sydney: { seeded: true, currency: 'AUD', wrongCurrencyMarks: [/CA\$/, /US\$/], forbiddenTerms: [/self[- ]employment/i, /Schedule C/i, /\bIRS\b/, /\bSE tax\b/i, /\bCRA\b/] },
  fresh: { seeded: false, currency: null, wrongCurrencyMarks: [], forbiddenTerms: [] },
};

export const digits = (s: string) => s.replace(/\D/g, '');
/** formatCurrencyCents renders whole units (maximumFractionDigits: 0). */
export const wholeUnits = (cents: number) => String(Math.round(Math.abs(cents) / 100));
```

```ts
import type { Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const LOCALES_DIR = join(__dirname, '..', '..', '..', 'packages', 'agentbook-i18n', 'src', 'locales');

/** Flattened `mobile.*` catalog values for a locale, optionally filtered by key prefix. */
export function catalogValues(locale: string, prefix = 'mobile.'): Record<string, string> {
  const json = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(LOCALES_DIR, locale, 'mobile.json'), 'utf8')) as Record<string, unknown>;
  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  const walk = (o: Record<string, unknown>, p: string) => {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o)) {
      const key = `${p}.${k}`;
      if (typeof v === 'string') out[key] = v;
      else if (v && typeof v === 'object') walk(v as Record<string, unknown>, key);
    }
  };
  walk(json, 'mobile');
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(out).filter(([k]) => k.startsWith(prefix)));
}

/** A `common.*` catalog value (e.g. the language switcher's accessible name). */
export function commonValue(locale: string, key: string): string {
  const json = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(LOCALES_DIR, locale, 'common.json'), 'utf8')) as Record<string, string>;
  const v = json[key];
  if (typeof v !== 'string') throw new Error(`common.${key} missing in ${locale}`);
  return v;
}

/**
 * Render the real app in `locale` WITHOUT touching production state: the
 * translation flag is off in prod (fail-closed DB row), so the one tenant-config
 * GET is rewritten (flag on + locale) and the switcher's PUT is answered locally.
 * Requires serviceWorkers: 'block' (page.route cannot see SW-handled requests).
 */
export async function forceLocale(page: Page, initial: string): Promise<{ current: () => string }> {
  let locale = initial;
  await page.route('**/api/v1/agentbook-core/tenant-config', async (route) => {
    const req = route.request();
    if (req.method() === 'PUT') {
      try {
        const b = JSON.parse(req.postData() ?? '{}') as { locale?: unknown };
        if (typeof b.locale === 'string') locale = b.locale;
      } catch { /* keep current */ }
      return route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'application/json', body: JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: { locale } }) });
    }
    const res = await route.fetch();
    const json = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as Record<string, unknown>;
    json.i18nLocalesEnabled = true;
    json.data = { ...((json.data as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {}), locale };
    return route.fulfill({ response: res, json });
  });
  return { current: () => locale };
}
```

```ts
import { test, expect } from './fixtures';
import { MOBILE_VIEWPORT, loginAs, settle } from './helpers';
import { SEL } from './selectors';
import { forceLocale, catalogValues } from './locale';

test.use({ viewport: MOBILE_VIEWPORT, serviceWorkers: 'block' });

const SCREENS = [
  { name: 'home', path: '/app', ready: SEL.home.screen, prefix: 'mobile.home.' },
  { name: 'docs', path: '/app/docs', ready: SEL.docs.screen, prefix: 'mobile.docs.' },
  { name: 'capture', path: '/app/capture', ready: SEL.capture.screen, prefix: 'mobile.capture.' },
  { name: 'chat', path: '/app/chat', ready: SEL.chat.screen, prefix: 'mobile.chat.' },
] as const;
const SCREEN_NS = new Set(['home', 'docs', 'viewer', 'capture', 'chat']);
const usable = (v: string) => !v.includes('{') && v.trim().length >= 2;

for (const locale of ['fr-CA', 'zh-CN'] as const) {
  test.describe(`${locale} in a real browser`, () => {
    for (const s of SCREENS) {
      test(`${s.name} renders translated copy and no English mobile strings`, async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
        await forceLocale(page, locale);
        await loginAs(page, 'maya');
        await settle(page);
        await page.goto(s.path);
        await expect(page.getByTestId(s.ready)).toBeVisible();
        await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('lang', new RegExp(`^${locale.split('-')[0]}`));
        await page.waitForTimeout(1500); // the locale pack is a lazy chunk; let it land
        const body = await page.locator('body').innerText();

        const en = catalogValues('en');
        const loc = catalogValues(locale);
        const screenKeys = Object.keys(loc).filter((k) => k.startsWith(s.prefix) && usable(loc[k]));
        const shellKeys = Object.keys(loc).filter((k) => !SCREEN_NS.has(k.split('.')[1]) && usable(loc[k]));
        const shownScreen = screenKeys.filter((k) => body.includes(loc[k]));
        const shownShell = shellKeys.filter((k) => body.includes(loc[k]));
        const englishLeft = [...screenKeys, ...shellKeys].filter(
          (k) => en[k] && en[k] !== loc[k] && en[k].length >= 8 && !en[k].includes('{') && body.includes(en[k]),
        );

        await testInfo.attach(`${s.name}-${locale}.png`, { body: await page.screenshot({ fullPage: true }), contentType: 'image/png' });
        expect(shownScreen.length, `${locale} ${s.name}: translated screen strings visible`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
        expect(shownShell.length, `${locale} ${s.name}: translated tab/shell strings visible`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
        expect(englishLeft, `${locale} ${s.name}: English mobile strings still visible`).toEqual([]);
      });
    }
  });
}
```

```ts
import { expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import type { MobileHome } from '../../../apps/web-next/src/lib/mobile/types';
import { SEL } from './selectors';
import { inPageFetch } from './page-api';
import { PERSONAS, digits, wholeUnits, type PersonaKey } from './personas';
import { forceLocale, catalogValues, commonValue } from './locale';

const SAFE_FALLBACK = /I don't want to quote you a number/i;
const FILTERS = ['needs-review', 'no-category', 'no-receipt', 'all', 'archived'] as const;

async function getHome(page: Page): Promise<MobileHome> {
  const r = await inPageFetch<{ success: boolean; data: MobileHome }>(page, 'GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-core/mobile/home');
  expect(r.status, 'mobile/home').toBe(200);
  return r.data!.data;
}
async function assertJurisdictionClean(page: Page, persona: PersonaKey) {
  const body = await page.locator('body').innerText();
  for (const re of PERSONAS[persona].wrongCurrencyMarks) expect(body, `wrong currency mark ${re}`).not.toMatch(re);
  for (const re of PERSONAS[persona].forbiddenTerms) expect(body, `foreign jurisdiction term ${re}`).not.toMatch(re);
}
function screenFor(route: string): string {
  if (route.startsWith('/app/docs/')) return SEL.viewer.screen;
  if (route.startsWith('/app/docs')) return SEL.docs.screen;
  if (route.startsWith('/app/capture')) return SEL.capture.screen;
  if (route.startsWith('/app/chat')) return SEL.chat.screen;
  return SEL.home.screen;
}
async function firstDocId(page: Page): Promise<string | null> {
  const r = await inPageFetch<{ data: Array<{ id: string }> }>(page, 'GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses?limit=1');
  return r.data?.data?.[0]?.id ?? null;
}

export async function home(page: Page, persona: PersonaKey) {
  await page.goto('/app');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.screen)).toBeVisible();
  const h = await getHome(page);
  if (!PERSONAS[persona].seeded) {
    expect(h.isBrandNew).toBe(true);
    await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.empty)).toBeVisible();
    return;
  }
  expect(h.currency).toBe(PERSONAS[persona].currency);
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.empty)).toHaveCount(0);
  const tiles: Array<[string, number | null]> = [
    [SEL.home.kpiMonthNet, h.kpis.monthNetCents],
    [SEL.home.kpiCash, h.kpis.cashTodayCents],
    [SEL.home.kpiOutstanding, h.kpis.outstandingCents],
    [SEL.home.kpiTax, h.kpis.estTaxOwedCents],
  ];
  for (const [id, cents] of tiles) {
    const tile = page.getByTestId(id);
    await expect(tile).toBeVisible();
    if (cents !== null) await expect.poll(async () => digits(await tile.innerText()), { message: id }).toContain(wholeUnits(cents));
  }
  for (const a of h.alerts) if (a.target) expect(a.target.route.startsWith('/app'), a.kind).toBe(true);
  if (h.alerts.length > 0) await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.alertBanner)).toBeVisible();
  else await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.alertBanner)).toHaveCount(0);
  await assertJurisdictionClean(page, persona);
}

export async function alertActions(page: Page, persona: PersonaKey) {
  await page.goto('/app');
  const h = await getHome(page);
  if (!PERSONAS[persona].seeded) {
    expect(h.alerts).toEqual([]);
    return;
  }
  // Every navigational alert lands on a working mobile screen. POST actions
  // (e.g. Remind) are NOT clicked: they email real recipients.
  for (const a of h.alerts.filter((x) => x.target)) {
    const qs = a.target!.query ? `?${new URLSearchParams(a.target!.query)}` : '';
    await page.goto(`${a.target!.route}${qs}`);
    await expect(page.getByTestId(screenFor(a.target!.route)), a.kind).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('[data-testid$="-error"]')).toHaveCount(0);
  }
  const top = h.alerts[0];
  if (top?.target) {
    await page.goto('/app');
    await page.getByTestId(SEL.home.alertAction).first().click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId(screenFor(top.target.route))).toBeVisible();
    expect(new URL(page.url()).pathname.startsWith(top.target.route.split('?')[0])).toBe(true);
  }
}

export async function docs(page: Page, persona: PersonaKey) {
  await page.goto('/app/docs');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.docs.screen)).toBeVisible();
  for (const f of FILTERS) {
    const chip = page.getByTestId(`${SEL.docs.filterPrefix}${f}`);
    await chip.click();
    await expect(chip).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
    await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.docs.row).first().or(page.getByTestId(SEL.docs.empty))).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.docs.error)).toHaveCount(0);
    if (!PERSONAS[persona].seeded) await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.docs.empty)).toBeVisible();
  }
  if (!PERSONAS[persona].seeded) return;
  await page.getByTestId(`${SEL.docs.filterPrefix}all`).click();
  await page.getByTestId(SEL.docs.row).first().click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.viewer.screen)).toBeVisible();
  const id = new URL(page.url()).pathname.split('/').pop()!;
  const row = await inPageFetch<{ data: { amountCents: number } }>(page, 'GET', `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}`);
  expect(row.status).toBe(200);
  const amountEl = page.getByTestId(SEL.viewer.amount);
  const shown = await amountEl.evaluate((el) => (el as HTMLInputElement).value || el.textContent || '');
  expect(digits(shown)).toContain(String(Math.floor(Math.abs(row.data!.data.amountCents) / 100)));
  await assertJurisdictionClean(page, persona);
}

export async function archiveRoundTrip(page: Page, persona: PersonaKey) {
  if (!PERSONAS[persona].seeded) {
    await page.goto('/app/docs/does-not-exist');
    await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.viewer.error)).toBeVisible();
    return;
  }
  await page.goto('/app');
  const id = await firstDocId(page);
  expect(id, 'seeded persona has at least one expense').toBeTruthy();
  const estimate = async () => JSON.stringify((await inPageFetch(page, 'GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-tax/tax/estimate')).data);
  const before = await estimate();
  await page.goto(`/app/docs/${id}`);
  await page.getByTestId(SEL.viewer.archive).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.viewer.restore)).toBeVisible();
  const archived = await inPageFetch<{ data: Array<{ id: string }> }>(page, 'GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses?archived=true&limit=100');
  expect(archived.data!.data.map((d) => d.id)).toContain(id);
  await page.goto('/app/docs?filter=archived');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.docs.row).first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto(`/app/docs/${id}`);
  await page.getByTestId(SEL.viewer.restore).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.viewer.archive)).toBeVisible();
  const after = await inPageFetch<{ data: Array<{ id: string }> }>(page, 'GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses?archived=true&limit=100');
  expect(after.data!.data.map((d) => d.id)).not.toContain(id);
  expect(await estimate(), 'archive/restore must not move the tax estimate').toBe(before);
}

export async function capture(page: Page, persona: PersonaKey) {
  await page.goto('/app/capture');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.screen)).toBeVisible();
  const shot = await page.context().newPage();
  await shot.setContent('<div id="r" style="width:360px;padding:24px;font:20px monospace;background:#fff;color:#000">MATRIX CAFE<br>2026-10-07<br>TOTAL $7.25</div>');
  const buffer = await shot.locator('#r').screenshot();
  await shot.close();
  await page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.fileInput).setInputFiles({ name: 'matrix.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer });
  const amount = page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.amount);
  await expect(amount).toBeVisible({ timeout: 60_000 });
  if (!(await amount.inputValue())) await amount.fill('7.25');
  const saved = page.waitForResponse((r) => r.url().includes('/expenses/from-receipt') && r.request().method() === 'POST', { timeout: 90_000 });
  await page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.save).click();
  const res = await saved;
  expect(res.status(), `${persona}: from-receipt`).toBe(200);
  const id = ((await res.json()) as { data: { doc: { id: string } } }).data.doc.id;
  try {
    await page.goto(`/app/docs/${id}`);
    await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.viewer.screen)).toBeVisible();
    await expect.poll(async () => digits(await page.getByTestId(SEL.viewer.amount).evaluate((el) => (el as HTMLInputElement).value || el.textContent || ''))).toContain('7');
  } finally {
    const del = await inPageFetch(page, 'DELETE', `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}`);
    expect(del.status, 'cleanup').toBe(200);
  }
}

export async function chat(page: Page, persona: PersonaKey) {
  await page.goto('/app/chat');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.screen)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.loading)).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 30_000 });
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.error)).toHaveCount(0);
  if (!PERSONAS[persona].seeded) await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.empty)).toBeVisible();
  const bots = page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.botBubble);
  const before = await bots.count();
  await page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.input).fill('hello');
  await page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.send).click();
  await expect(bots).toHaveCount(before + 1, { timeout: 90_000 });
  const text = (await bots.last().textContent()) ?? '';
  expect(text.trim().length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(text).not.toMatch(SAFE_FALLBACK);
  await assertJurisdictionClean(page, persona);
}

export async function tabs(page: Page) {
  await page.goto('/app');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.screen)).toBeVisible();
  await page.evaluate(() => { (window as unknown as { __e2eNoReload: number }).__e2eNoReload = 42; });
  const steps: Array<[string, string, string]> = [
    [SEL.shell.tabDocs, '/app/docs', SEL.docs.screen],
    [SEL.shell.tabCapture, '/app/capture', SEL.capture.screen],
    [SEL.shell.tabChat, '/app/chat', SEL.chat.screen],
    [SEL.shell.tabHome, '/app', SEL.home.screen],
  ];
  for (const [tab, path, screenId] of steps) {
    await page.getByTestId(tab).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId(screenId)).toBeVisible();
    expect(new URL(page.url()).pathname).toBe(path);
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __e2eNoReload?: number }).__e2eNoReload), `${tab}: full reload happened`).toBe(42);
  }
}

export async function deepLinks(page: Page, persona: PersonaKey) {
  await page.goto('/app/docs?filter=no-receipt');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(`${SEL.docs.filterPrefix}no-receipt`)).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
  await page.goto('/app/chat');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.screen)).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto('/app/capture');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.screen)).toBeVisible();
  if (PERSONAS[persona].seeded) {
    await page.goto('/app');
    const id = await firstDocId(page);
    await page.goto(`/app/docs/${id}`);
    await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.viewer.screen)).toBeVisible();
  }
  const res = await page.goto('/app/this-route-does-not-exist');
  const body = (await page.locator('body').innerText()).toLowerCase();
  expect(res?.status() === 404 || /not found|404/.test(body), 'unknown /app route shows not-found').toBe(true);
}

export async function languageSwitch(page: Page) {
  await forceLocale(page, 'en');
  await page.goto('/app');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.screen)).toBeVisible();
  const fr = catalogValues('fr-CA');
  const en = catalogValues('en');
  const visible = async (vals: Record<string, string>) => {
    const body = await page.locator('body').innerText();
    return Object.values(vals).filter((v) => !v.includes('{') && v.length >= 3 && body.includes(v)).length;
  };
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: commonValue('en', 'change_language') }).click();
  await Promise.all([page.waitForEvent('load'), page.getByRole('menuitemradio', { name: /Français/ }).click()]);
  await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('lang', /^fr/);
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.screen)).toBeVisible();
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  expect(await visible(fr), 'French strings after switching').toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: commonValue('fr-CA', 'change_language') }).click();
  await Promise.all([page.waitForEvent('load'), page.getByRole('menuitemradio', { name: /English/ }).click()]);
  await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('lang', /^en/);
  expect(await visible(en), 'English strings after switching back').toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
}
```

The second switcher button is found by its fr-CA accessible name, taken from the catalog (`common.change_language`), because the UI is French at that point.

```ts
import { test } from './fixtures';
import { MOBILE_VIEWPORT, loginAs, settle } from './helpers';
import { PERSONA_KEYS } from './personas';
import * as J from './journeys';

/**
 * Spec §8.1(7) × §8.2: every journey, every persona, on a real deployment,
 * asserting rendered content. No test is skipped per persona: the brand-new
 * account runs the empty-state branch of each journey instead.
 */
test.use({ viewport: MOBILE_VIEWPORT, serviceWorkers: 'block' });

for (const persona of PERSONA_KEYS) {

      await settle(page);
    });

    test('home: every alert action lands on a working mobile screen', async ({ page }) => J.alertActions(page, persona));
    test('docs: every filter truthful; viewer shows the doc', async ({ page }) => J.docs(page, persona));
    test('docs: archive → Archived → restore; tax estimate unchanged', async ({ page }) => J.archiveRoundTrip(page, persona));
    test('capture: photo → save → in Docs (cleaned up)', async ({ page }) => J.capture(page, persona));
    test('chat: history/empty + a real reply', async ({ page }) => J.chat(page, persona));
    test('tabs: client-side navigation, no full reload', async ({ page }) => J.tabs(page));
    test('deep links + unknown route', async ({ page }) => J.deepLinks(page, persona));
    test('language switch fr-CA → English (no prod mutation)', async ({ page }) => J.languageSwitch(page));
  });
}
```

```ts
describe('mobile /app route budgets (spec 2026-10-07 §8.3: baseline + 40 kB gz)', () => {
  const MOBILE_SAMPLE = `
┌ ○ /app                                                                        3.10 kB         210 kB
├ ○ /app/capture                                                                2.00 kB         205 kB
├ ○ /app/chat                                                                   1.50 kB         204 kB
├ ○ /app/docs                                                                   1.90 kB         205 kB
├ ƒ /app/docs/[id]                                                              4.00 kB         240 kB
`;
  const baseline = {
    commit: 'a'.repeat(40), measuredAt: '2026-10-07', method: 'test', unit: 'kB', allowanceKb: 40,
    routes: { '/app': 200, '/app/capture': 200, '/app/chat': 200, '/app/docs': 200 },
    inheritFrom: { '/app/docs/[id]': '/app/docs' },
  };

  it('budget = baseline + allowance; new routes inherit their parent', async () => {
    const { mobileBudgets } = await import(GUARD);
    expect(mobileBudgets(baseline)).toEqual({
      '/app': 240, '/app/capture': 240, '/app/chat': 240, '/app/docs': 240, '/app/docs/[id]': 240,
    });
  });

  it('passes at the budget, fails above it, fails when a route is missing', async () => {
    const { parseRoutes, checkMobileRoutes } = await import(GUARD);
    expect(checkMobileRoutes(parseRoutes(MOBILE_SAMPLE), baseline)).toEqual([]);
    const over = MOBILE_SAMPLE.replace('204 kB', '241 kB');
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement in `bin/perf-budget.mjs`**

Insert these exports above `function main()`:

```js
/**
 * /app PWA budgets: the measured pre-redesign First Load JS + 40 kB (gzip, as
 * `next build` prints it), per spec 2026-10-07 §8.3. The baseline lives in
 * bin/perf-baseline-mobile.json with the commit and method it was measured by.
 * Routes the redesign added (the viewer) borrow their parent's baseline.
 */
export const MOBILE_BASELINE_ROUTES = ['/app', '/app/capture', '/app/chat', '/app/docs'];

export function mobileBudgets(baseline) {
  const out = {};
  for (const [route, kb] of Object.entries(baseline.routes)) out[route] = kb + baseline.allowanceKb;
  for (const [route, parent] of Object.entries(baseline.inheritFrom ?? {})) {
    out[route] = baseline.routes[parent] + baseline.allowanceKb;
  }
  return out;
}

export function checkMobileRoutes(routes, baseline) {
  const failures = [];
  for (const [route, budget] of Object.entries(mobileBudgets(baseline))) {
    const r = routes.find((x) => x.route === route);
    if (!r) {
      failures.push(`${route}: missing from the build table — the mobile budget cannot be checked`);
      continue;
    }
    if (r.firstLoadKb > budget) {
      failures.push(`${route}: First Load JS ${r.firstLoadKb.toFixed(0)} kB exceeds mobile budget ${budget} kB`);
    }
  }
  return failures;
}

export function recordMobileBaseline(log, commit, measuredAt) {
  const routes = parseRoutes(log);
  const picked = {};
  for (const route of MOBILE_BASELINE_ROUTES) {
    const r = routes.find((x) => x.route === route);
    if (!r) throw new Error(`baseline log has no row for ${route}`);
    picked[route] = Math.round(r.firstLoadKb);
  }
  return {
    commit,
    measuredAt,
    method: 'First Load JS from the `next build` route table of the last main commit before the mobile redesign (first parent of the commit that added apps/web-next/src/app/app/_kit/index.ts); CI Build-job log when available, else a local ./bin/vercel-build.sh in a git worktree of that commit.',
    unit: 'kB First Load JS (gzip) as printed by next build',
    allowanceKb: 40,
    routes: picked,
    inheritFrom: { '/app/docs/[id]': '/app/docs' },
  };
}
```

```js
      process.exit(2);
```

```ts
import { test, expect } from './fixtures';
import type { Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { MOBILE_VIEWPORT, loginAs, settle } from './helpers';
import { SEL } from './selectors';

/**
 * Spec §8.3 performance. Throttling = Chrome DevTools "Slow 4G" (562.5 ms RTT,
 * 1474.56 kbps down, 675 kbps up) + 4x CPU slowdown (Lighthouse mobile profile).
 * GATE = repeat visit (HTTP cache warm), which is what an installed PWA user
 * experiences. The cold, cache-disabled load is measured and attached to the
 * report as information, not gated — stated here so nobody mistakes it.
 */
test.use({ viewport: MOBILE_VIEWPORT, serviceWorkers: 'block' });
test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });

const SLOW_4G = {
  offline: false,
  latency: 562.5,
  downloadThroughput: Math.round((1474.56 * 1024) / 8),
  uploadThroughput: Math.round((675 * 1024) / 8),
};
const KPI_IDS = [SEL.home.kpiMonthNet, SEL.home.kpiCash, SEL.home.kpiOutstanding, SEL.home.kpiTax];

async function throttle(page: Page, cacheDisabled: boolean) {
  const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
  await cdp.send('Network.enable');
  await cdp.send('Network.setCacheDisabled', { cacheDisabled });
  await cdp.send('Network.emulateNetworkConditions', SLOW_4G);
  await cdp.send('Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate', { rate: 4 });
  return cdp;
}
async function kpisVisibleAt(page: Page): Promise<number> {
  await page.goto('/app', { waitUntil: 'commit' });
  const h = await page.waitForFunction(
    (ids: string[]) => {
      const ok = ids.every((id) => {
        const el = document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${id}"]`);
        return !!el && /\d/.test(el.textContent || '');
      });
      return ok ? performance.now() : false;
    },
    KPI_IDS,
    { timeout: 30_000, polling: 50 },
  );
  return (await h.jsonValue()) as number;
}
const median = (xs: number[]) => [...xs].sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(xs.length / 2)];

test('Home shows its 4 KPIs within 2.5 s on Slow 4G + 4x CPU (repeat visit), and responds to a tap', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
  await loginAs(page, 'maya');
  await settle(page);
  await page.goto('/app');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.kpiTax)).toBeVisible(); // warm the function + HTTP cache
  await throttle(page, false);
  const samples = [await kpisVisibleAt(page), await kpisVisibleAt(page), await kpisVisibleAt(page)];
  await testInfo.attach('home-kpi-ms.json', { body: JSON.stringify({ samples, median: median(samples) }), contentType: 'application/json' });
  expect(median(samples), `KPI-visible samples ${samples.map(Math.round).join(', ')} ms`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2500);
  const t0 = Date.now();
  await page.getByTestId(SEL.home.kpiTax).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.kpiSheet)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 1000 });
  await testInfo.attach('kpi-tap-ms.json', { body: JSON.stringify({ ms: Date.now() - t0 }), contentType: 'application/json' });
});

test('cold load (cache disabled) — measured for the report, not gated', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
  await loginAs(page, 'maya');
  await settle(page);
  await throttle(page, true);
  const ms = await kpisVisibleAt(page);
  await testInfo.attach('home-kpi-cold-ms.json', { body: JSON.stringify({ ms }), contentType: 'application/json' });
  expect(ms).toBeGreaterThan(0);
});

test('Docs list scrolls without layout shift and never loads full-size receipts', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
  const blobHits: string[] = [];
  page.on('request', (r) => { if (/\.blob\.vercel-storage\.com\//.test(r.url())) blobHits.push(r.url()); });
  await loginAs(page, 'maya');
  await settle(page);
  await page.goto('/app/docs');
  await page.getByTestId(`${SEL.docs.filterPrefix}all`).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.docs.row).first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    const w = window as unknown as { __cls: number };
    w.__cls = 0;
    new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
      for (const e of list.getEntries() as Array<PerformanceEntry & { value: number; hadRecentInput: boolean }>) {
        if (!e.hadRecentInput) w.__cls += e.value;
      }
    }).observe({ type: 'layout-shift', buffered: false });
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < 12 && (await page.getByTestId(SEL.docs.row).count()) < 100; i++) {
    await page.mouse.wheel(0, 2000);
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  }
  const rows = await page.getByTestId(SEL.docs.row).count();
  const cls = await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __cls: number }).__cls);
  const imgs = await page.locator(`[data-testid="${SEL.docs.row}"] img`).evaluateAll((els) =>
    els.map((el) => {
      const img = el as HTMLImageElement;
      const w = new URL(img.currentSrc || img.src, location.href).searchParams.get('w');
      return { src: img.getAttribute('src') ?? '', w: w ? Number(w) : null, sized: !!(img.getAttribute('width') && img.getAttribute('height')) || !!img.style.width, loading: img.loading };
    }),
  );
  await testInfo.attach('docs-scroll.json', { body: JSON.stringify({ rows, cls, images: imgs.length }), contentType: 'application/json' });
  expect(cls, 'cumulative layout shift while scrolling Docs').toBeLessThan(0.1);
  for (const i of imgs) {
    expect(i.src, 'thumbnails go through the Next image optimizer').toContain('/_next/image');
    expect(i.w ?? 9999, 'thumbnail width').toBeLessThanOrEqual(384);
    expect(i.sized, 'thumbnail has intrinsic size (no shift)').toBe(true);
  }
  expect(imgs.slice(6).every((i) => i.loading === 'lazy'), 'off-screen thumbnails are lazy').toBe(true);
  expect(blobHits, 'no full-size receipt fetched directly by the list').toEqual([]);
});
```

```ts
import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright';
import { test, expect } from './fixtures';
import type { Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { MOBILE_VIEWPORT, loginAs, settle } from './helpers';
import { SEL } from './selectors';
import { inPageFetch } from './page-api';

/** Spec §8.3 accessibility, on all four screens + the viewer, light AND dark. */
test.use({ viewport: MOBILE_VIEWPORT, serviceWorkers: 'block' });

type Screen = { name: string; path: (p: Page) => Promise<string>; ready: string };
const SCREENS: Screen[] = [
  { name: 'home', path: async () => '/app', ready: SEL.home.screen },
  { name: 'docs', path: async () => '/app/docs', ready: SEL.docs.screen },
  {
    name: 'viewer',
    path: async (p) => {
      const r = await inPageFetch<{ data: Array<{ id: string }> }>(p, 'GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses?limit=1');
      return `/app/docs/${r.data!.data[0].id}`;
    },
    ready: SEL.viewer.screen,
  },
  { name: 'capture', path: async () => '/app/capture', ready: SEL.capture.screen },
  { name: 'chat', path: async () => '/app/chat', ready: SEL.chat.screen },
];

async function open(page: Page, s: Screen, theme: 'light' | 'dark') {
  await page.addInitScript((th) => { try { localStorage.setItem('theme', th); } catch { /* private mode */ } }, theme);
  await loginAs(page, 'maya');
  await settle(page);
  await page.goto('/app');
  await page.goto(await s.path(page));
  await expect(page.getByTestId(s.ready)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveClass(theme === 'dark' ? /\bdark\b/ : /^(?!.*\bdark\b).*$/);
  await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');
}

for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
  for (const s of SCREENS) {
    test(`axe: ${s.name} (${theme}) has zero serious/critical violations`, async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
      await open(page, s, theme);
      const res = await new AxeBuilder({ page }).withTags(['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21a', 'wcag21aa']).analyze();
      const bad = res.violations.filter((v) => v.impact === 'serious' || v.impact === 'critical');
      await testInfo.attach(`axe-${s.name}-${theme}.json`, { body: JSON.stringify(res.violations, null, 2), contentType: 'application/json' });
      expect(bad.map((v) => `${v.id} (${v.impact}): ${v.nodes.slice(0, 3).map((n) => n.target.join(' ')).join(' | ')}`)).toEqual([]);
    });
  }
}

for (const s of SCREENS) {
  test(`targets: every interactive element on ${s.name} is at least 44x44`, async ({ page }) => {
    await open(page, s, 'light');
    const small = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const sel = 'button, a[href], [role="button"], [role="tab"], [role="menuitem"], [role="menuitemradio"], input:not([type="hidden"]):not([type="file"]), select, textarea, summary';
      const out: string[] = [];
      for (const el of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(sel))) {
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
        if (r.width === 0 || r.height === 0 || cs.visibility === 'hidden' || cs.display === 'none') continue;
        if (el.tagName === 'A' && el.closest('p, li')) continue; // WCAG 2.5.8 inline-link exception
        if (r.width < 44 || r.height < 44) {
          const label = el.getAttribute('data-testid') ?? el.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? (el.textContent ?? '').trim().slice(0, 30);
          out.push(`${el.tagName.toLowerCase()}[${label}] ${Math.round(r.width)}x${Math.round(r.height)}`);
        }
      }
      return out;
    });
    expect(small).toEqual([]);
  });
}

test('focus: the first 6 tab stops on Home show a visible focus ring', async ({ page }) => {
  await open(page, SCREENS[0], 'light');
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
    const ring = await page.evaluate(() => {
      const el = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      if (!el || el === document.body) return 'none-focused';
      const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
      return cs.outlineStyle !== 'none' && parseFloat(cs.outlineWidth) > 0 ? 'ok' : `${el.tagName}:${el.getAttribute('data-testid') ?? ''}`;
    });
    expect(ring).toBe('ok');
  }
});

test('reduced motion: nothing animates on Home skeleton or the chat typing indicator', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
  await page.route((u) => u.pathname === '/api/v1/agentbook-core/mobile/home', async (route) => {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500));

  await page.route((u) => u.pathname === '/api/v1/agentbook-core/agent/message', async (route) => {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500));
    return route.continue();

  await loginAs(page, 'maya');
  await settle(page);
  const moving = () => page.evaluate(() =>
    Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*'))
      .filter((el) => {
        const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
        return cs.animationName !== 'none' && parseFloat(cs.animationDuration) > 0.001;
      })
      .map((el) => el.getAttribute('data-testid') || el.tagName));
  await page.goto('/app');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.skeleton)).toBeVisible();
  expect(await moving()).toEqual([]);
  await page.goto('/app/chat');
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.loading)).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 30_000 });
  await page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.input).fill('hello');
  await page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.send).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.typing)).toBeVisible();
  expect(await moving()).toEqual([]);
});
```

Create `tests/e2e/mobile-app/resilience.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { test, expect } from './fixtures';
import type { Page, Route } from '@playwright/test';
import { MOBILE_VIEWPORT, loginAs, settle } from './helpers';
import { SEL } from './selectors';
import { inPageFetch } from './page-api';

/**
 * Spec §8.3 resilience: offline, slow network (3 s), API 500, 429 and empty
 * account on each screen. Screenshots are attached for the launch report.
 * strictErrors=false only drops the browser's own "Failed to load resource"
 * lines that the injected failures cause; page errors and unhandled
 * rejections still fail the test.
 */
test.use({ viewport: MOBILE_VIEWPORT, serviceWorkers: 'block', strictErrors: false });

type S = {
  name: string;
  path: (page: Page) => Promise<string>;
  api: (u: URL) => boolean;
  ready: string; loading: string; error: string; stale: string | null; empty: string;
};
const firstId = async (p: Page) =>
  (await inPageFetch<{ data: Array<{ id: string }> }>(p, 'GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses?limit=1')).data!.data[0].id;

const SCREENS: S[] = [
  { name: 'home', path: async () => '/app', api: (u) => u.pathname === '/api/v1/agentbook-core/mobile/home',
    ready: SEL.home.screen, loading: SEL.home.skeleton, error: SEL.home.error, stale: SEL.home.stale, empty: SEL.home.empty },
  { name: 'docs', path: async () => '/app/docs', api: (u) => u.pathname === '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses',
    ready: SEL.docs.screen, loading: SEL.docs.skeleton, error: SEL.docs.error, stale: SEL.docs.stale, empty: SEL.docs.empty },
  { name: 'viewer', path: async (p) => `/app/docs/${await firstId(p)}`, api: (u) => /^\/api\/v1\/agentbook-expense\/expenses\/[^/]+$/.test(u.pathname),
    ready: SEL.viewer.screen, loading: SEL.viewer.skeleton, error: SEL.viewer.error, stale: null, empty: SEL.viewer.error },
  { name: 'chat', path: async () => '/app/chat', api: (u) => u.pathname.startsWith('/api/v1/agentbook-core/threads'),
    ready: SEL.chat.screen, loading: SEL.chat.loading, error: SEL.chat.error, stale: null, empty: SEL.chat.empty },
];

async function shot(page: Page, name: string) {
  await test.info().attach(`${name}.png`, { body: await page.screenshot(), contentType: 'image/png' });
}
const fulfillJson = (route: Route, status: number, body: unknown) =>
  route.fulfill({ status, contentType: 'application/json', body: JSON.stringify(body) });

test.describe('resilience (Maya)', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => { await loginAs(page, 'maya'); await settle(page); await page.goto('/app'); });

  for (const s of SCREENS) {
    test(`${s.name}: slow network (3 s) shows a loading state, then content`, async ({ page }) => {
      const path = await s.path(page);
      await page.route(s.api, async (route) => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return route.continue(); });
      await page.goto(path);
      await expect(page.getByTestId(s.loading)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 1500 });
      await shot(page, `${s.name}-slow-loading`);
      await expect(page.getByTestId(s.loading)).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 15_000 });
      await expect(page.getByTestId(s.error)).toHaveCount(0);
      await shot(page, `${s.name}-slow-loaded`);
    });

    test(`${s.name}: API 500 shows an error with Retry that recovers`, async ({ page }) => {
      const path = await s.path(page);
      let fail = true;
      await page.route(s.api, (route) => (fail ? fulfillJson(route, 500, { success: false, error: 'boom' }) : route.continue()));
      await page.goto(path);
      const err = page.getByTestId(s.error);
      await expect(err).toBeVisible();
      await shot(page, `${s.name}-500`);
      fail = false;
      await err.getByRole('button').first().click();
      await expect(page.getByTestId(s.error)).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 15_000 });
      await expect(page.getByTestId(s.ready)).toBeVisible();
    });

    test(`${s.name}: 429 is a labelled state, never a blank or a zero`, async ({ page }) => {
      const path = await s.path(page);
      await page.route(s.api, (route) => fulfillJson(route, 429, { success: false, error: 'rate_limited', retryAfterMs: 3000, message: 'Too many requests' }));
      await page.goto(path);
      await expect(page.getByTestId(s.error)).toBeVisible();
      await shot(page, `${s.name}-429`);
    });

    test(`${s.name}: offline after a good load shows the stale/offline state, not an error page`, async ({ page, context }) => {
      const path = await s.path(page);
      await page.goto(path);
      await expect(page.getByTestId(s.ready)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByTestId(s.loading)).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 15_000 });
      await page.route(s.api, (route) => route.abort('internetdisconnected'));
      await context.setOffline(true);
      try {
        await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('offline')));
        if (s.name === 'chat') {
          await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.chat.offline)).toBeVisible();
        } else {
          await page.reload().catch(() => { /* navigation is network-only; reload offline fails by design */ });
          await context.setOffline(false);
          await page.goto(path);
          await expect(page.getByTestId(s.stale ?? s.error)).toBeVisible();
        }
        await shot(page, `${s.name}-offline`);
      } finally {
        await context.setOffline(false);
      }
    });
  }

  test('capture: upload 500 / 429 show an error; slow 3 s shows progress; offline queues', async ({ page, context }) => {
    const isReceipt = (u: URL) => u.pathname === '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/from-receipt';
    const png = Buffer.from('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==', 'base64');
    const attempt = async () => {
      await page.goto('/app/capture');
      await page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.fileInput).setInputFiles({ name: 'r.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png });
      const amount = page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.amount);
      await expect(amount).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 });
      if (!(await amount.inputValue())) await amount.fill('1.00');
      await page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.save).click();
    };
    await page.route(isReceipt, (route) => fulfillJson(route, 500, { success: false, error: 'boom' }));
    await attempt();
    await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.error)).toBeVisible();
    await shot(page, 'capture-500');
    await page.unroute(isReceipt);
    await page.route(isReceipt, (route) => fulfillJson(route, 429, { success: false, error: 'rate_limited', retryAfterMs: 3000 }));
    await attempt();
    await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.error)).toBeVisible();
    await shot(page, 'capture-429');
    await page.unroute(isReceipt);
    await page.route(isReceipt, async (route) => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); return fulfillJson(route, 503, { success: false, error: 'boom' }); });
    await attempt();
    await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.save)).toBeDisabled();
    await shot(page, 'capture-slow');
    await page.unroute(isReceipt);
    await page.goto('/app/capture');
    await context.setOffline(true);
    try {
      await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('offline')));
      await page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.fileInput).setInputFiles({ name: 'r.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png });
      const amount = page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.amount);
      await expect(amount).toBeVisible();
      if (!(await amount.inputValue())) await amount.fill('1.00');
      await page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.save).click();
      await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.capture.queuePill)).toBeVisible();
      await shot(page, 'capture-offline-queued');
    } finally {
      // Leave nothing queued against Maya's books: clear the IndexedDB queue this test created.
      await page.evaluate(async () => {
        const dbs = (await (indexedDB as unknown as { databases?: () => Promise<Array<{ name?: string }>> }).databases?.()) ?? [];
        await Promise.all(dbs.filter((d) => d.name).map((d) => new Promise((r) => { const q = indexedDB.deleteDatabase(d.name!); q.onsuccess = q.onerror = q.onblocked = () => r(null); })));
      });
      await context.setOffline(false);
    }
  });
});

test.describe('empty account (fresh)', () => {
  test('every screen shows its empty state, not an error or zeros', async ({ page }) => {
    await loginAs(page, 'fresh');
    await settle(page);
    for (const [path, id] of [['/app', SEL.home.empty], ['/app/docs', SEL.docs.empty], ['/app/chat', SEL.chat.empty]] as const) {
      await page.goto(path);
      await expect(page.getByTestId(id)).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid$="-error"]')).toHaveCount(0);
      await shot(page, `fresh-${path.replace(/\//g, '_')}`);
    }
    await page.goto('/app/docs/not-a-real-id');
    await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.viewer.error)).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```
