- [ ] **Step 2: Write the PWA spec (service worker allowed)**

Create `tests/e2e/mobile-app/pwa.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { test, expect } from './fixtures';
import type { Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { MOBILE_VIEWPORT, loginAs } from './helpers';
import { SEL } from './selectors';

/**
 * Spec §8.3 PWA: manifest/installability, the deployed SW's caches and
 * notification default, and that a client controlled by an OLD worker ends up
 * on the NEW bundle (controllerchange path + unregister-and-reload path).
 * The SW must run here, so serviceWorkers stays 'allow' and nothing is routed.
 */
test.use({ viewport: MOBILE_VIEWPORT, serviceWorkers: 'allow' });

const PAGE_CHUNK = /\/_next\/static\/chunks\/app\/app\/page-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.js/g;
async function servedChunks(page: Page): Promise<string[]> {
  return page.evaluate(() =>
    performance.getEntriesByType('resource').map((e) => new URL(e.name).pathname)
      .filter((p) => /\/_next\/static\/chunks\/app\/app\/page-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.js$/.test(p)));
}
async function networkChunks(page: Page): Promise<string[]> {
  const html = await page.evaluate(async () => (await fetch(`/app?e2e=${Date.now()}`, { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'include' })).text());
  return [...new Set([...html.matchAll(PAGE_CHUNK)].map((m) => m[0]))];
}

test('manifest is installable and every icon/shortcut resolves', async ({ page }) => {
  const m = await (await page.request.get('/manifest.json')).json();
  expect(m.start_url).toBe('/app');
  expect(m.display).toBe('standalone');
  const sizes = (m.icons ?? []).map((i: { sizes: string }) => i.sizes);
  expect(sizes).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['192x192', '512x512']));
  for (const i of m.icons ?? []) expect((await page.request.get(i.src)).status(), i.src).toBe(200);
});

test('deployed sw.js: revalidated, notification default is /app, and no stale caches survive activation', async ({ page }) => {
  const res = await page.request.get('/sw.js');
  expect(res.headers()['cache-control'] ?? '').toMatch(/max-age=0|no-cache|must-revalidate/);
  const sw = await res.text();
  const handler = sw.slice(sw.indexOf("'notificationclick'"));
  expect(handler).toContain("'/app'");
  expect(handler).not.toMatch(/\|\|\s*['"]\/agentbook['"]/);
  const declared = [...sw.matchAll(/const \w*CACHE\w* = '([^']+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
  expect(declared.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  await loginAs(page, 'maya');
  await page.goto('/app');
  await page.evaluate(() => navigator.serviceWorker.ready);
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => !!navigator.serviceWorker.controller), { timeout: 20_000 }).toBe(true);
  const live = await page.evaluate(() => caches.keys());
  expect(live.filter((k) => !declared.includes(k)), 'caches from an older worker version').toEqual([]);
});

test('a client on an old worker reloads onto the new bundle exactly once (controllerchange)', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAs(page, 'maya');
  await page.goto('/app');
  await page.evaluate(() => navigator.serviceWorker.ready);
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(() => !!navigator.serviceWorker.controller), { timeout: 20_000 }).toBe(true);
  let loads = 0;
  page.on('load', () => { loads += 1; });
  const tag = `e2e${Date.now()}`;
  // A different script URL is a new worker version: install → skipWaiting →
  // clients.claim → controllerchange → the shell's one-shot reload.
  await page.evaluate(async (t) => { await navigator.serviceWorker.register(`/sw.js?v=${t}`); }, tag);
  await expect.poll(() => loads, { timeout: 30_000 }).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  // After the reload the shell re-registers the canonical /sw.js, which is one
  // more legitimate version change → at most one more reload. Then it must settle.
  await page.waitForTimeout(8000);
  const settled = loads;
  expect(settled, 'reloads after a worker update (1 for the update, ≤1 for re-registration)').toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);
  await page.waitForTimeout(5000);
  expect(loads, 'no reload loop').toBe(settled);
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.screen)).toBeVisible();
  const served = await servedChunks(page);
  expect(served.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(new Set(served)).toEqual(new Set(await networkChunks(page)));
});

test('unregister-and-reload lands on the deployed bundle with a fresh controller', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAs(page, 'maya');
  await page.goto('/app');
  await page.evaluate(() => navigator.serviceWorker.ready);
  await page.evaluate(async () => {
    for (const r of await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations()) await r.unregister();
    for (const k of await caches.keys()) await caches.delete(k);
  });
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByTestId(SEL.home.screen)).toBeVisible();
  await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(async () => (await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations()).length), { timeout: 20_000 }).toBe(1);
  expect(new Set(await servedChunks(page))).toEqual(new Set(await networkChunks(page)));
});
```

### Task 7.8: Security probes (two personas, prod)

**Files**
- Create: `tests/e2e/mobile-app/security.spec.ts`

**Interfaces**
- Consumes: C3 routes; `POST /api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses` (existing; `{amountCents, vendor, date, description}` → `data.id`).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the spec**

Create `tests/e2e/mobile-app/security.spec.ts`:

```ts
import { test, expect, type Browser, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { loginAs, settle } from './helpers';
import { inPageFetch } from './page-api';

/**
 * Spec §7 / §8.3 security, against the real deployment with two personas.
 * Alex owns a throwaway probe expense; Maya attacks it through every new or
 * extended route. All probes are "must NOT happen" — a correct server makes
 * them no-ops — and the probe row is deleted in finally.
 */
test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });
test.use({ serviceWorkers: 'block' });

async function session(browser: Browser, persona: 'maya' | 'alex'): Promise<{ page: Page; close: () => Promise<void> }> {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ serviceWorkers: 'block' });
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  await loginAs(page, persona);
  await settle(page);
  await page.goto('/app');
  return { page, close: () => ctx.close() };
}
const recentIds = async (p: Page) =>
  ((await inPageFetch<{ data: Array<{ id: string }> }>(p, 'GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses?limit=5')).data?.data ?? []).map((d) => d.id);

test('cross-tenant ids return 404 on every new route and change nothing', async ({ browser }) => {
  const alex = await session(browser, 'alex');
  const maya = await session(browser, 'maya');
  const created = await inPageFetch<{ data: { id: string } }>(alex.page, 'POST', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses', {
    amountCents: 1, vendor: 'e2e-security-probe', date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), description: 'security probe - safe to delete',
  });
  expect([200, 201]).toContain(created.status);
  const id = created.data!.data.id;
  try {
    const probes: Array<[string, string, unknown?]> = [
      ['GET', `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}`],
      ['PATCH', `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}`, { vendor: 'pwned', amountCents: 999, date: '2020-01-01' }],
      ['PUT', `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}`, { amountCents: 999 }],
      ['POST', `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}/archive`],
      ['POST', `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}/unarchive`],
      ['DELETE', `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}`],
    ];
    for (const [m, p, b] of probes) {
      const r = await inPageFetch(maya.page, m, p, b);
      expect(r.status, `${m} ${p} as another tenant`).toBe(404);
    }
    const review = await inPageFetch<{ data: { results: Array<{ expenseId: string; ok: boolean }> } }>(
      maya.page, 'POST', '/api/v1/agentbook-core/auto-categorize/review', { items: [{ expenseId: id, action: 'accept' }] },
    );
    if (review.status === 200) expect(review.data!.data.results).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ expenseId: id, ok: false })]);
    else expect(review.status).toBe(404);
    const listed = await inPageFetch<{ data: Array<{ id: string }> }>(maya.page, 'GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses?limit=100&q=e2e-security-probe');
    expect((listed.data?.data ?? []).map((d) => d.id)).not.toContain(id);
    const after = await inPageFetch<{ data: { amountCents: number; archivedAt?: string | null; deletedAt?: string | null } }>(alex.page, 'GET', `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}`);
    expect(after.status).toBe(200);
    expect(after.data!.data.amountCents).toBe(1);
    expect(after.data!.data.archivedAt ?? null).toBeNull();
    expect(after.data!.data.deletedAt ?? null).toBeNull();
    const alexThreads = await inPageFetch<{ data: Array<{ id: string }> }>(alex.page, 'GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-core/threads');
    for (const th of (alexThreads.data?.data ?? []).slice(0, 3)) {
      const r = await inPageFetch(maya.page, 'GET', `/api/v1/agentbook-core/threads/${th.id}/turns`);
      expect(r.status, `thread ${th.id} as another tenant`).toBe(404);
    }
  } finally {
    const del = await inPageFetch(alex.page, 'DELETE', `/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/${id}`);
    expect(del.status, 'probe cleanup').toBe(200);
    await alex.close();
    await maya.close();
  }
});

test('unauthenticated calls return 401', async ({ playwright }) => {
  const base = test.info().project.use.baseURL!;
  const req = await playwright.request.newContext({ baseURL: base });
  const calls: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-core/mobile/home'],
    ['GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-core/calendar/upcoming?days=30'],
    ['GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses?limit=1'],
    ['GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/x'],
    ['PATCH', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/x'],
    ['POST', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/x/archive'],
    ['POST', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/x/unarchive'],
    ['POST', '/api/v1/agentbook-core/auto-categorize/review'],
    ['POST', '/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/from-receipt'],
    ['GET', '/api/v1/agentbook-core/threads'],
    ['POST', '/api/v1/agentbook-core/agent/message'],
  ];
  for (const [method, path] of calls) {
    const r = await req.fetch(path, { method, maxRedirects: 0, data: method === 'GET' ? undefined : { text: 'x' } });
    expect(r.status(), `${method} ${path} without a session`).toBe(401);
  }
  await req.dispose();
});

test('from-receipt rejects a wrong type and an oversize file, creating nothing, leaking nothing', async ({ browser }) => {
  const maya = await session(browser, 'maya');
  try {
    const before = await recentIds(maya.page);
    const post = (kind: 'text' | 'huge') => maya.page.evaluate(async (k) => {
      const fd = new FormData();
      const blob = k === 'text'
        ? new Blob(['hello'], { type: 'text/plain' })
        : new Blob([new Uint8Array(15 * 1024 * 1024)], { type: 'image/jpeg' });
      fd.append('file', blob, k === 'text' ? 'note.txt' : 'huge.jpg');
      fd.append('idempotencyKey', crypto.randomUUID());
      const r = await fetch('/api/v1/agentbook-expense/expenses/from-receipt', { method: 'POST', body: fd, credentials: 'include' });
      return { status: r.status, body: await r.text() };
    }, kind);
    const wrong = await post('text');
    expect([400, 415]).toContain(wrong.status);
    const huge = await post('huge');
    expect([400, 413]).toContain(huge.status);
    for (const r of [wrong, huge]) expect(r.body).not.toMatch(/\bat \S+ \(|prisma|ECONN|stack/i);
    expect(await recentIds(maya.page)).toEqual(before);
  } finally {
    await maya.close();
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the lib**

Create `tests/e2e/mobile-app/scorecard-lib.ts`:

```ts
export type GateStatus = 'pass' | 'fail' | 'pending';
export interface GateResult { id: string; gate: string; rubric: string; status: GateStatus; evidence: string }
export interface PwSummary { expected: number; unexpected: number; flaky: number; skipped: number }

export function summarizePlaywright(report: unknown): PwSummary {
  const s = ((report as { stats?: Record<string, unknown> } | null)?.stats ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  return {
    expected: Number(s.expected ?? 0), unexpected: Number(s.unexpected ?? 0),
    flaky: Number(s.flaky ?? 0), skipped: Number(s.skipped ?? 0),
  };
}

/** Launch gates are deterministic or they are not gates: skipped/flaky/empty all fail. */
export function playwrightStatus(s: PwSummary): 'pass' | 'fail' {
  if (s.unexpected > 0 || s.flaky > 0 || s.skipped > 0) return 'fail';
  return s.expected > 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail';
}

export function checklistStatus(md: string): { status: GateStatus; done: number; total: number } {
  const done = (md.match(/^\s*- \[[xX]\]/gm) ?? []).length;
  const open = (md.match(/^\s*- \[ \]/gm) ?? []).length;
  const total = done + open;
  return { status: total > 0 && open === 0 ? 'pass' : 'pending', done, total };
}

export function verdict(results: GateResult[]): 'GO' | 'NO-GO' {
  return results.length > 0 && results.every((r) => r.status === 'pass') ? 'GO' : 'NO-GO';
}

type Suite = { title?: string; suites?: Suite[]; specs?: Array<{ tests?: Array<{ results?: Array<{ status?: string }> }> }> };
export function personaBreakdown(report: unknown): Record<string, { passed: number; failed: number }> {
  const out: Record<string, { passed: number; failed: number }> = {};
  const walk = (s: Suite, persona: string | null) => {
    const m = /^matrix — (\w+)$/.exec(s.title ?? '');
    const p = m ? m[1] : persona;
    for (const spec of s.specs ?? []) {
      for (const t of spec.tests ?? []) {
        if (!p) continue;
        const last = t.results?.[t.results.length - 1]?.status;
        out[p] ??= { passed: 0, failed: 0 };
        if (last === 'passed') out[p].passed += 1; else out[p].failed += 1;
      }
    }
    for (const child of s.suites ?? []) walk(child, p);
  };
  for (const s of ((report as { suites?: Suite[] } | null)?.suites ?? [])) walk(s, null);
  return out;
}

const cell = (s: string) => s.replace(/\|/g, '\\|').replace(/\s*\n\s*/g, ' ').trim();

export function renderReport(results: GateResult[], meta: { base: string; commit: string; runAt: string }): string {
  const v = verdict(results);
  const rows = results.map((r) => `| ${r.id} | ${cell(r.gate)} | ${cell(r.rubric)} | ${r.status.toUpperCase()} | ${cell(r.evidence)} |`);
  return [
    '# AgentBook mobile app (/app PWA) — launch report',
    '',
    `Run: ${meta.runAt} · Target: ${meta.base} · main @ \`${meta.commit}\``,
    'Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-mobile-app-ux-design.md §8 (rubric). Generated by tests/e2e/mobile-app/scorecard.ts.',
    '',
    `**Verdict: ${v}**`,
    '',
    '| Gate | What | Spec | Status | Evidence |',
    '|---|---|---|---|---|',
    ...rows,
    '',
    v === 'GO'
      ? 'All gates passed, including the manual device pass.'
      : 'NO-GO until every row is PASS. PENDING rows are manual items; FAIL rows have evidence above and artifacts in tests/e2e/mobile-app/results/.',
    '',
  ].join('\n');
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write the runner**

Create `tests/e2e/mobile-app/scorecard.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Executes every launch gate (spec §8) against a deployment and writes the
 * launch report. Run from the repo root:
 *   npx tsx tests/e2e/mobile-app/scorecard.ts [--base https://agentbook.brainliber.com]
 * Exit code 0 only on GO.
 */
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import {
  checklistStatus, personaBreakdown, playwrightStatus, renderReport, summarizePlaywright, verdict, type GateResult,
} from './scorecard-lib';

const ROOT = process.cwd();
if (!existsSync(join(ROOT, 'apps', 'web-next'))) throw new Error('run from the repo root');
const argBase = process.argv.indexOf('--base');
const BASE = argBase > -1 ? process.argv[argBase + 1] : 'https://agentbook.brainliber.com';
const OUT = join(ROOT, 'tests', 'e2e', 'mobile-app', 'results');
mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
const CONFIG = 'tests/e2e/mobile-app/playwright.config.ts';
const REPORT = join(ROOT, 'docs', 'superpowers', 'reports', '2026-10-mobile-app-launch-report.md');
const CHECKLIST = join(ROOT, 'docs', 'superpowers', 'reports', '2026-10-mobile-device-pass.md');

function sh(cmd: string, args: string[], env: Record<string, string> = {}, cwd = ROOT) {
  const r = spawnSync(cmd, args, { cwd, env: { ...process.env, ...env }, encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024 });
  return { code: r.status ?? 1, out: `${r.stdout ?? ''}${r.stderr ?? ''}` };
}
const tail = (s: string, n = 400) => s.trim().slice(-n);

function playwright(id: string, files: string[]): { status: 'pass' | 'fail'; evidence: string; json: unknown } {
  const jsonFile = join(OUT, `${id}.json`);
  sh('npx', ['playwright', 'test', `--config=${CONFIG}`, ...files, '--reporter=json'], {
    E2E_BASE_URL: BASE, PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME: jsonFile,
  });
  const json = existsSync(jsonFile) ? JSON.parse(readFileSync(jsonFile, 'utf8')) : null;
  const s = summarizePlaywright(json);
  return {
    status: playwrightStatus(s),
    evidence: `passed ${s.expected}, failed ${s.unexpected}, flaky ${s.flaky}, skipped ${s.skipped} (${files.join(', ')})`,
    json,
  };
}

const GATE_SPECS = new Set(['i18n-browser.spec.ts', 'perf.spec.ts', 'a11y.spec.ts', 'resilience.spec.ts', 'pwa.spec.ts', 'security.spec.ts', 'chat-replay.spec.ts']);
const JOURNEY_SPECS = readdirSync(join(ROOT, 'tests', 'e2e', 'mobile-app'))
  .filter((f) => f.endsWith('.spec.ts') && !GATE_SPECS.has(f));

const results: GateResult[] = [];
const add = (id: string, gate: string, rubric: string, status: GateResult['status'], evidence: string) =>
  results.push({ id, gate, rubric, status, evidence });

// G1 — CI green on main
{
  const r = sh('gh', ['run', 'list', '--branch', 'main', '--workflow', 'ci.yml', '--limit', '1', '--json', 'conclusion,headSha', '--jq', '.[0].conclusion + " " + .[0].headSha']);
  add('G1', 'All CI green on main (Quality Gates)', '§8.6, §8.1(8)', r.out.startsWith('success') ? 'pass' : 'fail', tail(r.out, 120));
}
// G2 — unit/component/API-client/route/invariant/offline suites
{
  const r = sh('npx', ['vitest', 'run', 'src/__tests__/app', 'src/__tests__/api/mobile', 'src/__tests__/architecture'], {}, join(ROOT, 'apps', 'web-next'));
  add('G2', 'Unit, component, API-client, route, invariant, offline-queue suites', '§8.1(1)-(5)', r.code === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail', tail(r.out, 200));
}
// G3 — i18n static guards
{
  const r = sh('npx', ['vitest', 'run', 'src/__tests__/architecture/mobile-app-i18n.test.ts', 'src/__tests__/architecture/i18n-catalog.test.ts', 'src/__tests__/architecture/i18n-shell-wiring.test.ts', 'src/__tests__/architecture/i18n-french-quality.test.ts', 'src/__tests__/app/mobile/chat-i18n.test.ts'], {}, join(ROOT, 'apps', 'web-next'));
  add('G3', 'i18n parity/wiring + no hardcoded English in /app', '§8.1(6)', r.code === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail', tail(r.out, 200));
}
// G4 — fr-CA / zh-CN in a real browser
{ const r = playwright('G4', ['i18n-browser.spec.ts']); add('G4', 'fr-CA and zh-CN render in a real browser (4 screens)', '§8.1(6)', r.status, r.evidence); }
// G5 — journeys × personas
{
  const r = playwright('G5', JOURNEY_SPECS);
  const per = personaBreakdown(r.json);
  const perText = ['maya', 'alex', 'sydney', 'fresh'].map((p) => `${p} ${per[p]?.passed ?? 0}✓/${per[p]?.failed ?? 0}✗`).join(', ');
  const allPersonas = ['maya', 'alex', 'sydney', 'fresh'].every((p) => (per[p]?.passed ?? 0) > 0 && (per[p]?.failed ?? 0) === 0);
  add('G5', 'E2E journeys 100% on the deployment, all four personas', '§8.1(7), §8.2', r.status === 'pass' && allPersonas ? 'pass' : 'fail', `${r.evidence}; ${perText}`);
}
// G6 — performance (runtime + route-JS budget from the latest main Build log)
{
  const r = playwright('G6', ['perf.spec.ts']);
  const run = sh('gh', ['run', 'list', '--branch', 'main', '--workflow', 'ci.yml', '--limit', '1', '--json', 'databaseId', '--jq', '.[0].databaseId']).out.trim();
  const job = sh('gh', ['run', 'view', run, '--json', 'jobs', '--jq', '.jobs[] | select(.name=="Build") | .databaseId']).out.trim();
  const log = sh('gh', ['run', 'view', run, '--job', job, '--log']).out
    .split('\n').map((l) => (l.split('\t')[2] ?? '').replace(/^[0-9-]+T[0-9:.]+Z /, '')).join('\n');
  const logFile = join(OUT, 'main-build.log');
  writeFileSync(logFile, log);
  const budget = sh('node', ['bin/perf-budget.mjs', logFile]);
  const ok = r.status === 'pass' && budget.code === 0;
  add('G6', 'Perf: Home KPIs ≤ 2.5 s Slow-4G; /app route JS ≤ baseline + 40 kB gz; Docs CLS/thumbs', '§8.3 Performance', ok ? 'pass' : 'fail',
    `${r.evidence}; budget: ${tail(budget.out.split('=== /app PWA routes')[1] ?? budget.out, 300)}`);
}
// G7 — accessibility
{ const r = playwright('G7', ['a11y.spec.ts']); add('G7', 'A11y: axe 0 serious/critical (light+dark), 44×44, focus, reduced motion', '§8.3 Accessibility', r.status, r.evidence); }
// G8 — resilience + console/unhandled-rejection collector (enforced by fixtures in every spec)
{ const r = playwright('G8', ['resilience.spec.ts']); add('G8', 'Resilience: offline, 3 s, 500, 429, empty per screen; zero console errors in journeys', '§8.3 Resilience', r.status, r.evidence); }
// G9 — PWA
{ const r = playwright('G9', ['pwa.spec.ts']); add('G9', 'PWA: manifest/installable, SW update reaches stale clients', '§8.3 PWA', r.status, r.evidence); }
// G10 — security
{ const r = playwright('G10', ['security.spec.ts']); add('G10', 'Security: cross-tenant 404, unauth 401, upload type/size', '§8.3 Security, §7', r.status, r.evidence); }
// G11 — chat reviewer-rule replay
{ const r = playwright('G11', ['chat-replay.spec.ts']); add('G11', 'Chat transcript replay (no reviewer-rule regressions)', '§8.1(7d), §8.4', r.status, r.evidence); }
// G12 — zero open P0/P1
{
  const labels = sh('gh', ['label', 'list', '--limit', '200', '--json', 'name', '--jq', '[.[].name] | join(",")']).out;
  if (!/\bP0\b/.test(labels) || !/\bP1\b/.test(labels)) {
    add('G12', 'Zero open P0/P1', '§8.6', 'pending', 'repo has no P0/P1 labels — triage open issues manually and record here');
  } else {
    const n = (l: string) => Number(sh('gh', ['issue', 'list', '--state', 'open', '--label', l, '--json', 'number', '--jq', 'length']).out.trim() || 'NaN');
    const p0 = n('P0'); const p1 = n('P1');
    add('G12', 'Zero open P0/P1', '§8.6', p0 === 0 && p1 === 0 ? 'pass' : 'fail', `open P0=${p0}, P1=${p1}`);
  }
}
// G13 — manual device pass
{
  const c = existsSync(CHECKLIST) ? checklistStatus(readFileSync(CHECKLIST, 'utf8')) : { status: 'pending' as const, done: 0, total: 0 };
  add('G13', 'Manual device pass (iOS Safari + Android Chrome)', '§8.6', c.status, `${c.done}/${c.total} checks ticked in docs/superpowers/reports/2026-10-mobile-device-pass.md`);
}

const commit = sh('git', ['rev-parse', 'origin/main']).out.trim();
writeFileSync(REPORT, renderReport(results, { base: BASE, commit, runAt: new Date().toISOString() }));
console.log(readFileSync(REPORT, 'utf8'));
process.exit(verdict(results) === 'GO' ? 0 : 1);
```

```markdown
# Mobile app — manual device pass

Spec §8.6 requires one real iOS Safari and one real Android Chrome install. Tick a box only after doing it
on the device, against https://agentbook.brainliber.com, signed in as a test persona. Note the device + OS
next to the heading. The scorecard (G13) reads the boxes; it is PENDING until every box is ticked.

**iOS Safari — device/OS: ________**

- [ ] Add to Home Screen from Safari's Share sheet; the icon appears and opens /app full-screen (no Safari chrome)
- [ ] Capture: tap Capture, take a real receipt photo with the camera, see the preview + prefilled amount, Save; the expense appears in Docs
- [ ] Chat: attach a photo from the camera; the receipt card appears and Open shows the viewer
- [ ] Keyboard: in Chat, focus the composer; the composer stays above the keyboard and the last message stays visible
- [ ] Offline: enable Airplane Mode, open the app from the home screen; Home shows the "as of HH:MM" snapshot; Capture queues a photo ("Queued · 1 waiting"); disable Airplane Mode and the queued receipt becomes exactly one expense
- [ ] Push: with notifications allowed, trigger a test push; tapping it opens /app (not /agentbook)

**Android Chrome — device/OS: ________**

- [ ] Install via the browser's Install app / Add to Home screen prompt; the app opens /app standalone
- [ ] Capture: camera capture → preview → Save; appears in Docs
- [ ] Chat: camera attach works; the composer stays above the keyboard
- [ ] Offline: Airplane Mode → snapshot on Home, capture queues, back online → exactly one expense
- [ ] Push: tapping a notification opens /app
```
